title: Senior Manager, Demand & Supply Planning
description:
***The role***

Today our jewellery manufacturing buys to order. A customer PO lands, we order loose diamonds from our own diamond-growing and polishing unit and findings (chains, earring backs, clasps and other bought-in components) from supplier partners, and both take 4–6 weeks. Customers often give us less time than that, so we rush, pay for it, or ship late. At the same time, parts of our factory sit under-loaded in off-season months and overloaded in peak.

You will fix both problems. You will forecast demand, place projection orders for diamonds and findings ahead of confirmed POs, hold the right buffer stock, and load slow months with pre-production of proven styles so we ship faster in season.

This is a pure planning role. You will not sell, buy on price, or run the shop floor. You will decide
**what**
we need,
**how much**
, and
**when**
— and be accountable for the numbers.

***About us***

Dholakia Lab Grown Diamond (DLGD) is the lab-grown diamond jewellery arm of the Hari Krishna (HK) Group. We are fully integrated, from growing and polishing lab-grown diamonds to designing and manufacturing jewellery for leading retailers and brands across the US, UK and Europe.

HK Group, founded in 1992, is one of India's largest diamond and jewellery exporters, with more than 11,000 people. In 2026, GJEPC recognised the Group as India's largest diamond jewellery manufacturer and exporter.

***What you will do***

**1. Forecast demand**

* Build a rolling 12-month demand forecast by customer, programme, style family and month, refreshed monthly.
* Use order history, seasonality (holiday, Valentine's, Mother's Day, bridal), customer sell-through and replenishment data, and known promotions.
* Agree forecasts and blanket commitments directly with key customers' planning and merchandising teams, so our forecast rests on their plans, not only our history.
* Measure and report forecast accuracy and bias every month, and explain the misses.

**2. Plan loose diamonds**

* Translate the jewellery forecast into diamond requirements by shape, size/sieve, colour, clarity and certification.
* Place monthly projection orders with our diamond unit so common qualities are polished and waiting before customer POs arrive.
* Set and maintain safety stock for high-runner qualities; keep slow-moving and special qualities on order-to-order.
* Cut rush orders (2-week turnarounds) to the exception, not the norm.

**3. Plan findings and bought-in components**

* Build the findings plan (chains, earring backs, clasps, jump rings, settings and other parts) from the forecast and bills of materials.
* Place projection and blanket orders with supplier partners, with agreed call-off schedules and minimum stock levels.
* Standardise components where possible, so one stock serves many styles.
* Track supplier lead time and on-time delivery, and escalate chronic gaps.

**4. Level production across the year**

* Map capacity by department (casting, setting, polishing, assembly and others) month by month against demand.
* Identify slow months and plan pre-production of proven, repeat styles into finished or semi-finished stock for peak season.
* Only pre-build what has a firm customer commitment or a strong repeat history; agree the list with Sales and the Business Head before production starts.
* Release work orders to the shop floor in line with the plan, and track plan vs actual.

**5. Run the monthly planning cycle (S&OP)**

* Lead a monthly sales and operations planning meeting with Sales, Merchandising, Production, Procurement and Finance.
* Bring one agreed number for demand, supply, inventory and capacity, with the risks and the decisions needed.
* Model the cash and inventory cost of each planning choice before it is made.

**6. Own inventory health**

* Monitor diamond, findings, WIP and finished-goods stock against agreed limits.
* Flag ageing and excess stock early and propose how to use or re-allocate it.
* Build and maintain the planning tools, dashboards and ERP master data the process depends on.

***What you own, and what you don't***

* **Demand:**
  you own the forecast and its accuracy. Sales targets and customer pricing sit with Sales.
* **Diamonds and findings:**
  you own what to order, how much and when, within an approved inventory budget. Supplier selection and price negotiation sit with Procurement.
* **Production:**
  you own the monthly production plan and pre-build list. Shop-floor execution and staffing sit with Production.
* **Inventory:**
  you own stock levels against agreed limits. Write-offs and valuation sit with Finance.

Projection orders and pre-builds above the approved inventory budget need sign-off from the Business Head and Finance.

***How we will measure you***

* On-time, in-full delivery to customers
* Orders delayed by diamond or findings shortage
* Rush diamond orders as a share of total
* Forecast accuracy and bias, by customer and style family
* Inventory turns and ageing (diamonds, findings, finished goods)
* Capacity utilisation in off-season months

***Your first 90 days***

* **Days 1–30:**
  Map the current order-to-delivery flow, lead times by supplier, and the last 24 months of orders by customer and style. Identify the 20% of diamond qualities and findings that drive 80% of volume.
* **Days 31–60:**
  Launch the first rolling forecast and the first projection orders for high-runner diamonds and findings. Propose safety-stock levels and an inventory budget.
* **Days 61–90:**
  Run the first full monthly S&OP meeting. Present an off-season pre-build plan for the next slow period, with its cash and risk impact.

***Who we are looking for***

**Must have**

* 8+ years in demand, supply or materials planning in manufacturing, with at least 3 years owning a forecast and inventory outcomes yourself.
* Experience planning made-to-order or short-lifecycle products with long-lead materials (jewellery, watches, apparel, footwear, consumer goods or similar).
* A proven record of cutting lead times or stock-outs without inflating inventory, with numbers to show it.
* Strong Excel and data skills; comfortable building forecast models and planning dashboards from raw ERP data.
* Hands-on ERP/MRP experience (SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics or a jewellery ERP).
* The confidence to challenge Sales on forecasts and push back on rush requests, with data.

**Strong advantage**

* Jewellery or diamond industry experience, especially with US, Europe & UK retail customers.
* Working knowledge of diamond grading (shape, size, colur, clarity) and jewellery bills of materials.
* S&OP / IBP process leadership, or APICS CPIM / CSCP certification.
* Experience with statistical forecasting tools or Python / Power BI.

**Education**

* Degree in engineering, supply chain, operations, statistics or a related field. An MBA in operations is welcome but not required.

***The details***

* **Title:**
  Senior Manager – Demand & Supply Planning
* **Reports to:**
  COO
* **Works with:**
  Sales and Merchandising, Production, Procurement, our diamond unit, Finance
* **Team:**
  Individual contributor at start, with scope to build a planning team of 2–3
* **Location:**
  Mumbai,

title: AVP - Data Governance
description:
**Synopsis of the role**
We are seeking a Data Governance Leader to drive data quality, regulatory compliance, and analytics governance across our core credit ecosystem. In this executive-facing role, you will oversee data pipelines, enforce Uniform Credit Reporting Formats, and manage Critical Data Elements across data ingestion lifecycle. Working closely with Senior Leadership, Board committees, and regulatory bodies to align data policies with regulatory frameworks. Additionally, you will lead root cause analysis and establish data trend reporting to mitigate risk. Join us to bridge complex technical architectures with business strategy and shape credit data governance.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Data Quality & Analytics Governance (DQI/DSR): Enforce and maintain Uniform Credit Reporting Formats (UCRF -Forms 1, 2, and 3) across all data pipelines. Oversee end-to-end ingestion processing, ensure automated generation and distribution of Data Statistics Reports (DSR), and establish benchmarks for file-level, CI-level, and Industry-level Data Quality Indexes (DQIs).
* Critical Data Element (CDE) & Lineage Management: Own and continuously update the CDE Master Register covering key attributes such as Loan Status, DPD, Outstanding Balance, and Demographics. Design and enforce risk-based data lineage tracking from initial SFTP ingestion through to consumer credit reports (CIRs) and scoring models.
* Regulatory Compliance & Policy Alignment: Ensure strict compliance with statutory credit data retention policies (7- year and perpetual retention rules) and RBI guidelines. Work closely with legal and compliance teams to adapt internal governance policies to evolving regulatory standards.
* Dispute Resolution Governance: Monitor and optimize dispute resolution workflows to ensure adherence to the statutory 30-day resolution SLA. Collaborate directly with the Internal Ombudsman on complex or escalated dispute rejections to maintain fairness and accuracy.
* Root Cause Analysis (RCA) & Algorithm Tuning: Analyze quarterly delink logs and customer complaint dumps to conduct deep-dive RCAs. Identify and resolve algorithm defects, fine-tuning entity resolution match logic and adjusting match thresholds within DCtrl.
* Member Engagement & Data Remediation: Drive engagement with Credit Institutions (CIs) to resolve recurring submission errors, monitor compliance, and enforce data cleanup and resubmission schedules.
* Audit & Anomaly Detection: Execute routine KYC anomaly audits focusing on key identifiers like PAN, Aadhaar, and Voter ID to ensure data integrity and prevent identity misclassification.
* Data Trends: Data Trend Analysis & Reporting: Extract, analyze, and publish data trends to deliver actionable insights to key stakeholders, serving as early warning indicators to mitigate potential risks.

**What Experience You Need**

* Education: Bachelor’s or master’s degree in data Analytics, Computer Science, Statistics, Finance, or related quantitative fields.
* Experience: 15+ years of relevant experience in Data Governance, Data Quality Management, or Business Intelligence within a Credit Bureau, Financial Institution, or Fintech.
* Domain Knowledge: Deep expertise in Indian Credit Bureau standards (UCRF, CICRA, DPDP), entity resolution, cascading match algorithms, and data lineage mapping.
* Technical & Analytical Skills: Proficiency in SQL, SAS/Python, database architecture (Cassandra/Oracle), ETL frameworks (Talend GCP), and statistical sampling methods.
* Leadership: Strong cross-functional leadership, executive presentation capabilities, and experience presenting governance outcomes to Senior Leadership teams and board committees.

**What Could Set You Apart**

* Prior Experience in Data governance role with large Bank, NBFC or CIC

description:
**Job Title:**
AI Acceleration Control Tower Lead - PM BA
  
  
**Department**
: India CoE CIB CIO OFFICE
  
  
**About Business line/Function:**
AI Acceleration
  
  
**Position Purpose**
BNP Paribas CIB ITO has launched its AI Acceleration Program to support the large-scale deployment of GenAI and Agentic AI, aligning with the BNPP Group’s 2030 AI ambitions.
  
  
The AI Acceleration Program team, based in EMEA and ISPL, oversees the following activities:
  
  

* Program Management activities (implementation of AI Governance within ITO, reporting broadly on AI related topics to ITO management, overall coordination of AI dependencies in ITO scope)
* Community of Practice - animation of AI communities through communication, training, events, license management etc.)
* Control Tower (assuring correct reporting on AI products adoption and value
* AI Exploration Center (facilitation of governance processes within ITO for AI projects and use cases and reporting towards CIB and Group) on ongoing initiatives in ITO scope

Within the AI Acceleration Program, a CIB AI Control Tower has been initiated to pursue 2 objectives:
  
  

* Defining automated control and data representation mechanism to measure KPIs to track:
* AI Usage, Adoption and value of AI products (AI SDLC with Claude Code/Qwen, LLM@CIB, ....)
* AI Platform usage and cost monitoring (based on CIB entities and sub-entities consumption of different LLM products and models)
* Other based on ever evolving AI strategies
* Supporting Risk Management and Compliance of AI usage by providing relevant support, data, and logs to corresponding team.

**Responsibilities**
Direct Responsibilities
  
  

* Control Tower lead for Global CIB ITO:
* Work as a primary coordinator and contact point to understand AI Control tower dashboard requirements from stakeholders that could be senior leaders, cluster Catalysts across regions, analyze and translate them to be able to implement in the Central AI dashboard
* Assure correct working of the dashboard (stability, data accuracy, communication, support model)
* Represent Control Tower topics and assure correct and clear reporting on:
* Support and presentation for regular governance meetings on management and senior management level (AI catalysts Meeting, regional OpCo's, ad-hoc requests) as well on operational level with peers and users
* Written (email) communication to management and peers
* Communication and Collaboration with stakeholders:
* Work closely with different teams to understand their data needs and provide relevant insights (e.g. Community of Practice team to help them identify most suitable / targeted change management initiatives)
* Present findings and recommendations to management and stakeholders in a clear and compelling manner
* Experience in prioritizing and systematically organizing tasks, demonstrating sensitivity to urgent matters, completing tasks in a timely manner
* Solid experience in getting to understand complex situations and raise risks and share proposals
* Translate requirements into actionable changes to be realized by BI team:
* Assure proper documentation of the Control Tower scope
* Translate requirements into requests for change in JIRA
* Work closely with BI team to construct and prioritize roadmap and assure correct execution of changes
* Identify any dependencies and actively help to resolve them with involved team, escalating if required to the right stakeholders
* Support to Risk and Compliance framework
* Act as a bridge, when required, between regional teams and central governance regarding regional Risk, Compliance and Regulatory topics in the context of AI.
* Support the definition and implementation of AI-specific guardrails (such as terms and conditions, suspicious prompt monitoring), conduct periodic controls of AI product accesses, etc.

**Technical & Behavioral Competencies**
**Technical Responsibilities**
The ideal candidate will have:
  
  
**Data Presentation**

* Data Analysis: Perform and document analysis, review and study on specified AI Usage Understand business change and requirement needs, assess the impact and the cost.
* Data visualization: Deliver data in useful and appealing ways to users
* Data Mining: The extraction of patterns and knowledge from large amounts of data from the database in order to answer to questions, investigations or controls needs.
* Data Science: use of scientific methods to obtain useful information from computer data directly from Oracle database to automate process & controls.

**Business Intelligence**

* Collect reporting needs and analyze that, define and monitor KPIs accordingly to track AI usage, adoption, workmix, cost, platform capacity, value etc
* Based on the requirements and the data pattern, provide clear requirements (using JIRA) to the AI Platform’s BI Team to create and maintain dashboards in line with identified needs, ensuring BI Roadmap prioritization and delivery.
* Collect, analyse, and interpret complex data sets to uncover trends and patterns, and provide reporting to stakeholders (Management, AI Catalysts, AI Platform, etc).
* Write clear technical and functional specification using JIRA or similar tools
* Accountable to ensure data accuracy and integrity through data validation and quality control measures Have a strong background in data analysis, visualization, reporting

**Tool Knowledge**

* Advanced knowledge in Excel, knowledge of project management software (such as Jira)
* Intermediate knowledge of SQL systems with ability to write basic queries for data analysis
* Advanced understanding of SDLC and Agile processes
* Understanding of BI tools (e.g. PowerBI) – Preferred

**Specific Qualifications**
**Skills Referential**

+ Ability to manage a project
+ Analytical Ability
+ Ability to develop and adapt a process
+ Ability to anticipate business / strategic evolution
+ Ability to understand, explain and support change

**Behavioral Skills**




+ Ability to collaborate / Teamwork
+ Decision Making
+ Ability to synthetize / simplify
+ Critical thinking

**Education & Experience Level**
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent, at least 12 years of professional experience.
  
  
**Location: Mumbai**
**About BNP Paribas Group**
BNP Paribas is the European Union’s leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking & Services for the Group’s commercial & personal banking and several specialized businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment & Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate & Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. Based on its strong diversified and integrated model, the Group helps all its clients (individuals, community associations, entrepreneurs, SMEs, corporates and institutional clients) to realize their projects through solutions spanning financing, investment, savings and protection insurance. In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg.
  
  
The Group is rolling out its integrated commercial & personal banking model across several Mediterranean countries, Turkey, and Eastern Europe. As a key player in international banking, the Group has leading platforms and business lines in Europe, a strong presence in the Americas as well as a solid and fast-growing business in Asia-Pacific.
  
  
BNP Paribas has implemented a Corporate Social Responsibility approach in all its activities, enabling it to contribute to the construction of a sustainable future, while ensuring the Group's performance and stability.
  
  
**About BNP Paribas India Solutions**
Established in 2005, BNP Paribas India Solutions is a wholly owned subsidiary of BNP Paribas SA, European Union’s leading bank with an international reach. With delivery centers located in Bengaluru, Chennai and Mumbai, we are a 24x7 global delivery center. Driving innovation and growth, we are harnessing the potential of over 10000 employees, to provide support and develop best-in-class solutions.

title: Senior Associate Valuations Control
description:
SS&C is a leading provider of mission-critical, AI-powered technology and services empowering financial services and healthcare organizations to work smarter, faster, and securely. Founded in 1986, SS&C is headquartered in Windsor, Connecticut, and has offices worldwide. More than 23,000 financial services and healthcare organizations, from the world's largest companies to small and mid-market firms, rely on SS&C for expertise, scale, and technology.
  
  
**Job Description**
Job Summary:\*\*
  
  
The Senior Associate Valuations Control will play a crucial role in ensuring the accuracy and integrity of valuations for a variety of financial instruments. This position involves performing independent price verification, reconciling valuations, and supporting the overall valuation control framework.
  
  
Job Responsibilities:\*\*
  
  

* Perform independent price verification (IPV) on a diverse range of financial instruments, including but not limited to fixed income, equities, derivatives, and alternative investments.
* Reconcile internal valuations with external pricing sources and identify, investigate, and resolve discrepancies.
* Ensure adherence to established valuation policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements.
* Prepare detailed valuation reports and documentation for internal and external stakeholders, including auditors and clients.
* Collaborate with front office, risk management, and operations teams to understand and address valuation-related issues.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of valuation methodologies, systems, and controls.
* Assist in the development and implementation of new valuation models and processes.
* Participate in special projects and ad-hoc analysis as required by management.
* Provide training and mentorship to junior team members, fostering a culture of continuous learning and development.

Job Qualifications:\*\*
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related quantitative field. Master's degree or professional certifications (e.g., CFA, FRM) are highly desirable.
* 4-7 years of experience in valuation control, product control, or a similar role within the financial services industry, preferably with exposure to a variety of asset classes.
* Strong understanding of financial instruments, valuation techniques, and market conventions.
* Proficiency in financial modeling and strong analytical skills with meticulous attention to detail.
* Advanced Excel skills are essential; experience with VBA, SQL, Python, or other programming languages is a plus.
* Familiarity with financial data providers (e.g., Bloomberg, Refinitiv) and valuation systems.
* Excellent communication (written and verbal) and interpersonal skills, with the ability to articulate complex concepts clearly.
* Ability to work effectively under pressure, manage multiple priorities, and meet tight deadlines.
* A proactive and inquisitive mindset, with a strong commitment to accuracy and data integrity

title: Implementation Manager
description:
**Some Careers Open More Doors Than Others.**
If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
  
  
HSBC Corporate and Institutional Banking is a markets-led, financing-focused business that provides investment and financial solutions. Through our international network, we connect emerging and mature markets, covering key growth areas. We partner with our corporate, government and institutional clients to help them achieve consistent, long-term performance. Our products and services include advisory, financing, prime services, research and analysis, securities services, trading and sales and transaction banking.
  
  
****Job Introduction****
As an Individual Contributor own the implementation and ongoing management of credit policies, controls, regulatory requirements and governance processes for the business. The role converts regulatory and risk requirements into practical operating processes, management information, system changes and disciplined follow-up, while serving as a central coordinator across Business, Credit Risk, Operations, Compliance, Finance, Technology, Internal Audit and external regulators/auditors.
  
  
****Principal Responsibilities****
****1. Regulatory reporting and schemes****

* Coordinate SMA inputs for CRILC/CIC reporting, challenge classifications and finalise submissions.
* Manage RBI Tranche I/II/III credit-control submissions, including data, validation, governance and evidence.
* Administer ADB, GuarantCo, Agri and other credit support schemes, ensuring eligibility, documentation and reporting.
* Coordinate related-party exposure management and SOX declarations.

****2. Credit policy implementation****

* Coordinate input, rollout and annual updates for credit policies covering evaluation, MSME/priority-sector lending, ECLGS, securities-backed lending and project finance.
* Convert regulatory and group changes into procedures, controls, communications, training, system requirements and implementation plans.
* Serve as the business contact for policy interpretation and implementation.

****3. Credit controls and portfolio discipline****

* Strengthen monitoring controls, ownership, evidence, escalation and closure.
* Track covenants, conditions,, early warnings and information requests.
* Ensure compliance with LDS, LEI, Large Exposures, market-suitability, Excess Reporting, unhedged FX and capital-market exposure requirements.
* Lead read-across reviews, Management Self-Identified Issues & actions and remediation of policy, control or regulatory findings.

****4. Audit and issue management****

* Lead credit-file preparation and submission for RBI, statutory, HKMA, GIA and concurrent audits.
* Validate information from Credit Systems, Business Credit Officers, relationship managers and other sources; coordinate audit and regulatory responses.
* Drive audit actions and remediation to sustainable closure, with accurate reporting and evidence.

****5. Pricing, capital and governance****

* Support the India Deal Prioritisation Committee and RWA optimisation.
* Maintain monthly credit-interest spread delineation and support the Interest Rates on Advances Policy.
* Coordinate pricing-system and process changes and maintain governance records.

****6. Business management and resilience****

* Coordinate Credit stress tests and Quarterly Lending Survey, including sector credit forecasts.
* Manage third-party and group-entity risk for credit processes, including TPEM/outsourcing governance.
* Responsible to ensure changes in systems to meet the regulatory and business growth requirements are delivered on time.
* Oversee vendor and bill-payment administration for credit support services.
* Support Watch, Worry and Monitor and MSME exposure governance forums.

**Qualifications**
****Role Requirements / Education Qualifications / Certifications / Experience:****

* Graduate with a minimum 10 years’ relevant experience in credit analysis, credit regulations, policies and controls.
* Strong knowledge of credit policy implementation, control frameworks and regulatory reporting requirements.
* Ability to articulate required actions clearly, manage senior stakeholders and deliver high-quality outcomes within agreed timelines.
* Resilience, sound judgement and the ability to remain effective in a demanding and evolving environment are essential.

**Pro-Tip:**
Familiarity with AI-enabled tools is an advantage.
  
  
As an employee, you are required to perform your duties in a professional capacity exercising independent judgement, discretion and decision-making authority in planning, organising, directing work, supervising and appraising the work of team members, as applicable; and taking accountability for delivery outcomes. You will represent the organization with relevant internal and external stakeholders. You will allocate and prioritize work, provide direction and feedback, manage team capacity and leave in line with policy as applicable.
  
  
HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.
  
  
Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

title: Senior Data Analyst I - Survey Programming
description:
**Company Description**
At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content - wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future.
  
  
**Job Description**
Our Senior Technical Survey Data Analysts are responsible for programming survey questionnaires based on the materials provided by the Brand Impact Research Team, using specific software to program surveys, such as Decipher. This position combines survey development (from questionnaires), quality assurance, and direct communication with internal stakeholders and partners. This role will include liaising with project managers and researchers to understand their requirements, programming surveys according to their specifications, and resolving any issues encountered during fieldwork. The role also involves checking and cleaning survey data, merging data, and creating cross-tabulation tables.
  
  
**Primary Role Responsibilities**

* Turning a questionnaire document into an online survey using Decipher
* Performing rigorous quality assurance checks on survey programs to ensure that they are error-free and meet client expectations
* Working with the client services and research teams to ensure that client expectations are met and exceeded
* Communicating with internal stakeholders to obtain clarifications and/or resolve survey programming issues
* Troubleshooting and resolving issues with programmed surveys while they are in the field
* Reviewing collected data for outliers, skip logic issues, or inconsistencies
* Cleanse data, data merging, and create cross-tabulation tables
* The position involves regular night shifts and weekend work. Adapting to this schedule is a crucial aspect of the role.
* Support all operational tasks undertaken by the team outside of survey and data programming, ensuring seamless workflow and efficiency.
* Collaborate with team members to contribute to overall project success

**Necessary Skills**

* Excellent critical thinking and the desire to seek solutions for novel situations as they arise
* Attention to detail – quality, and accuracy in all work and interactions
* A self-motivated, curious learner with the ability to work collaboratively and willingness to lean in – need to jump in quickly, adapt and work in a collaborative team environment, managing multiple projects at once
* Agile and open-minded, resilient with an enthusiasm for problem-solving.
* Quick learner with a logical mindset and analytical thinking who is passionate about technology
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Friendly, motivated, dynamic, ambitious, and a team player!
* Strong project management skills - being organized, taking ownership, using initiative & being proactive
* Some programming experience, ideally understanding Object-Oriented Programming, loops, recursion, data structures, and algorithms.
* Ability to work across diverse clients and industries

**Qualifications**

* 4-6+ years experience in analytics and/or survey program
* Bachelor’s Degree/ B.Tech/BE in Computer Science/Engineering or any IT-related fields
* Python 2.7 (or other languages), XML, HTML, JavaScript, and CSS “OR” have strong problem-solving skills with the ability to learn things quickly in a challenging environment and think outside the box
* Ability to grasp new concepts easily
* Stats background a plus
* Technical proficiency in Office/Google Suite of software solutions
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment
* Experience in Decipher
* The position involves regular night shifts and weekend work

**Additional Information**
Please be aware that job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen.com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen.com address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.

title: Data Analyst II - Survey Programming
description:
**Company Description**
At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content - wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future.
  
  
**Job Description**
Our Technical Survey Data Analysts are responsible for programming survey questionnaires based on the materials provided by the Brand Impact Research Team, using specific software to program surveys, such as Decipher. This position combines survey development (from questionnaires), quality assurance, and direct communication with internal stakeholders and partners. This role will include liaising with project managers and researchers to understand their requirements, programming surveys according to their specifications, and resolving any issues encountered during fieldwork. The role also involves checking and cleaning survey data, merging data, and creating cross-tabulation tables.
  
  
**Primary Role Responsibilities**

* Turning a questionnaire document into an online survey using Decipher or other survey software
* Performing rigorous quality assurance checks on survey programs to ensure that they are error-free and meet client expectations
* Working with the client services and research teams to ensure that client expectations are met and exceeded
* Communicating with internal stakeholders to obtain clarifications and/or resolve survey programming issues
* Troubleshooting and resolving issues with programmed surveys while they are in the field
* Reviewing collected data for outliers, skip logic issues, or inconsistencies
* Cleanse data, data merging, and Create cross-tabulation tables
* The position involves night shifts and weekend work. Adapting to this schedule is a crucial aspect of the role.
* Support all operational tasks undertaken by the team outside of survey and data programming, ensuring seamless workflow and efficiency.
* Collaborate with team members to contribute to overall project success

**Necessary Skills**

* Excellent critical thinking and the desire to seek solutions for novel situations as they arise
* Attention to detail – quality, and accuracy in all work and interactions
* A self-motivated, curious learner with the ability to work collaboratively and willingness to lean in – need to jump in quickly, adapt, and work in a collaborative team environment, managing multiple projects at once
* Agile and open-minded, resilient with an enthusiasm for problem-solving.
* Quick learner with a logical mindset and analytical thinking who is passionate about technology
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Friendly, motivated, dynamic, ambitious, and definitely a team player!
* Strong project management skills - being organized, taking ownership, using initiative & being proactive
* Some programming experience, ideally understanding Object-Oriented Programming, loops, recursion, data structures, and algorithms.
* Ability to work across diverse clients and industries

**Qualifications**

* 3+ years experience in survey program
* Bachelor’s Degree/ B.Tech/BE in Computer Science/Engineering or any IT-related fields
* Python 2.7 (or other languages), XML, HTML, JavaScript, and CSS “OR” have strong problem-solving skills with the ability to learn things quickly in a challenging environment and think outside the box
* Ability to grasp new concepts easily
* Stats background a plus
* Technical proficiency in Office/Google Suite of software solutions
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment
* Experience in Decipher survey programming platform
* The position involves night shifts and weekend work.

**Additional Information**
Please be aware that job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen.com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen.com address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.

title: Ecommerce Manager
company: Intellectual Capital HR Consulting Pvt. Ltd.
description:
**Key Responsibilities**

**A. E-commerce Channel Management**

* Lead day-to-day operations across Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, Tata CLiQ, Blinkit, Instamart, Zepto and MARKETPLACE's website, as applicable.
* Ensure catalogue accuracy, listing completeness, pricing accuracy and product availability.
* Monitor listing suppression, Buy Box or equivalent offer visibility, catalogue issues, account health and platform escalations.
* Coordinate new SKU launches, listing updates, content uploads and product information changes.
* Ensure that products are listed correctly and that the right SKUs are available on the right channels.

**B. Inventory & Supply Chain Coordination**

* Work closely with the Operations team to plan inventory allocation and replenishment across marketplaces and warehouses.
* Monitor stock-outs, excess stock, inventory ageing and demand trends.
* Coordinate purchase-order requirements, inbound stock and marketplace fulfilment requirements.
* Improve inventory visibility and ensure that sales opportunities are not lost due to preventable stock shortages.
* Establish SKU-wise exception reporting and escalation mechanisms.

**C. E-commerce Performance & Commercial Analysis**

* Track sales, units sold, returns, cancellations, availability and other relevant marketplace KPIs.
* Monitor channel-wise and SKU-wise performance and identify opportunities to improve growth.
* Work with the Finance team to understand marketplace fees, discounts, returns, contribution margins and settlement differences.
* Coordinate with performance marketing agencies on advertising requirements, campaign calendars, stock availability and listing readiness.
* Monitor advertising outcomes with agencies and connect campaign activity with overall channel performance.

**D. Quick Commerce & Website**

* Manage operational requirements for quick-commerce platforms, including catalogue setup, assortment, availability, purchase orders, promotional coordination and issue resolution.
* Coordinate website product listings, pricing, product content and operational requirements with the relevant teams and service providers.
* Identify channel-specific opportunities and improve execution across existing and new e-commerce channels.

**E. Team Management & Process Improvement**

* Lead and organise the existing e-commerce/operations team, with clearly defined responsibilities and performance metrics.
* Establish standard operating procedures for listings, inventory allocation, order processing, catalogue updates and marketplace escalations.
* Improve workflows, data accuracy and execution discipline.
* Work with the warehouse and logistics teams to improve dispatch accuracy, fulfilment performance and returns processing.
* Drive process automation and better utilisation of the existing warehouse management and e-commerce systems.

**F. Reporting & Cross-functional Coordination**

* Prepare a regular e-commerce dashboard covering sales, inventory, listing health, stock-outs, returns, cancellations and operational exceptions.
* Coordinate with Finance on marketplace reconciliation and channel-level performance.
* Work with Marketing on promotions, campaigns, product launches and content requirements.
* Escalate material risks, opportunities and decisions requiring founder intervention.

**Candidate Profile**

* 68 years of experience in e-commerce operations, marketplace management or e-commerce business management.
* Prior experience with a D2C, consumer-products, retail or marketplace-led brand is strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated hands-on experience with Amazon and Flipkart; quick-commerce experience with platforms such as Blinkit, Instamart or Zepto is a strong advantage.
* Strong understanding of catalogue management, listing health, inventory planning, marketplace operations and account escalations.
* Experience managing teams and coordinating with warehouses, logistics partners, advertising agencies and internal stakeholders.
* Strong Excel and data-analysis skills, with the ability to interpret SKU-wise and channel-wise performance.
* Familiarity with e-commerce management systems, ERP/WMS tools and marketplace seller portals.
* High ownership, problem-solving ability and willingness to work hands-on in a lean organisation.

**Key Success Measures**

* Improved sales-channel execution and availability.
* Reduction in avoidable stock-outs, listing errors and catalogue issues.
* Accurate SKU mapping, pricing and marketplace content.
* Improved inventory allocation and replenishment discipline.
* Timely resolution of marketplace escalations.
* Better team productivity and standardisation of operating processes.
* Reliable e-commerce dashboards and coordination with Finance and Marketing.

**Role Boundaries**

The E-commerce Manager will own marketplace operations, availability, catalogue hygiene, channel execution and e-commerce performance monitoring. Performance marketing agencies will continue to execute paid advertising, with the Brand & Content Manager owning brand communication and creative strategy.

The E-commerce Manager will work with Operations on warehouse and logistics execution and with Finance on reconciliations and profitability. The role must coordinate these functions without duplicating their core responsibilities.

title: Research Engineer, Portfolio Management Group (PMG Tech), Associate
description:
**About This Role**
Your team
  
  
Portfolio Management Group Technology (PMG Tech) is the horizontal technology platform within BlackRock’s Portfolio Management Group. The team integrates portfolio management, risk management, and quantitative workflows with advanced engineering, artificial intelligence, and data capabilities, making technology a strategic driver of investment and risk outcomes.
  
  
Risk and Quantitative Analysis (RQA) provides independent oversight of BlackRock’s investment and enterprise risks through quantitative analysis, risk expertise, and evidence-based insights. In partnership with PMG Tech, RQA uses advanced engineering, artificial intelligence, and data platforms to enhance decision-making, strengthen risk management capabilities, and scale innovative solutions across investment, operational, technology, and enterprise risk domains.
  
  
Your role and impact
  
  
As a Research (AI) Engineer, you will partner with RQA, PMG Tech, and business stakeholders to develop data workflows, analytics solutions, and artificial intelligence-assisted capabilities that transform risk and quantitative challenges into actionable insights.
  
  
Embedded within a PMG Tech Pod, a business-focused, cross-functional team, you will collaborate with risk managers, quantitative analysts, artificial intelligence leads, and engineers. You will deliver high-quality data assets, analytical tools, and technology solutions that support risk management and informed decision-making.
  
  
This role requires an understanding of business problems and risk workflows, along with the ability to translate requirements into scalable data solutions. You will use Python, Structured Query Language (SQL), cloud data platforms, workflow orchestration, and visualization tools to develop and operate data-intensive applications. You will also apply data quality practices, continuous integration and continuous delivery processes, and data operations to create reliable, production-grade solutions.
  
  
Your responsibilities
  
  
**Responsibilities**
In every role at BlackRock, you'll be expected to apply sound judgement and critical thinking to solve complex problems, adapt as the business evolves, and combine the curiosity to explore new approaches and technologies with the rigor to challenge the results. The scope of this role also includes the following responsibilities:
  
  

* Build and maintain web-harvesting processes, data pipelines, transformations, and workflows that support research hypotheses and data analysis.
* Develop platform capabilities that source high-quality data and create scalable, reliable, and maintainable data solutions.
* Create research utilities, prototypes, dashboards, and exploratory tools that support insight generation and research workflows.
* Engage with investors, researchers, risk managers, and quantitative analysts to understand their workflows and translate business requirements into effective data solutions.
* Collaborate with core engineering teams to adopt data-extraction and data-management capabilities that accelerate investment research.
* Partner with artificial intelligence leads to source data and build applications that supplement research with artificial intelligence-assisted insights.

Your experience
  
  

* Strong programming capabilities in Python and Structured Query Language, supported by analytical thinking and effective problem-solving skills.
* Demonstrated experience in data engineering, data analytics, or the development of data-intensive applications.
* Knowledge of, or curiosity about, investment research and risk-management workflows or similar domains.
* Proven ability to collaborate effectively across engineering, research, and business teams and translate requirements into scalable technical solutions.
* A bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, data science, data engineering, or a related field.
* Experience with web-harvesting techniques and cloud data platforms such as Snowflake, BigQuery, Google Cloud Platform, and Google Cloud Storage.
* Exposure to artificial intelligence and machine learning tooling, large language model experimentation, retrieval-augmented generation, summarization, and question-and-answer applications. Experience with dashboards, notebooks, lightweight research tools, enterprise-grade container orchestration platforms supporting declarative infrastructure and horizontal scaling, or directed acyclic graph-based workflow orchestration frameworks for data and batch processing is beneficial.

**Our Benefits**
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
  
  
**Our hybrid work model**
BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
  
  
**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided
**guidance**
on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
  
  
**About BlackRock**
At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
  
  
This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
  
  
To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.
  
  
BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

The Senior Data Coordinator will serve as the day-to-day lead for a team of Data Specialists supporting strategic data, technology, and operational initiatives across Lincoln International's Valuations & Opinions Group. This is a hands-on working-lead role. In addition to setting daily priorities, coordinating workloads, coaching early-career team members, and reviewing work quality, this individual will be expected to perform the team’s core data and operational responsibilities as needed, particularly during periods of high volume, complex assignments, or limited team capacity.

Team Leadership & Daily Operations

* Monitor productivity, turnaround times, and workflow bottlenecks; proactively adjust assignments and escalate risks when needed.

* Investigate data exceptions and recurring issues, coordinate resolution, and recommend sustainable process improvements.
* Maintain clear process documentation, operating procedures, and ownership standards to support scalable execution.
* Provide stakeholders with visibility into work status, data-quality issues, and outstanding dependencies.

Product & Technology Support
  
  

* Partner with the Anaplan Technology team on new platform capabilities and enhancements, including requirements clarification, functional testing, issue documentation, and validation of fixes.
* Coordinate user acceptance testing and ensure test scenarios, results, defects, and follow-up actions are documented clearly.
* Support valuation technology platforms by triaging user questions, coordinating issue resolution, and identifying recurring support needs.

* Strong written and verbal English communication skills, with close attention to detail and the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and business stakeholders.

The Resource Planning and Market Assessment (RP&MA) team is responsible for economic analysis of various electric utilities across the US, with a focus on integrating renewables and storage to plan for the clean energy grid of the future. We advise our development team, company leadership, and external clients on optimal resource planning decisions. We contribute to investment decisions in solar, wind, battery storage and hydrogen. We are a data-driven team that believes in continuous improvement and collaboration. This means that we are always looking to develop better tools, processes, and modeling approaches through learning and knowledge sharing. We are looking for someone who enjoys challenges, works well in a collaborative team environment, and revels in seeking answers through data analytics. The Engineer of RP&MA Planning is part of a highly skilled professional team and reports to the Manager of the department.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Perform a broad range of studies and other consulting services to support electric utilities and asset developers to make decisions backed by business and engineering analysis regarding their investments and power supply requirements, such as integrated resource planning, market assessments, valuations, and power supply RFP evaluations.
* Researching about the US power markets (PJM, MISO, NEISO, SPP, CAISO, WECC, SERC, ERCOT, NYISO) and assisting for the production cost & capacity expansion models development which can be utilized for the power price forecasting and congestion & curtailment risk evaluation.
* Perform forecasts and evaluations utilizing power supply planning software such as capacity optimization and hourly dispatch software models.
* Extracting key operational characteristics and market assumptions from internal sources and third-party databases like S&P Global and Velocity Suite.
* Analyze life-cycle costs by developing and incorporating technical assumptions regarding capital costs, operation and maintenance costs, performance estimates, and economic assumptions and forecasts.
* Conduct technical and business-related risk assessments that evaluate impacts associated with rules implemented by regulatory agencies.
* Developing presentation materials that communicate clearly the analyses performed and conveying insights that help developers better serve their utility customers.
* Support multiple ad hoc projects inclusive of those above, completing them in a timely manner.

**Qualifications**

* Master's degree in Power / Energy systems is preferred or bachelor’s in electrical engineering is must.
* Prior experience associated with electric utility operations, planning, or consulting is preferred.
* 2-6 years of experience in production cost modeling, and/or power market economics analysis using industry-standard models such as PROMOD or PLEXOS.
* Knowledge of the US power market is preferred.
* Strong understanding of the economics underlying electric power generation and background in power sector modeling, resource cost-benefit analysis, or related complex system modeling.
* Experience in evaluating complex technical and financial issues independently, developing recommendations, action plans, and managing multiple complex assignments simultaneously.
* Strong attention to detail, facilitation, team building, collaboration, organization and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work methodically and analytically in a quantitative problem-solving environment.
* Strong data management, analysis, and presentation skills (Excel, PowerPoint)

title: Manager - Data Analyst
description:
**Job Summary**
**Job Description – Manager – Data Analytics**
The Manager, Data Analytics in Aviation in Data analytics function will be responsible to optimize airline operations, enhance safety and customer experience, and drive business growth through advanced data analysis and reporting. This role is responsible for developing and implementing analytics strategies, managing data infrastructure, and delivering actionable insights to senior leadership and cross-functional teams. The position requires strong technical expertise and proven leadership skills to foster a data-driven culture and continuous improvement.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Data collection, processing, analysis, and reporting for aviation operations, safety, compliance, and commercial activities.
* Develop and implement analytics strategies and initiatives aligned with organizational goals and KPIs.
* Design, build, and maintain dashboards, reports, and visualization tools to support decision-making and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs).
* Conduct advanced data analysis, predictive modeling, and machine learning to identify trends, risks, and opportunities for operational improvement.
* Present findings, strategic recommendations, and business insights to stakeholders at all levels, ensuring clarity for both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Ensure data integrity, security, and compliance with industry regulations and best practices.

**Required Skills And Experience**

* 3-5 years of experience in data analytics or information technology, preferably in aviation or a related industry.
* Advanced proficiency in ETL processes, and cloud databases.
* Strong programming and data analysis skills (SQL, Python, R, Excel).
* Expertise in data visualization, dashboard design, and KPI tracking.
* Experience with predictive analytics, machine learning, and statistical modeling relevant to aviation operations, will be preferred.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to present complex information clearly and drive consensus.

**Good To Have**

* Advanced proficiency in ETL processes, and cloud databases.
* Strong programming and data analysis skills (SQL, Python, R, Excel).

**Educational Qualifications**
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Business Administration, Data, or a related field.
  
  
**Location:**
Akasa Air Head Office - Mumbai

description:
Full-Time
  
  

* Full-Time
* Anywhere

**Headquarters:**
Remote – MX
  
  
****Who We Are****
Oportun (Nasdaq: OPRT) is a mission-driven financial services company that puts its members’ financial goals within reach. With intelligent borrowing, savings, and budgeting capabilities, Oportun empowers members with the confidence to build a better financial future. Since inception, Oportun has provided more than $22.7 billion in responsible and affordable credit, saved its members more than $2.5 billion in interest and fees, and helped its members set aside an average of more than $1,800 annually.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
As a Sr. Data Engineer at Oportun, you will be a key member of our team, responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining sophisticated software / data platforms in achieving the charter of the engineering group. Your mastery of a technical domain enables you to take up business problems and solve them with a technical solution. With your depth of expertise and leadership abilities, you will actively contribute to architectural decisions, mentor junior engineers, and collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality, scalable software solutions that advance our impact in the market. This is a role where you will have the opportunity to take up responsibility in leading the technology effort – from technical requirements gathering to final successful delivery of the product – for large initiatives (cross-functional and multi-month-long projects).
  
  
**At Oportun, we move fast and we hold each other to a high bar. If you care about doing your best work while actually moving the needle for real people, you’ll fit right in.**
****What You’ll Do****
**Your day-to-day**

* You’ll design and implement scalable, efficient, and reliable data architectures that support business and analytical needs.
* You’ll build and maintain data pipelines, ETL processes, and integration solutions for large volumes of structured and unstructured data.
* You’ll optimize data pipelines, databases, data warehouses, and data lakes for performance, reliability, scalability, and security.
* You’ll partner with stakeholders to understand data requirements, develop domain expertise, and translate business needs into effective data models and solutions.
* You’ll establish and improve data quality standards, validation rules, documentation, and governance practices.
* You’ll implement monitoring and observability practices to identify bottlenecks, improve performance, and strengthen platform reliability.
* You’ll provide technical leadership on architecture, scalability, reliability, monitoring, integration, and extensibility.
* You’ll lead and contribute to code reviews, helping maintain high standards for code quality, performance, and maintainability.
* You’ll mentor junior engineers and support a culture of continuous learning and technical excellence.
* You’ll take ownership of production issues, including troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, escalation, and long-term resolution.
* You’ll independently lead multiple features and projects, coordinate work across engineers, and keep stakeholders informed of progress, risks, and dependencies.
* You’ll help evolve engineering tools, platforms, and practices and encourage adoption of better ways of working.
* You’ll look for practical ways to use AI tools to improve engineering productivity, analysis, documentation, and problem-solving.

****Who You Are****
**The right fit looks like this**
You’re a hands-on data engineer who enjoys solving complex technical problems and building systems that others depend on. You combine strong technical depth with a practical understanding of business needs and know how to turn ambiguous requirements into scalable solutions.
  
  
You take ownership, communicate clearly, and are comfortable leading technical work without relying on formal authority. You enjoy mentoring others and helping teams make stronger technical decisions.
  
  
****What You Bring****
**Skills & experience**
****Required****

* 8+ years of experience in data engineering, with strong experience in data architecture, ETL, and database management.
* Strong programming skills in Python or PySpark, plus experience with Java or Scala.
* Experience building complex end-to-end data pipelines and data integration solutions.
* Strong knowledge of SQL and experience with relational and NoSQL database technologies.
* Experience with big data technologies such as Spark, Kafka, Hadoop, or similar platforms.
* Experience with orchestration and scheduling tools such as Airflow, Databricks, Jenkins, or similar technologies.
* Experience designing and operating scalable, reliable, and secure data systems.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP and associated data services.
* Experience working in Agile environments such as Scrum, Lean, or Kanban.
* Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.
* Experience mentoring junior engineers and contributing to technical leadership within a team.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical teams.

**Nice to Have**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field.
* Databricks experience or certification.
* Experience with AWS Redshift, S3, Azure SQL Data Warehouse, or comparable cloud data services.
* Experience implementing data governance, data quality, or observability frameworks.
* Experience leading cross-functional or multi-month engineering initiatives.
* Experience using AI-assisted engineering tools to improve development, troubleshooting, documentation, or productivity.

**Our AI Mindset**
We build with AI. We lead with judgment.
  
  
**AI isn’t a feature here. It’s how we work.**
We’re excited about what AI makes possible, and we’re looking for people who share that curiosity. You don’t need to be an expert. You need to be
**open to experimenting**
, willing to learn, and able to apply new tools in ways that actually move the needle.
  
  
In this role, you’ll be encouraged to explore AI tools, find practical use cases for your function, and bring ideas for working smarter. We believe the best outcomes come when
**human judgment and AI capability work together.**
**Why Oportun**
****What’s In It For You****
Oportun offers a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to support your physical, financial, and professional well-being. Benefits vary by country of employment.
  
  
****Mexico Benefits:****
Some of the benefits available to eligible employees include:
  
  

* Medical Insurance

title: Ecommerce Manager
description:
**What you'll do**

* Procure stock from vendors — the right product, the right quantity, at the right time, based on demand
* Read demand: what's selling, what's about to, what's dead — and buy accordingly
* Cost and margin awareness — know what we paid, what we sell at, and flag when a buy doesn't make sense
* Maintain accurate stock across the warehouse and all channels
* Chase every vendor on every open order; make sure stock arrives when promised
* Coordinate with accounts so vendors get paid on time and our credit stays clean
* Oversee inwards and outwards — every unit logged, every discrepancy caught
* Reconcile returns and RTO back into stock — restock or write off
* Know the authentication process well enough to route stock correctly and catch problems before dispatch
* Oversee warehousing and shipping operations alongside the warehouse team
* Resolve issues between customer experience and purchasing — you close the loop, whichever team it lands with
* Build reports on demand: stock health, vendor performance, ageing inventory, fulfilment gaps
* Own the KPIs: stock accuracy, vendor on-time rate, fulfilment gap, ageing stock
* Be the person who knows where every unit is and why

**What we need**

* 3–6 years in e-commerce operations, procurement, supply chain or inventory management
* Crazy good with Excel/Google Sheets — VLOOKUP, pivots, large datasets, building trackers from scratch
* Uses AI daily — ChatGPT/Claude for reports, vendor comms, data cleanup, automating repetitive work. This is not optional
* Understanding of sneakers, streetwear and consumer products — sizing (UK/US/EU), colourways, SKUs, release cycles. Strong interest in the category is essential
