title: Team Member Credit Risk Modelling
description:
**Job Summary**
Team Member – Credit Risk Modelling will be responsible for the development, enhancement, implementation, and monitoring of Internal Rating Models and Expected Credit Loss (ECL) models under IFRS 9 / Ind AS 109 frameworks for wholesale portfolios. The role requires strong expertise in credit risk analytics, statistical modelling, regulatory compliance, and stakeholder management within a banking or NBFC environment.
  
  
The candidate should possess 7–8 years of relevant experience in credit risk modelling, with hands-on exposure to Probability of Default (PD), Loss Given Default (LGD), Exposure at Default (EAD), scorecards, internal rating frameworks, and ECL implementation.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
***IFRS 9 / Ind AS 109 ECL Modelling & Implementation***
Support development and maintenance of Expected Credit Loss (ECL) models under IFRS 9 / Ind AS 109 framework.
  
  
Implement staging assessment methodologies, macroeconomic overlays, SICR frameworks, and forward-looking adjustments.
  
  
Monitor model performance and recommend enhancements based on portfolio behavior and economic trends.
  
  
Collaborate with finance, risk, and business teams for smooth implementation of ECL methodologies within the Bank/NBFC systems.
  
  
Support provisioning calculations, management reporting, and audit/regulatory requirements.
  
  
***Data Management & Analytics***
Perform data extraction, cleansing, transformation, and analysis using large datasets from multiple source systems.
  
  
Analyse portfolio trends, credit behaviour, migration patterns, and default characteristics.
  
  
Conduct statistical analysis and model diagnostics using SAS, SQL, Python, R, or similar analytical tools.
  
  
Prepare dashboards and analytical reports for senior management and risk committees.
  
  
***Regulatory & Governance Support***
Ensure compliance with RBI guidelines, Basel framework, IFRS 9 / Ind AS 109 standards, and internal model governance policies.
  
  
Prepare model documentation, methodology papers, validation support documents, and regulatory submissions.
  
  
Support internal audit, model risk management, and regulatory inspection requirements.
  
  
***Stakeholder Management***
Work closely with Risk, Finance, Business, IT, and Model Validation teams for implementation and monitoring activities.
  
  
Present model methodologies, assumptions, and performance outcomes to senior stakeholders and committees.
  
  
Coordinate with cross-functional teams to ensure timely execution of model-related initiatives.
  
  
**Required Skills & Qualifications**
7–8 years of experience in Credit Risk Modelling within a Bank or NBFC.
  
  
Strong understanding of Internal Rating Models, Basel regulations, and IFRS 9 / Ind AS 109 ECL framework.
  
  
Hands-on experience in development/implementation of PD, LGD, EAD, scorecards, or rating models.
  
  
Good understanding of staging assessment, SICR, macroeconomic overlays, and provisioning methodologies.
  
  
Strong analytical and statistical modelling skills.
  
  
Proficiency in SAS, SQL, Python, R, or similar analytical tools.
  
  
Experience in handling large datasets and performing quantitative analysis.
  
  
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  
  
Ability to independently manage projects and interact with senior management.
  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**
MBA / CA / FRM / CFA / Master’s degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Finance, or related quantitative discipline.
  
  
Experience in model validation or regulatory interaction will be an added advantage.
  
  
Exposure to wholesale and retail credit risk portfolios preferred. Role: Assistant Vice President (AVP) – Credit Risk Modelling / IFRS 9 & Internal Rating Models

title: Data Steward, SAPAC (contract)
description:
**With a passion for life**
Join our diverse teams of passionate people and a career that allows you to develop both personally and professionally. At Getinge we exist to make life-saving technology accessible for more people. To make a true difference for our customers – and to save more lives, we need team players, forward thinkers, and game changers.
  
  
Are you looking for an inspiring career? You just found it.
  
  
**Please Note - This is a 24-month contractual position**
**Job Purpose**
The Data Steward is the operational execution lead for commercial data quality across SAPAC, supporting the Data Coordinator and the respective business data owners. The role performs recurring data verification, audits, sampling and correction activities, directly supports designated markets, and produces the reporting required to identify and resolve data quality issues — flagging the underlying cause of each issue so that it can be addressed at source.
  
  
**Output: accurate data, completed corrections under owner approval, managed exceptions, root causes flagged, and timely data quality reporting.**
**Key Responsibilities**
**Recurring verification and reporting (all markets, under the agreed allocation)**

* Post-load price verification after every price load: sample SKUs against the approved price file and flag mismatches for correction (accuracy — distinct from the Data Coordinator's quarterly audit of timeliness)
* All cost-to-price reconciliation: spare parts each price-increase cycle (selling price versus current transfer price per part, flagging negative or below-threshold margins) and completeness checks on capital and consumables reconciliation
* Monthly contract-expiry report per market: contracts expiring within 90 days with no renewal action, and the on-time renewal rate
* Monthly preventive-maintenance completion reporting using the regional tracker template
* Quarterly customer-master-to-pricing audits where applicable: affiliations, hierarchies and classifications that drive pricing conditions
* Quarterly customer master hygiene runs: duplicate detection, entity and payer verification, classification checks
* Quarterly point-of-sale service-contract reconciliation and warranty-versus-installation allocation sampling
* Rotating monthly contract-record completeness sampling by market (expiry, pricing and coverage fields)
* For every recurring exception, record the likely underlying cause (process, ownership, system) alongside the correction, so patterns can be addressed by the Data Coordinator and the business owner

**Direct execution for designated markets (primary executor)**

* Prepare, validate and load price files into SAP for designated markets — reviewed by the Data Coordinator, verified and signed off by the market's Finance Director
* Execute installed base corrections and cleansing, customer master de-duplication and corrections, and contract-record completion, each under business-owner approval
* Capture point-of-sale service contracts into the portfolio and maintain preventive-maintenance tracking where local capacity is limited
* Enter and maintain distributor installation and end-customer data received under the regional collection standard
* Keep the execution log: every change, its approving data owner, and turnaround — reported to the Steering Committee via the Lead

**Installed base (all markets)**

* Execute the corrections arising from the installed base accuracy programme coordinated by the Data Coordinator; maintain the underlying data for the country accuracy score

**Support and enablement**

* Handle hands-on support requests from non-designated markets — price-file validation, IB corrections, de-duplication — logged and reported, with the Steering Committee managing the balance against verification work
* Maintain the single current repository of data SOPs using existing global platforms (GetBasic, GetLibrary, GetQMS, the Finance Manual) rather than local copies
* Produce one-page filter, currency and refresh-cycle guides for the global dashboards and support market training

**Phase 2 (from month 6, gated)**

* Zone and region performance reporting for India, building on work already under way with the Service Director
* Account-history and customer summary requests for sales and service teams, once scoped by the Steering Committee

**Requirements**
**Must have:**

* 4–8 years in data operations, master data maintenance, finance operations, order management or service administration
* Hands-on SAP experience in at least two of: customer master, material master, pricing conditions, equipment and service-contract records — including creating and maintaining records, not only reporting on them
* Advanced Excel (lookups, pivots, reconciliations); Power BI a strong advantage
* Meticulous attention to detail and the persistence to work through large record sets methodically
* The habit of asking why an error occurred — able to recognise when a data problem is really a process or ownership problem, and to say so
* Good written and spoken English; able to explain an exception clearly to a colleague in another country
* Comfortable working across cultures and time zones with people who do not report to you

**Good To Have**

* An analytics background or interest — the role has a Phase 2 pathway into reporting and analytics work
* Medical-device, pharmaceutical or other regulated-industry experience
* Exposure to service-contract or installed-base administration
* Experience with distributor or channel data

**About Us**
With a firm belief that every person and community should have access to the best possible care, Getinge provides hospitals and life science institutions with products and solutions aiming to improve clinical results and optimize workflows. The offering includes products and solutions for intensive care, cardiovascular procedures, operating rooms, sterile reprocessing and life science. Getinge employs over 12,000 people worldwide and the products are sold in more than 135 countries.
  
  
Reasonable accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

title: Manager – Reporting
description:
**About The Role**
We are looking for a finance professional to join our Finance team as Manager – Reporting. This is primarily a financial reporting role built around five core pillars: financial reporting, deep technical knowledge of Ind AS and accounting, driving month-end close, getting statutory and internal audits fully done and closed, and owning inventory accounting. The role also requires a good understanding of how both our online (e-commerce) and offline (retail/store) businesses operate and get reflected in the numbers.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead month-end close activities end-to-end — closing calendar, accruals, provisions, and schedules — ensuring books are closed accurately and within timelines.
* Apply deep, hands-on knowledge of Ind AS and accounting standards to ensure financial statements are technically accurate and fully compliant.
* Get statutory, internal, and tax audits fully done — audit planning, PBC schedules, query resolution, and final closure — with no open items, including handling Big 4 auditors directly.
* Own inventory accounting — stock valuation, GL-to-warehouse/SCM reconciliation, obsolescence and slow-moving provisioning, and costing method reviews — as a core, ongoing responsibility.
* Build a strong working understanding of both the online (e-commerce) and offline (retail/store) sides of the business, and ensure reporting reflects channel-specific nuances (COD, returns, offline retail, store-level P&L, etc.).
* Perform variance analysis (actuals vs. budget vs. prior period) across online and offline channels and provide clear, actionable commentary to leadership.
* Coordinate with cross-functional and channel teams (online category, offline retail/stores, supply chain) to ensure reporting reflects business realities accurately.
* Support budgeting, forecasting, and board/investor reporting requirements as needed.
* Identify opportunities to automate and streamline reporting processes, dashboards, and reconciliations.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* CA with 4–6 years of post-qualification experience, primarily in financial reporting.
* Deep, hands-on knowledge of Ind AS and accounting standards — this is a core requirement, not a nice-to-have.
* Proven, hands-on experience running month-end close and independently getting statutory/internal audits fully closed.
* Experience handling Big 4 auditors, including managing the audit relationship end-to-end.
* Hands-on experience in inventory accounting — valuation, reconciliation, and provisioning — is required, not just preferred.
* Experience in a business with both online and offline (omnichannel) revenue streams — e-commerce, retail, or D2C — is strongly preferred.
* Experience with SAP HANA is preferred.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and reporting/visualization tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
* Exposure to IPO readiness / IPO process will be an added advantage.

**What We Are Looking For**

* A highly motivated finance professional with strong technical accounting and reporting knowledge.
* Detail-oriented with exceptional analytical and organizational skills.
* Ability to independently manage multiple priorities while maintaining accuracy.
* A collaborative team player with a continuous improvement mindset.
* Someone who thrives in a dynamic, high-growth environment and takes ownership of deliverables.

**Key Skills**

* Financial Reporting (Core)
* Inventory Accounting (Core)
* Ind AS & Technical Accounting
* Online & Offline Business Acumen
* Month-End Close Management
* MIS & Management Dashboards
* Statutory Audit Closure
* Reconciliations & Book Closure
* Big 4 Auditor Handling
* Internal Controls & Compliance
* Variance Analysis
* IPO Readiness (Plus)

**About Company**
Founded in 2011, Purplle has emerged as one of India’s premier omnichannel beauty destinations, redefining the way millions shop for beauty. With 1,000+ brands, 60,000+ products, and over 7 million monthly active users, Purplle has built a powerhouse platform that seamlessly blends online and offline experiences.
  
  
Expanding its footprint in 2022, Purplle introduced 6,000+ offline touchpoints and launched 100+ stores, strengthening its presence beyond digital. Beyond hosting third-party brands, Purplle has successfully scaled its own D2C powerhouses—FACES CANADA, Good Vibes, Carmesi, Purplle, and NY Bae—offering trend-driven, high-quality beauty essentials.
  
  
What sets Purplle apart is its technology driven hyper-personalized shopping experience. By curating detailed user personas, enabling virtual makeup trials, and delivering tailored product recommendations based on personality, search intent, and purchase behavior, Purplle ensures a unique, customer-first approach.
  
  
In 2022, Purplle achieved unicorn status, becoming India’s 102nd unicorn, backed by an esteemed group of investors including ADIA, Kedaara, Premji Invest, Sequoia Capital India, JSW Ventures, Goldman Sachs, Verlinvest, Blume Ventures, and Paramark Ventures.

description:

**Publisher Management**

* Manage publisher relationships across APAC, with accountability for quality assurance, onboarding, optimizations, and traffic control.

* Support Client Partners with performance insights, campaign troubleshooting, and strategic recommendations.
* Respond daily to client inquiries, provide campaign status updates, and investigate performance concerns.
* Participate in weekly performance calls with clients; prepare and deliver recommendations and custom strategy outputs as requested.

**Fraud Prevention & Traffic Quality**

* Monitor and identify fraudulent activity, suspicious publishers, and traffic quality risks across the APAC portfolio.
* Review fraud dashboards daily; investigate blocked traffic, rejected installs, and suspicious activity patterns.
* Lead weekly publisher quality reviews and fraud trend analyses; generate and communicate optimization recommendations.

**Finance & Billing Support**

* Support billing reconciliation and validation processes for APAC publisher activity.
* Submit publisher invoices to the finance team on a weekly basis; proactively communicate on pending payments.
* Provide monthly billing validation to all publishers, ensuring accuracy and timely resolution of discrepancies.

**Commercial & Strategic Support**

* Support Client Partners and Management with campaign planning, proposals, inventory forecasting, and commercial requests.
* Respond to rate card requests, provide inventory availability assessments, estimate campaign volume and KPI feasibility.
* Support proposal development; deliver historical benchmark data and market insights to inform client strategy.

* 5+ years in mobile app performance advertising, ad operations, or programmatic media ideally within a DSP, ad network, or publisher-side environment.

* Hands-on experience with mobile measurement platforms (e.g. AppsFlyer, Adjust, Kochava) and DSPs.

* Strong analytical mindset - comfortable working with large datasets and translating data into actionable insights.
* Excellent communication skills; able to present complex performance narratives clearly to clients and senior stakeholders.
* High attention to detail and operational rigour, particularly in billing and reconciliation workflows.
* Commercial acumen - able to support proposal development and provide market benchmarking.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously in a fast-paced, cross-market environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working across multiple APAC markets especially SEA
* Familiarity with CRM tools and publisher onboarding workflows.
* Proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets for reporting; SQL or BI tool experience a plus.
* Fluency in English required; additional APAC language skills advantageous.

* You bring a track record of success in a similar role, with hands-on experience.
* You’re not afraid to challenge the status quo and bring fresh, out-of-the-box ideas to the table.
* You anticipate challenges before they arise and take initiative to find effective solutions.

* Learn from the best: Our state of the art workshops guarantee the latest insights into digital advertising

You will be responsible for leading teams, managing projects, and confirming successful implementation of treasury management systems. Your leadership will inspire others to embrace technology and innovation, enhancing the delivery of financial solutions. This position offers a dynamic environment where you can develop your leadership style, motivate your team, and contribute to the success of our firm by identifying opportunities and driving strategic initiatives.

* Managing client engagements and delivering finance solutions tailored to client needs
* Overseeing financial forecasting and modeling to support strategic decision-making
* Developing and executing financial strategies to enhance operational efficiency
* Analyzing financial statements and reports to identify trends and opportunities
* Coordinating with cross-functional teams to align financial management practices
* Utilizing accounting practices and financial record keeping to maintain accuracy
* Guiding teams in budgetary management and financial transactions
* Promoting the use of innovative financial technologies and methodologies
* Validating compliance with financial regulations and standards

What You Must Have
  
  

* At least a Bachelor's degree
* At least 8+ years of experience
* At least one of the following: Certified Public Accountant
* Oral and written proficiency in English required

What Sets You Apart
  
  

* Demonstrating proficiency in financial modeling and forecasting

title: Senior Customer Experience Manager
description:
**About Kapture CX**

Founded in Bengaluru in 2014,
**Kapture CX**
began as an enterprise customer support software company and has evolved into an
**AI-first Agentic Operating System for Enterprises**
.

Kapture helps enterprises scale AI execution while keeping humans in control. Its
**AgentOS platform**
enables enterprises to deploy, orchestrate, monitor, and optimize AI agents across critical business workflows — including
**customer support, sales, collections, and claims**
.

Kapture’s AI agents can execute workflows end-to-end across
**voice, chat, email, messaging, and social channels**
, with human intervention built in wherever judgment, empathy, or decision-making is required.

Today, Kapture is trusted by
**1,000+ enterprises across 18 countries**
, helping organizations transform customer experience, automate complex workflows, and drive measurable business outcomes through
**AI Agents, Agentic AI, Voice AI, Conversational AI, and intelligent automation**
.

**What is this role all about?**

As a
**Senior Customer Experience Manager**
, you will own the success and growth of a portfolio of enterprise customers on the Kapture platform. You will act as a trusted partner to both business and technical stakeholders, driving CSAT, customer adoption, platform value, advocacy, retention, and long-term account health.

You will combine customer engagement, business understanding, technical expertise, and strong delivery capabilities to help customers achieve their objectives on Kapture. You will also identify opportunities for platform optimization, solutioning, and account growth while partnering closely with internal teams to resolve complex challenges and continuously improve the customer experience.

**Here's a more detailed description of what you will do in this role:**

**Client Engagement**

* Own the overall health and success of a portfolio of enterprise customers, ensuring strong adoption, satisfaction, retention, and long-term value.
* Build trusted relationships with business and technical stakeholders and act as a strategic advisor on customer objectives and platform usage.
* Lead QBRs, health checks, success planning, and key customer conversations to understand evolving needs and drive measurable outcomes.
* Proactively identify customer risks, address concerns, and build mitigation plans to strengthen customer relationships and renewal readiness.

**Project & Delivery Management**

* Drive customer onboarding, implementation, integrations, and adoption initiatives, ensuring effective coordination across customers and internal teams.
* Manage multiple customer engagements and cross-functional dependencies to ensure timely delivery and resolution of customer priorities.
* Partner with Product, Engineering, Sales, and Support teams to drive customer initiatives and ensure effective execution.

**Business Acumen**

* Understand customer business objectives and translate them into opportunities to improve platform adoption, utilization, and ROI.
* Analyze customer health, usage, feedback, and engagement trends to identify risks, improvement opportunities, and areas for growth.
* Identify expansion opportunities and partner with Customer Success and Sales teams to support account growth and long-term customer value.
* Capture customer feedback and translate recurring needs and business challenges into actionable inputs for relevant internal teams.

**Technical Expertise**

* Understand the customer's technical architecture and integration setup well enough to have credible conversations with technical stakeholders.
* Maintain/contribute to troubleshooting guides, implementation docs, and RCAs. Owning the documentation of all projects involved in.
* Partner with Engineering/SRE to drive resolution of complex technical escalations, translating root cause into business impact and next steps for the customer.
* Own complex technical escalations by analyzing logs, debugging issues, andPartner with Engineering and Product teams to diagnose issues, drive resolution, and ensure effective communication with customers.

**Solutioning & AI**

* Recommend platform configurations, workflows, integrations, and best practices that address customer requirements and improve business outcomes.
* Identify opportunities to leverage Kapture's automation and AI capabilities to improve customer experience, adoption, and operational efficiency.
* Work with Product and technical teams to translate customer requirements into scalable solutions and product improvements.
* Identify recurring customer challenges and contribute to scalable solutions rather than addressing issues individually.

**People Management**

* Mentor and support Customer Experience team members by sharing customer management, technical troubleshooting, and platform best practices.
* Support the team in managing complex customer situations and contribute to building stronger customer-facing capabilities.

**What does success look like in this role?**

Success in this role means
**customers consistently realize measurable value from Kapture's platform, demonstrate strong adoption and engagement, and maintain healthy long-term relationships with Kapture**
.

You build trusted relationships across business and technical stakeholders, proactively resolve customer risks, deliver customer initiatives effectively, and use technical and business insights to improve customer outcomes. You also contribute to retention, account growth, and scalable solutions that improve the overall customer experience.

**What would make you a good fit for this role?**

**Basic Requirements**

* You have
  **5–7 years of experience**
  in fast paced, complex, growth environments in Customer Success, Customer Experience, Technical Account Management, Solution Consulting, or Enterprise SaaS.
* You have experience managing
  **enterprise customers across business and technical stakeholders**
  .
* You have a strong understanding of
  **customer lifecycle management, onboarding, adoption, retention, and stakeholder management**
  .
* You have experience working with
  **APIs, integrations, troubleshooting, and enterprise SaaS implementations**
  .
* You have experience managing multiple Enterprise SaaS customer engagements in the geography and working cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Sales, and Support teams.
* You have strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to balance customer, business, and technical priorities.

**You will have an advantage if you:**

* Have exposure to
  **AI-powered CX, conversational AI, chatbots, or automation platforms**
  .
* Have experience with
  **CRM platforms such as Salesforce or HubSpot**
  .
* Have experience creating
  **customer playbooks, implementation guides,dashboards, campaign management, troubleshooting documentation, and RCAs**
  .
* Have experience identifying recurring customer issues and driving
  **preventive or scalable solutions**
  .
* Have experience identifying and supporting
  **account expansion opportunities**
  .
* Have experience with
  **dashboarding**
  , APIs, integration frameworks, SQL/NoSQL databases or data flows, tools such as Kafka, Grafana, or similar monitoring platforms.

title: Programmatic Manager
description:
Ethinos Digital Marketing Agency is looking for a Manager – Programmatic Advertising to lead the planning, execution, and optimization of programmatic campaigns across multiple platforms. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in media planning, campaign strategy, performance analysis, and client communication, along with the ability to lead a team and drive campaign performance in line with business objectives.
  
  
Location: Andheri East, Mumbai
  
  
Work Mode: Work-From-Office | Mon to Fri
  
  
Timings: 10 AM to 7 PM
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Media Planning & Strategy: Develop comprehensive media plans aligned with client objectives, target audiences, budgets, and campaign KPIs.
* Campaign Management: Plan, execute, and manage programmatic campaigns across platforms such as Google Ads, Display & Video 360 (DV360), Meta Ads, and other relevant advertising platforms.
* Team Leadership: Lead and mentor team members, allocate tasks, monitor deliverables, and ensure timely execution of campaigns.
* Campaign Optimization: Monitor campaign performance and optimize budgets, bids, audience targeting, placements, and creatives to improve campaign efficiency and ROI.
* Client Communication: Act as a key point of contact for clients, understand their business requirements, present media plans and performance reports, and provide strategic recommendations.
* Performance Reporting: Analyze campaign data, prepare reports, identify trends, and translate insights into actionable optimization strategies.
* Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with client servicing, creative, analytics, and other internal teams to ensure campaign alignment and smooth execution.
* Budget & KPI Management: Oversee campaign budgets, pacing, forecasts, and delivery against agreed performance metrics.
* Industry Knowledge: Stay updated on programmatic advertising trends, platform developments, audience targeting capabilities, and emerging technologies.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Advertising, Business, or a related field.
* Minimum 4 years of experience in programmatic advertising, digital media, or paid media campaign management.
* Hands-on experience with Google Ads, Display & Video 360 (DV360), Meta Ads, and other relevant programmatic platforms.
* Strong understanding of media planning, audience segmentation, bidding strategies, campaign optimization, and performance measurement.
* Proven ability to lead a team, manage multiple campaigns, and drive timely execution.
* Excellent client-facing communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with proficiency in campaign reporting and performance analysis.
* Ability to manage budgets, prioritize tasks, and work effectively in a fast-paced agency environment.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience managing multiple client accounts in a digital marketing agency.
* Ability to develop data-driven media strategies and present recommendations to clients.
* Experience mentoring team members and ensuring quality control across campaign deliverables.

title: SAP SF Compensation and variable pay
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION- SAP Compensation, Variable Pay & Benefits Lead**
**NOTE- Immediate to 15 Days Notice Period Candidates will be considered.**
**Position Overview**
Oversee and execute the end-to-end Compensation, Variable Pay, and Employee Benefits architecture. Ensure competitive, compliant, and data-driven pay structures while driving operational accuracy, cost efficiency, and strong alignment with business performance.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Compensation Management
* Lead annual increment, merit, promotion, and market-adjustment cycles.
* Perform salary benchmarking and role evaluations using market data (e.g., Mercer, Aon).
* Manage salary bands, pay structures, and internal pay equity audits.
* Provide data-backed compensation proposals for new hires, promotions, and retention cases.
* Variable Pay & Incentives
* Design, administer, and govern short-term incentive, bonus, and sales pay plans.
* Execute monthly, quarterly, and annual variable pay calculations, audits, and payouts.
* Partner with Finance and Business Unit leaders to define, track, and validate target KPIs.
* Benefits Administration & Vendor Management
* Manage health insurance, leaves, wellness initiatives, and retirement benefits.
* Lead vendor management, SLA tracking, broker negotiations, and program renewals.
* Resolve escalated employee queries and ensure clear benefit policy communications.
* Governance & Statutory Compliance
* Maintain C&B policy compliance with statutory regulations (PF, Gratuity, ESIC, LWF, Minimum Wages).
* Maintain complete documentation and process controls for internal and external audit readiness.
* Standardize and automate Total Rewards workflows.
* Analytics, Modeling & Budgeting
* Build executive dashboards tracking C&B cost impacts, headcount metrics, and payout trends.
* Perform financial modeling and scenario planning to support strategic decision-making.
* Assist in annual budgeting and cost forecasting for pay, incentives, and benefits.
* Stakeholder Engagement
* Act as the C&B Subject Matter Expert (SME) for HRBPs, Talent Acquisition, Finance, and Business Leaders.
* Drive communication and rollout plans for annual rewards, incentive cycles, and policy updates.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Execution: 100% timeliness and zero-error accuracy in increment and variable pay cycles.
* Compliance: 100% statutory compliance and clean audit reports.
* Competitiveness: Alignment of salary bands with target market percentiles.
* Cost Efficiency: Effective benefit program renewals within budget parameters.

**Requirements & ProfileExperience & Education**

* Experience: 7–12 years of core experience in Compensation & Benefits or Total Rewards in mid-to-large enterprise environments.
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in HR, Business, or Finance. MBA/PGDM preferred.

**Key Skills**

* Technical: Deep C&B domain expertise, Indian C&B statutory rules, Mercer/Aon benchmarking tools, advanced Excel modeling, and HRIS/payroll platforms.
* Competencies: Analytical problem-solving, high data accuracy and confidentiality, strong execution discipline, and clear stakeholder communication.

title: StockX: Category Manager – Sneakers
description:
Full-Time
  
  

* Full-Time
* Anywhere
* Posted 1 day ago

**Headquarters:**
Remote, USA
  
  
**Help empower our global customers to connect to culture through their passions.**
****Why You’ll Love This Role:****
StockX is the world’s leading marketplace for current culture, built at the intersection of commerce, community, and credibility. Sneakers are foundational to StockX — not just as a category, but as a culture, an economy, and a global community.
  
  
We are expanding how sneaker culture shows up on StockX through creator-driven, community-oriented commerce experiences that blend storytelling, expertise, and transaction. To do this well, we need category leaders who don’t just understand the sneaker market — they live inside it.
  
  
The
**Sneakers Category Manager**
is the single-threaded owner of sneaker category growth within a new, high-priority commerce initiative. This person is the in-house expert on sneaker culture, people, economics, and moments — and is responsible for translating that expertise into supply growth, engagement, and GMV.
  
  
**You Will Act As:**

* The internal authority on the primary and secondary sneaker ecosystem
* The external face of StockX to sneaker sellers, creators, and community leaders
* The architect of the sneaker go-to-market / growth playbook for this new initiative

This role blends deep cultural fluency, strategic ownership, and hands-on execution. Early on, you will own everything related to sneakers within this initiative. As the category scales, you will grow into a leader overseeing a broader sneaker portfolio and team.
  
  
****What You’ll Do:****
**Own the Sneakers Category End-to-End**

* Define and execute the growth strategy for sneakers within the platform
* Own category-level performance across supply, engagement, and revenue
* Establish quarterly goals, leading indicators, and operating rhythms

**Be the Market & Culture Expert**

* Maintain deep, current knowledge of sneaker culture, including:

+ Key sellers, creators, collectors, and resellers
+ Sub-segments (hype vs. GRs, vintage, performance, regional markets, etc.)
+ Drops, releases, brand dynamics, and cultural moments
+ Pricing dynamics, liquidity, and resale economics

* Serve as the internal voice of the sneaker community, informing product, marketing, and platform decisions

**Supply & Creator Acquisition**

* Build and own a pipeline of high-impact sneaker sellers, shops, influencers, and creators
* Personally recruit and onboard flagship sellers who set the tone for the platform
* Develop seller strategies that balance credibility, storytelling, and commerce

**Commerce Strategy & Category Moments**

* Identify and orchestrate sneaker-specific moments, campaigns, and formats that drive engagement and conversion
* Partner with Category Marketing to design culturally authentic activations
* Experiment with new approaches and iterate quickly based on performance and feedback

**Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Work closely with Account & Partnerships Managers to scale seller acquisition and support
* Collaborate with Product and Engineering to shape features and tools that matter to sneaker sellers and buyers
* Provide clear, actionable insights from the market to influence roadmap prioritization

**Build the Playbook**

* Document learnings, frameworks, and best practices that can be reused across future categories
* Help define what “great” looks like for category ownership at StockX
* Support hiring and onboarding as the sneaker category team grows

****About You:****

* Deeply embedded in sneaker culture — you know the people, platforms, trends, and economics, and you’re already plugged into the ecosystem
* 5+ years of experience in category management, partnerships, marketplace growth, brand, or operator roles in sneakers, streetwear, or adjacent ecosystems
* Comfortable owning outcomes, not just strategy — you execute, iterate, and adapt
* Strong relationship builder with credibility among sellers, creators, and community members
* Data-literate and commercially minded — you understand pricing, margins, liquidity, and incentives
* Entrepreneurial, scrappy, and energized by building something from the ground up

****Nice To Have:****

* Existing network of sneaker resellers, store owners, creators, or influencers
* Experience buying and selling sneakers or operating within resale marketplaces
* Familiarity with content-driven commerce, creator platforms, or enthusiast communities
* Experience working cross-functionally with product and engineering teams

****Why This Role Matters:****
Sneakers will define the early perception and success of this new commerce initiative at StockX. This role sets:
  
  

* The cultural bar for the platform
* The go-to-market & growth blueprint for future categories
* The credibility of StockX with the sneaker community

You will have outsized influence on how StockX expands its leadership from marketplace into deeper cultural engagement.

****About StockX****
StockX is proud to be a Detroit-based technology leader focused on the large and growing online market for sneakers, apparel, accessories, electronics, collectibles, trading cards, and more. StockX’s powerful platform connects buyers and sellers of high-demand consumer goods from around the world using dynamic pricing mechanics. This approach affords access and market visibility powered by real-time data that empowers buyers and sellers to determine and transact based on market value. The StockX platform features hundreds of brands across verticals including Jordan Brand, adidas, Nike, Supreme, BAPE, Off-White, Louis Vuitton, Gucci; collectibles from brands including LEGO, KAWS, Bearbrick, and Pop Mart; and electronics from industry-leading manufacturers Sony, Microsoft, Meta, and Apple. Launched in 2016, StockX employs 1,000 people across offices and verification centers around the world. Learn more at www.stockx.com.

title: D&T Quality Engineer I
description:
**Company Overview**
We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.
  
  
**Overview**
As a Digital & Technology Quality Engineer , you will help ensure the quality and reliability of data solutions that power trusted business insights. You will perform data and business intelligence testing, create and execute test cases, validate data, and partner with developers, business analysts, and stakeholders to resolve defects. Reporting to the Manager – Quality Engineering, this is a great opportunity to grow your data quality assurance skills in a collaborative, fast-paced Digital and Technology environment.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**

* Perform data testing and business intelligence testing, applying knowledge of data warehouse (BigQuery on GCP) concepts to validate data solutions.
* Create, execute, and maintain test cases and test data, and document testing activities, results, and evidence.
* Write and execute SQL queries to validate, reconcile, and compare data across source systems and targets.
* Perform data validation and root-cause analysis to identify, investigate, and help resolve data quality issues.
* Manage defects and collaborate with developers and business analysts to enable efficient, high-quality testing.
* Support delivery and governance by ensuring required sign-offs on deliverables and adherence to established quality processes.
* Generate accurate metrics and productivity reports on time, providing clear insight into testing performance.
* Deliver high-quality work that meets or surpasses stakeholder expectations while communicating clearly and responsively.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Education : Full-time graduation from an accredited university in computer science or related field.
* Experience : 3 to 5 years of experience in data testing or software quality assurance.
* Strong troubleshooting and root-cause analysis abilities.
* Strong understanding of the software development life cycle and multiple software engineering and testing methodologies.
* Proficiency in SQL, database testing, and business intelligence testing.
* Experience creating test cases and testing documentation from requirements or specifications, including projects with limited development documentation.
* Familiarity with issue-tracking tools such as Jira or Azure DevOps.
* Well-developed communication and interpersonal skills, attention to detail, and the ability to complete tasks accurately.
* Self-motivated and detail-oriented, with a continuous-improvement mindset and the ability to perform well in a fast-paced, changing environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science and related fields.
* Advanced capability in agile testing, test management, and database testing, including SQL.
* Working knowledge of extract-transform-load (ETL) processes, test design techniques, and test planning.
* Foundational knowledge of application programming interface testing.
* ISTQB certification.
* Experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and related services such as BigQuery or Cloud Functions.
* Knowledge of big data concepts, data warehouse structures, extract-transform-load processes, and data architecture principles.
* Basic knowledge of Python programing.
* Exposure to usage of GenAI tools in testing
* Familiarity with continuous integration and continuous delivery pipelines and DevOps methodologies.
* Experience working in an offshoring environment and demonstrated alignment with General Mills values.

**ELIGIBILITY**
Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

title: Amazon Specialist
description:
**Roles & Responsibilities:**

title: Data Analyst-I
description:
Etraveli Group is a leading global flight technology provider, specializing in flight sales and offering flight content delivery and fintech products. We are here to solve complexity, by connecting millions of flights and travelers across the globe, from search and selection to trip and beyond.
  
  
We partner with major global platforms such as Booking.com, Google Flights, Skyscanner, and Kayak, providing seamless flight booking and related services. Our B2B portfolio includes Precision, our specialist in travel fintech; Tripstack, our B2B Flights as a Service Provider and world leader in virtual interlining, serving as the gateway to Etraveli Group’s flight content and fulfillment services; Wenrix, the AI Infrastructure for profitable growth in air; and Flygresor.se, Sweden’s leading flight comparison site. We also operate our own online travel agency brands including Gotogate, Mytrip, and Flightnetwork.
  
  
Every day we strive to make the world smaller for our customers and bigger for our people. Our diverse team of more than 3200 passionate professionals is what makes us the industry’s tech wonder and the best in the world at what we do.
  
  
Major offices in Sweden (HQ), Greece, India, Canada, Israel, Poland, UK, and Uruguay.
  
  
The Role
  
  
The Customer Services department within ETG is dedicated to continuously elevating the customer experience through automation, process optimization, and quality governance.
  
  
We are seeking an inquisitive, detail-oriented Data Analyst to join our team in Mumbai. In this role, you will play a pivotal part in delivering actionable insights and robust reporting solutions to global stakeholders across the Customer Services organization, empowering data-driven decision-making.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Performance Reporting: Monitor, analyse, and report on core Customer Service KPIs and operational performance metrics across daily, weekly, and monthly intervals.
* Dashboard Development: Design, build, and maintain interactive productivity dashboards and visual analytics for cross-functional teams using BI tools (Qlik Sense).
* Data Management & Extraction: Write efficient SQL queries to extract, transform, and model complex, multidimensional datasets from relational databases to fulfil ad-hoc and routine business requests.
* Stakeholder Engagement: Collaborate directly with global business leads to understand data requirements, manage inbound reporting queues, and effectively communicate insights to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Continuous Improvement: Identify operational trends, inefficiencies, and data quality gaps to assist leadership in driving automation and workflow enhancements.

**Requirements**

* Experience: 3–5 years of hands-on experience in a Data Analysis, Business Intelligence, or Operational Reporting role (BPO / Contact Centre experience is highly advantageous).
* SQL Proficiency: Strong experience writing complex SQL queries for data extraction, aggregation, and analysis.
* BI Tools: Hands-on experience developing reports and dashboards in Qlik Sense / QlikView, Power BI, Tableau or Looker Studio (preferred).
* Advanced Spreadsheet Skills: Proficient in Excel and Google Sheets, including advanced formulas (INDEX/MATCH, XLOOKUP, nested logic), pivot tables, and data modelling.
* Data Handling: Proven ability to clean, manipulate, and draw insights from large, complex, and unaggregated datasets.

Key Competencies & Behavioural Traits
  
  

* Self-Driven & Proactive: Strong sense of ownership with a desire to impact organizational success.
* Agility: Comfortable working in a fast-paced, evolving environment with shifting business priorities.
* Good Communication: Able to articulate technical data findings clearly to global stakeholders at varying leadership levels.

title: MIS Strategy Head
description:

The role will be responsible for developing robust MIS frameworks, executive dashboards and KPI systems, ensuring data accuracy and reporting governance, and translating business information into actionable insights for senior management. * Work closely with Sales, Sourcing, Closing, Marketing, Finance, CRM and Projects teams to understand business requirements and reporting needs.
* Ensure accountability for accurate data submissions and timely updates across functions.
* Prepare management review presentations, variance analyses and action trackers.
* Align reporting across departments to provide leadership with a consistent view of business performance.

* Document report logic, data sources, KPI definitions and standard operating procedures.
* Improve reporting turnaround time, analytical capabilities and adoption of reporting tools across the organisation.

* Lead and develop the MIS and analytics team, setting priorities, quality standards and performance expectations.
* Review and validate team output before circulating reports to senior management.
* Build analytical capabilities and promote fact-based decision-making across functions.

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Statistics, Economics, Information Systems or a related field; MBA or postgraduate qualification preferred.
* 12+ years of experience in MIS, business analytics, strategy, performance reporting or business intelligence.
* Experience in real estate or with a real estate developer preferred.
* Proven experience in designing management dashboards, KPI frameworks and executive reporting across multiple functions or projects.
* Strong proficiency in MS Excel and business intelligence tools such as Power BI.
* Familiarity with CRM, ERP and financial reporting systems.
* Experience leading teams, automating reporting processes and working with senior management.

title: Demand Planning Manager
description:
**Job Description**
Are you ready to join a high-performing Operations team and take ownership of demand decisions that shape business performance, influence senior colleagues, and ensure our products are available when it matters most?
  
  
Bring your planning and forecasting skills to be part of India’s growth journey – Use your excellent stakeholder skills to assure an optimal build up of India’s business plans, that are grounded in market realities while clearly articulating BU-specific assumptions across the planning horizon consolidating key inputs from sales and marketing to create plans.
  
  
*No relocation assistance is offered for this position*
**Core Responsibilities**

  
* Own the end-to-end Demand Plan for a part of the Business Unit, covering both Consumer Sales (CS – sales to consumers, based on retail sell-out data) and Selling-In (SI – sales to retail partners) at theme, customer group, and SKU level.
* Shape BU-level CS and SI decisions by balancing commercial ambitions with supply chain constraints, inventory health, and financial implications
* Define, challenge, and align demand assumptions with Sales and Brand Management, ensuring plans reflect commercial activities, product launches, and promotional strategies.
* Work with the sales and marketing teams to gain an understanding of past performance and reasons for deviations from expectations, as well as the drivers behind Forecasting KPIs.
* Work with the Business Intelligence team to understand drivers impacting consumer sales, including any changes to the category or country macroeconomic environment.
* Monitor and steer forecast performance (topline, theme, and item level), proactively identifying risks and adjusting plans to ensure strong in-stock levels while minimizing excess inventory and waste.
* Represent Demand Planning in key cross-functional forums, shaping plans for critical campaigns and driving alignment on priorities and trade-offs.
* Manage the Gap to Target process with Sales and Marketing to identify opportunities to close gaps in Consumer Sales and Retail Inventory
* Build and continuously improve demand planning capabilities, including tools, analytics, and ways of working, driving digitalization, process and collaboration excellence.
* Understanding of different channels & their behaviour which support better planning & forecasting.

**Play your part in our team succeeding**
BU India is one of the fastest growing BUs in the LEGO group and is quite strategic to the growth of the APAC maket. The team provides the operational backbone for sales and marketing functions enabling business continuity covering planning, inventory, customer service and logistics.
  
  
As Demand Planning Manager, you will shape the BU demand plan, aligning Sales and Marketing into one clear, data-driven view that drives critical commercial and supply chain decisions. Your work ensures the business commits to the right volumes at the right time
  
  
**Do you have what it takes?**

  
* Bachelor’s Degree with MBA in Operations or Supply chain management from a Tier 1 institute is preferred
* Proven experience of 5 years or above owning and delivering demand planning, supply planning, or advanced analytics within a multinational FMCG, retail, or consumer goods organization.
* Strong understanding of S&OP processes and demand drivers, with the ability to translate Consumer Sales (CS), Selling-In (SI), and inventory dynamics into clear business decisions and outcomes.
* Ability to navigate ambiguity and complexity, prioritize effectively, and take accountability for sound business decisions in fast-paced and volatile environments.
* Strong collaborator management and executive presence; acts as a decisive sparring partner to Sales and Marketing, confidently influencing and constructively challenging decisions.
* Strong analytical and strategic capability; able to synthesize complex datasets, challenge assumptions, and own the development of robust, actionable demand plans.

**NICE TO HAVE**

  
* Result Orientation There is a high expectation to deliver an accurate and insight-based forecast built off an understanding of past performance and the ability to explain its impact on future planning assumptions.
* Collaboration To be effective in this role, you will need to proactively build a culture of collaboration with the Sales, Marketing and Business Intelligence teams where changes in planning assumptions are stress-tested through constructive discussions.
* Functional Expertise You will need to have a strong understanding of Sales and Operations Planning and Forecasting, as well as best practices to be able to drive the continuous improvement within the processes.
* Power BI Passion for data and digital tools advanced proficiency in Excel (including VBA and Power Query) and Power BI, with a focus on driving automation and enabling better decision-making.

You will partner with plants and cross-functional teams across the United States to identify risks, develop practical solutions, and improve material availability, inventory, cost, and service. This role offers the opportunity to influence a complex global supply network while working as an individual contributor in a collaborative virtual team. This role requires you to operate in 1.30 pm to 10.30 pm shift.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**

* Support OU-level performance improvement across OTD, DOS, VN, NPW, utilization, MDRs, lead-time compliance, and related supply-chain metrics.
* Partner with Consultant and ESC stakeholders and lead ESC plant calls from the ISA front to drive improvement in OTD, DOS, LE, LTL, and related metrics.
* Support TLC and critical analysis including warehouse space, inventory projection with freight cost, safety stock, min–max levels, load efficiency, and less-than-truckload (LTL) optimization, to identify cost and service improvement opportunities.
* Support disruption recovery and escalation management by expediting materials, coordinating alternate sources of supply and transportation, reviewing purchase order commitments, and tracking recovery actions through closure. Identify recurring MDR issues, recommend practical corrective actions, and support sustainable solutions to improve supply continuity and reduce repeat disruptions.
* Coach and support new team members through buddying, knowledge sharing, and process guidance as needed.
* Assist with escalation tracking, process-improvement initiatives, and the application of AI-enabled tools and insights to improve decision-making, generate cost improvement opportunities, and deliver measurable cost avoidance.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Full-time graduation from an accredited university.
* At least 6 years of related experience in supply chain, materials management, planning, procurement, logistics, or a comparable analytical function.
* Experience working with supply chain, inventory management, replenishment, and material-availability concepts.
* Experience using SAP Materials Management or a comparable enterprise resource-planning system.
* Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including data manipulation, pivot tables, charts, and data analysis.
* Ability to gather, visualize, analyze, and translate data into actionable business recommendations.
* Strong communication, presentation, collaboration, prioritization, and time-management skills.
* Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities under tight deadlines, navigate ambiguity, and influence stakeholders toward solutions.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master’s degree in operations, Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, Analytics, or a related field.
* Professional certification such as APICS Certified Supply Chain Professional or Six Sigma.
* Experience supporting multiple manufacturing plants or a complex, global supply network.
* Experience with material-disruption recovery, supply-risk assessment, network design, landed-cost analysis, or inventory optimization.
* Experience developing or manipulating SAP reports and creating advanced Excel analyses, including macros.
* Demonstrated continuous-improvement mindset and experience coaching or developing junior team members.

**ELIGIBILITY**
Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

title: Manager, Business Process Transformation
description:
**Job Description**
At EisnerAmper, we look for individuals who welcome new ideas, encourage innovation, and are eager to make an impact. Whether you’re starting out in your career or taking your next step as a seasoned professional, the EisnerAmper experience is one-of-a-kind. You can design a career you’ll love from top to bottom – we give you the tools you need to succeed and the autonomy to reach your goals.
  
  
The Business Process Improvement Analyst sits within the Enterprise Transformation Office. This role works under the direction of the Director of Process Transformation to engage with Service Lines or other functions across the business to diagnose root causes of pain points, understand and map current-state processes, define performance metrics and translate findings into actionable improvement recommendations including; process redesign, automation AI-enabled solutions, and draft relevant requirements.
  
  
Engagements span the full range from targeted improvements within a single business team to larger, enterprise-wide initiatives. The analyst can engage across the firm, including Tax, Assurance, Advisory and Outsourced Services Service Lines, as well as other operational teams, wherever process improvement work is needed.
  
  
At EisnerAmper, we look for individuals who welcome new ideas, encourage innovation, and are eager to make an impact. Whether you’re starting out in your career or taking your next step as a seasoned professional, the EisnerAmper experience is one-of-a-kind. You can design a career you’ll love from top to bottom – we give you the tools you need to succeed and the autonomy to reach your goals.
  
  
**What it Means to Work for EisnerAmper:**

* You will get to be part of one of the largest and fastest growing accounting and advisory firms in the industry
* You will have the flexibility to manage your days in support of our commitment to work/life balance
* You will join a culture that has received multiple top “Places to Work” awards
* We believe that great work is accomplished when cultures, ideas and experiences come together to create innovative solutions
* We understand that embracing our differences is what unites us as a team and strengthens our foundation
* Showing up authentically is how we, both as professionals and a Firm, find inspiration to do our best work

**Key Responsibilities**

* Support ETO business analysts & engage as directed with business unit stakeholders to identify pain points, inefficiencies and improvement opportunities through interviews, workshops, and process observation.
* Map & analyze current-state ("as-is") processes using ETO standard notation (swim lanes, SIPOC, value stream) and validate with process owners.
* Document data flows and system touchpoints as part of process mapping, particularly where they inform automation, integration, or AI-enabled recommendations.
* Design and support the implementation of process performance metrics and KPIs (leading and lagging indicators) to baseline performance and track the impact of improvements.
* Develop future-state ("to-be") process recommendations, including process redesign, automation, and AI/technology-enabled solutions.
* Translate discovery sessions and stakeholder input into structured requirements, process documentation, and decision-ready materials for the Director and business sponsors.
* Understand what’s needed to develop credible business cases for recommended changes, including effort, cost, and expected benefits, and work to gather relevant data/information as part of the initiative documentation.
* Contribute reusable process artifacts (templates, capability maps, documentation standards) to the Process Center of Excellence to promote consistency across projects and across the firm.
* Act as a bridge between business and technology teams by clearly articulating business requirements and validating that proposed solutions address the root problem.
* Track and report on the status of improvement initiatives, flagging risks and dependencies to the Director.
* Promote a continuous improvement mindset within partner business units.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Process maps and requirements are accurate, validated by stakeholders, and reused without rework.
* KPIs/metrics are in place and actively tracked within [60–90] days of engagement start.
* Improvement recommendations are adopted by business sponsors and show measurable impact against baseline.
* Documentation meets Process COE standards and is contributed back to the shared library.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Operations, Information Systems, or related field.
* 8-12 years of experience in business process analysis, operations, consulting, or transformation roles, with demonstrated ownership of process work (not just support/documentation).
* Proven ability in writing business, data, & technical requirements and the development of wireframes to clearly articulate solutions
* Proven proficiency in process mapping (current- and future-state) - able to independently run mapping sessions and produce validated, accurate artifacts with minimal oversight.
* Confident engaging business unit stakeholders directly - able to ask the right questions, surface real pain points, and read between the lines of what's said versus what's actually broken.
* Demonstrated ability to recognize and shape improvement opportunities - not just document "as-is" state, but connect root causes to practical recommendations (process, tech, automation, or AI).
* Experience defining and standing up KPIs/metrics; familiarity with Lean/Six Sigma, BPMN, or similar frameworks preferred.
* Strong analytical skills - comfortable working with process and operational data to identify root causes and quantify impact.
* Ability to manage time across multiple projects and escalate when help is required.
* Working knowledge of process/workflow tools (e.g., Visio, Miro) and data/reporting tools (e.g., Excel, Power BI, or similar).
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Exposure to automation or AI-enabled process solutions (RPA, GenAI use cases, workflow tools).
* Process improvement certification (Lean Six Sigma Green/Black Belt, PMP, or equivalent).
* Experience in a shared services or enterprise transformation function.

**About EisnerAmper:**
EisnerAmper is one of the largest accounting, tax and business advisory firms in the U.S., with more than 5000 employees and over 450 partners across the country. We combine responsiveness with a long-range perspective; to help clients meet the pressing issues they face today, and position them for success tomorrow. Our clients are enterprises as diverse as sophisticated financial institutions and start-ups, global public firms and middle-market companies, as well as high net worth individuals, family offices, not-for-profit organizations, and entrepreneurial ventures across a variety of industries.
  
  
We are also engaged by the attorneys, financial professionals, bankers and investors who serve these clients. Our reach extends globally, with offices in the United Kingdom, Israel, India, the Cayman Islands, Singapore, and Ireland.
  
  
**About EisnerAmper India:**
EisnerAmper (India) Consultants Pvt. Ltd. (“EA India”) is a subsidiary of Eisner Advisory Group LLC (“EA Group”), which practices in an alternative practice structure with EisnerAmper LLP. EA India employees provide advisory services to clients of EA Group and audit services to clients of Eisner Amper LLP and comply with the professional standards applicable to each of EA India, EA Group and EisnerAmper LLP. EA India employees also provide operational services to EA Group and EisnerAmper LLP. The policies and procedures of EA India, including obligations of confidentiality and non-disclosure, apply to all services provided by EA India employees. All applicants are applying to positions for employment with EA India, and not EA Group or EisnerAmper LLP.
  
  
EA India opened its first office in Mumbai in 2007. Over the years, our India footprint has expanded to include offices in Bangalore, Hyderabad, and Ahmedabad. We are a culturally diverse pool of over 1000 professionals supporting our global clientele from a range of startups to Fortune 500 entities.
  
  
Should you need any accommodations to complete this application please email: indiata@eisneramper.com
  
  
Preferred Location:
  
  
Mumbai

Our Professional Services organization works together with our internal customers to address business needs of AWS customers using AI.

title: Trade Surveillance Analyst
description:
Our India Compliance team works closely with our Trading and Technology teams to manage the regulatory risks of our trading activities in India. As a Surveillance Analyst at IMC, you will assist with our day-to-day surveillance operations, monitoring and review of Internal and exchange generated alerts. Your role will cover many different aspects of IMC’s compliance program, requiring you to work with people across all areas of the business. This role will report into Head of Compliance- India.
  
  
**Your Core Responsibilities**

* Investigating and resolving trade surveillance alerts across market abuse typologies including spoofing, layering, ramping, marking the close, wash trading, and insider trading indicators.
* Monitor and investigate market surveillance alerts and electronic communications to identify potential market abuse risks and provide recommendations to enhance pre- and post-trade controls (and our surveillance platforms).
* Managing alert queues, ensuring timely investigation, escalation to Compliance Officer and closure of alerts
* Regular review of parameters and calibrating surveillance alert parameters as new markets, strategies, and products come online
* Record keeping and preparing reports for internal approvals and regulatory submissions.
* Experience in designing or calibrating surveillance alerts from scratch.
* Driving data analysis and reporting in support of broader compliance team needs.
* Experience with Multi-class surveillance like equities , derivatives or commodities is preferred.
* Collaborate with Compliance, Trading and Tech Teams.
* Collaborate with internal developers and vendor teams.
* Contribute to the design of alert specifications and maintain clear documentation
* Communicating with regional compliance teams on global issues and projects.
* Comfort working with large data sets
* Working knowledge of SEBI and Exchange regulations
* Experience with Excel-based data analysis (pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, macros)
* Promoting IMC’s Compliance culture, awareness of regulatory developments, and best practices within the business.

**Your Skills And Experience**

* 2 to 4 years of experience in financial markets surveillance in India at a Trading Firm, Broker, Regulator, Exchange, or similar role.
* Degree qualified in Finance, Business, Law, or a related discipline.
* Experience in trade surveillance and market abuse detection is essential, with a strong preference for candidates who have investigated alerts involving manipulative practices such as spoofing, layering, ramping or wash trading.
* Familiarity with trade surveillance systems, whether in-house tools or third-party platforms (such as OneTick, SMARTS, NICE Actimize, Trading Technologies or First Derivatives) is highly regarded.
* Understanding of proprietary trading and market making business models is an advantage.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Strong attention to detail and analytical/ problem solving skills.
* Strong interpersonal, organisational, and time management skills.
* Ability to work both independently and in teams.
* Ability to communicate complex ideas or concepts clearly.
* Willing to learn and take responsibility for required tasks and projects.

**About Us**
*IMC is a research-driven trading firm where quantitative modeling, machine learning, and engineering shape how modern markets are traded. A stabilizing force in markets since 1989, we provide liquidity across trading venues, delivering the best outcome in value and risk management to investors. Using our own technology and capital, we build proprietary systems and algorithms that operate across global markets. Our researchers, traders, and engineers work as a collective, combining rapid experimentation, advanced infrastructure, and real-time feedback to turn insight into execution and execution into advantage.*

title: Senior Manager, Digital Insights & Analytics – Client Data & Experience
description:
Senior Manager, & Digital Insights & Analytics, Client Data & Experience
  
  
Mumbai, India ( 23 Oct 2026) JD
  
  
Apply now
  
  
**About Amicorp**
Amicorp Group is an independent global provider of corporate management, fiduciary, fund administration and financial markets services. Since 1992, we have helped entrepreneurs, families, investment managers, corporations and financial institutions simplify operations, stay compliant and protect and grow their assets. With offices across multiple jurisdictions worldwide, we combine local expertise with global reach.
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  
Amicorp’s markets are changing fast. New financial hubs are rising, clients and intermediaries expect digital service, and new opportunities are emerging in areas such as tokenization, fintech alliances and data centers. To capture them, Amicorp needs to know which clients, segments, services and markets offer the most growth, and to act on that insight quickly.
  
  
The Senior Manager, Digital Insights & Analytics will provide that insight. You will align Amicorp’s client data with market opportunities to show where to focus, which services to offer to whom, and how to grow, retain and serve clients better. To do this, you will connect the CRM, Zoho applications and other client platforms into a single, trusted view of each client. You will lead Amicorp’s client analytics, from data integration and quality to dashboards, predictive models and client experience measurement, and make data the basis for growth decisions across marketing, the sales offices and client service.
  
  
**Primary Duties And Responsibilities**
What You’ll Work On
  
  
Market Opportunity Insight
  
  

* Combine client data with market and competitor insight from the Market Intelligence Lead to size opportunities by client segment, service line and jurisdiction.
* Identify where Amicorp is under-represented, which clients and intermediaries are most likely to need new services (such as tokenization or data center structuring), and where to invest.
* Support the Head of Digital Business Development, the Special Projects Lead and the sales offices with data-backed opportunity analysis and business cases.

Client Data Strategy & Single Client View
  
  

* Define and own Amicorp’s client data strategy, including the data model, key definitions (client, prospect, intermediary, account, service line) and how data flows between platforms.
* Build and maintain a single client view that brings together data from the CRM, Zoho applications, client portals, WhatsApp, marketing automation, the websites, events and finance systems.
* Set up the matching and de-duplication rules that link the same client, contact or intermediary across systems.
* Create a roadmap for client data and analytics capabilities, agreed with the Head of Digital Business Development and IT.

Platform Integration: CRM, Zoho & Client Platforms
  
  

* Map every client-facing platform, the data it holds and how it connects to the others.
* Design and oversee integrations between the CRM, Zoho applications (such as Zoho CRM, Desk, Campaigns, Forms or Analytics, depending on what Amicorp uses) and other platforms, working with IT and vendors on APIs, connectors and data pipelines.
* Make sure key events, such as enquiries, event registrations, WhatsApp conversations, portal activity, onboarding steps and invoices, reach the right systems and the client record.

Data Quality & Governance

* Define data ownership, access rights and naming conventions for client data.
* Keep documentation of data sources, definitions and integrations up to date, so others can rely on and reuse them.

Analytics, Reporting & Dashboards
  
  

* Build the enterprise dashboards that show the full client journey: marketing reach, leads, pipeline, conversion, onboarding, service, revenue and retention.
* Measure marketing and sales performance end to end, including campaign and channel contribution to pipeline and revenue, working with the Senior Marketing Specialist, Digital and the Sales Operations & Office Liaison Lead.

* Answer ad-hoc questions from executives, business line leaders and the sales offices with clear, reliable data.
* Make dashboards self-service where possible, and train users to read and use them.

Advanced Analytics & AI
  
  

* Develop models that predict client attrition risk, cross-sell and upsell opportunities, lead quality and client lifetime value.
* Segment clients and intermediaries by behavior, value and needs to support targeting and personalization.
* Use AI to analyze unstructured data, such as WhatsApp conversations, emails, survey comments and service requests, to identify themes and sentiment.
* Apply AI responsibly, with human review, clear documentation and compliance with Amicorp policies.

Client Experience Measurement
  
  

* Own the enterprise Client Experience Index (CEI) and the Voice of the Client program, including NPS, CSAT and Customer Effort Score.
* Link client experience scores to the single client view, so feedback can be analyzed by client, service, office and journey stage.
* Connect client experience to business outcomes such as retention, share of wallet, referrals from intermediaries and cost to serve.
* Map key client journeys, such as entity formation, fund launch, trust set-up, onboarding and KYC, and identify friction points using data.

Data Protection & Compliance
  
  

* Make sure client data is collected, integrated, stored and used in line with data protection, confidentiality and regulatory requirements in each jurisdiction, including GDPR and AML/KYC rules.
* Work with Compliance, Legal and Information Security on consent, data retention, data residency and access controls.
* Apply privacy-by-design to every integration and analytics project.

Leadership & Collaboration
  
  

* Build and lead a small analytics capability over time, using internal staff, vendors and partners as needed.
* Promote a data-driven culture across marketing, sales offices and client service.
* Report regularly to the Head of Digital Business Development and executive leadership on insights, priorities and the value delivered.

How This Role Fits the Team
  
  

* Head of Digital Business Development is this role’s line manager and uses its insights to set digital growth priorities and targets.
* Sales Operations & Office Liaison Lead administers the CRM and prospecting tools and supports the sales offices. This role owns how client data connects across platforms, and the analytics built on it.

* Client Messaging & WhatsApp Lead runs the WhatsApp channel. This role integrates conversation and consent data and analyzes it for insight.
* Market Intelligence Lead covers the external market and competitors. This role covers Amicorp’s own client data. Together they size and prioritize market opportunities.

* Global Events Lead shares event data, which this role links to clients and pipeline.
* IT, Compliance and Information Security are key partners for integrations, security and data protection.

**Qualifications, Skills, And Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Communications, Marketing, Information Systems or a related field.
* 5–8 years of experience in client service operations, CRM, digital communications or conversational messaging, including at least 2 years running a messaging channel such as WhatsApp Business at scale.
* Hands-on experience with the WhatsApp Business Platform (API), including template management, opt-in rules and automation.
* Experience setting up service operating models, such as routing, response-time targets and escalation processes.
* Experience in financial services, banking, wealth management, fund administration or another regulated industry strongly preferred.
* Experience coordinating teams across offices or leading a small team.

Skills & Tools
  
  

* Experience with messaging and service platforms such as Twilio, Infobip, 360dialog, Respond.io, Zendesk, Sprinklr or Salesforce Service Cloud.
* Experience with CRM systems (e.g. Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics or HubSpot) and their integration with messaging tools.

Additional Information
