title: Data Analyst
description:
Data Analyst

About Us

Resollect is a Mumbai-based startup fixing how debt recovery works in India. We work with banks, asset reconstruction companies (ARCs) and NBFCs, and the industry has been stuck with clunky, manual processes for far too long. We're changing that by combining legal processes (SARFAESI, Sec 13(2), Sec 14, DRT) with smart automation, clean design, and AI that actually does something useful. We're a small, founder-led team with deep domain expertise, and we move fast.

The Role

Resollect sits on a lot of recovery data: loan accounts, notices, legal stages, hearings and recoveries across our bank, NBFC and ARC clients. Most of it arrives messy. Your job is to make it clean, trustworthy and useful, both for our clients and for how we run the company.

We're big on AI here. We don't want someone who does repetitive work by hand. We want someone who reaches for AI first, builds their own small tools, writes their own prompts, and automates the boring stuff out of existence.

What You'll Do

Build and own dashboards for clients and internal teams: portfolio recovery, case-stage tracking (Sec 13(2) → 13(4) → Sec 14 → DRT), turnaround times and collections.

Tame messy client data. Clean loan-book dumps and inconsistent Excel files, and build pipelines so the same cleanup never has to be done twice.

Write SQL and own data quality across our internal systems.

Find what drives recovery. Which accounts, actions and geographies recover best, and turn that into clear recommendations.

Automate recurring client MIS and reporting.

Use AI / LLMs to extract structured data from documents such as notices and court orders, and to speed up analysis.

Work with tech and operations on data models, tracking and new product features.

What We're Looking For

1–3 years as an analyst (strong freshers with real projects are welcome).

Strong SQL and Excel. Python (pandas) is a big plus.

Dashboarding experience in Power BI, Looker, Metabase or similar.

Structured thinking. You start from the business question, not the chart.

Clear communication. You can explain a finding to a bank's head of collections in two minutes.

Nice to Have (Not Required)

Experience with lending, collections or BFSI data

Experience using LLMs to extract or classify data from documents

A grounding in statistics, or side projects that show you go beyond the obvious

Why This Might Be Worth Your Time

Real data, real money: your analysis directly changes how loans get recovered.

You'll work directly with the founder and build the data function from the ground up.

You'll get very good at using AI for real analytical work.

If you get a kick out of turning a messy spreadsheet into a decision someone acts on, we'd like to meet you.

Location: Mumbai (Andheri), in-office

title: Analyst - Wholesale Credit Risk Quantitative Research
description:
**Job Description**
Bring your expertise to JPMorganChase. As part of Risk Management and Compliance, you'll help keep the firm strong and resilient by anticipating emerging risks and applying sound judgment to solve real-world challenges for our company, customers, and communities. Our culture values curiosity, challenging the status quo, and striving to be best-in-class.
  
  
**Job Summary**
As a Quantitative Research Analyst, Wholesale Credit Risk Modeling within Risk Management and Compliance, you will design, analyze, and deliver quantitative models that support wholesale credit stress testing, internal capital planning, risk appetite frameworks, and loan loss reserves under current expected credit loss standards. You will use statistical techniques and tools to build forecasting models and run back-testing and annual monitoring in line with model governance standards. You will work with experienced quantitative researchers and business partners while building both quantitative and business skills. You will contribute to clear model documentation and communication of model results for internal and regulatory reviews.
  
  
Job Responsibilities
  
  

* Design and develop loss forecasting models for regulatory purposes.
* Conduct back-testing, performance monitoring, and annual reviews of models in line with model governance standards.
* Apply statistical and econometric techniques, and machine learning where appropriate, for forecasting, risk monitoring, and model explainability.
* Handle large-scale panel datasets, including data cleaning, filtering, and feature engineering.
* Partner with Data and Technology teams to implement models with robust data pipelines and controls.
* Prepare clear, comprehensive model documentation for internal and regulatory reviews, and support preparation of results and model impacts for senior stakeholders.

**Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**

* Degree in Engineering, Financial Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Sciences, Statistics, Econometrics, or another quantitative field.
* Strong background in Calculus, Linear Algebra, Probability, and Statistics.
* Theoretical and practical knowledge of statistical methods and models, including generalized linear models, time-series analysis, clustering, decision trees, and logistic regression.
* Experience handling large amounts of panel data, including data cleaning and filtering.
* Proficiency in at least one object-oriented programming language and proficiency in Python or C++, with good software practices (version control, testing, reproducibility).
* Ability to solve problems creatively in a dynamic environment, with eagerness to learn about credit risk, risk parameters, and regulatory and accounting concepts.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**

* 2+ years of relevant experience.
* Knowledge of wholesale credit products and experience developing loss forecasting models for regulatory exercises.
* Knowledge of securitization and securitized products such as residential mortgage-backed securities (RMBS), asset-backed securities (ABS), and collateralized loan obligations (CLOs).
* Knowledge of bond and loan pricing, and knowledge of other financial products and asset classes, options pricing theory, or financial regulations.
* Experience with machine learning and generative AI.
* Familiarity with SQL, distributed data tools, and cloud-based workflows, or high-performance computing.
* Proven ability to build collaborative relationships with key internal partners to achieve objectives and set priorities.

Beyond that, we are interested in the things that make you unique: personal qualities, outside interests, and achievements beyond academia and professions that demonstrate the kind of person you are and the value you could bring to the team
  
  
**About Us**
JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.
  
  
We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.
  
  
**About The Team**
J.P. Morgan's Commercial & Investment Bank is a global leader across banking, markets, securities services and payments. Corporations, governments and institutions throughout the world entrust us with their business in more than 100 countries. The Commercial & Investment Bank provides strategic advice, raises capital, manages risk and extends liquidity in markets around the world.

* Possess in-depth technical knowledge of ERP systems (SAP ERP/HANA, Oracle GL) and finance data structures.
* Lead Chart of Accounts (CoA) design and finance data architecture initiatives.

* Effectively prioritize and manage multiple projects in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment.

* Proven experience in consulting or finance data intelligence leadership roles.
* Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence at all organizational levels.
* Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to present complex information clearly.
* Adaptable and able to navigate ambiguity and evolving business environments.

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
* Knowledge on AI models and understanding of context of GENAI. ML and Agentic in Finance

**To Qualify for the Role, You Must Have**

* CA, CFA, CPA, MBA, or Master’s degree in Finance or related field.
* 5-8 years of relevant experience in finance data intelligence, finance analytics, or finance domain.
* Advanced skills in Excel, PowerPoint, and SQL.

**Ideally, You’ll Also Have**

* Hands-on experience with ERP systems (SAP, Oracle), financial consolidation tools (HFM), and finance data lake platforms.
* Experience leading finance transformation, ERP implementation, and data governance initiatives.
* Project management certification or experience.
* Strong stakeholder management and client engagement skills.

**What We Look For**

* A strategic thinker with commercial acumen, technical expertise, and a passion for continuous learning.
* A leader who thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys working with global teams and clients across industries.

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, you will lead impactful projects with some of the world’s top companies. We emphasize education, coaching, and practical experience to support your leadership and professional growth. You will have the autonomy to shape your career with an individual progression plan and take on challenging assignments in an interdisciplinary environment focused on quality and knowledge sharing. Additionally, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching, and feedback from experienced leaders and colleagues.
* Opportunities to develop new skills and advance your career.
* Flexibility to manage your role in a way that suits you.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

**The Role:**
The Assistant Vice President in the Model Implementation & Support Team plays a pivotal role in the end-to-end lifecycle of actuarial model enhancements, from design and implementation to validation and impact assessment. The role involves understanding business requirements, developing changes in RAFM, and maintaining supporting tools such as the Assumption Management System and Unify. Assistant Vice President ensure robust model architecture, maintain detailed documentation, and drive process improvements.
  
  
On the testing side, the Assistant Vice President validates model changes through functional and end-to-end testing, ensuring accuracy and consistency across the results production process. They assess the financial impact of changes on the balance sheet and P&L, perform reconciliations, and communicate findings to stakeholders. Defect identification, resolution, and retesting are key responsibilities, along with maintaining a thorough audit trail for governance and approvals.
  
  
By combining technical modelling expertise with strong analytical and communication skills, the Assistant Vice President ensures that model changes are not only technically sound but also financially transparent and aligned with business objectives.

**Model Development**
**Model Testing**

* Translate business needs into technical specifications that align with the existing model architecture and operational framework.
* Design, develop, and unit test enhancements to RAFM models, ensuring alignment with actuarial principles and business objectives.
* Maintain a robust audit trail and comprehensive documentation for all model changes.
* Develop and maintain the in-house Assumption Management System (Excel/VBA-based) to support assumption governance.

* Retest and validate fixes to ensure resolution of identified issues.
* Maintain comprehensive documentation of testing activities, results, and financial impact analysis to support audit and approval processes.

* Propose and implement process improvements to increase efficiency and reduce manual effort.

title: Vessel Performance Analyst | Naval Architecture | Mumbai
description:
**Job Description**

We are looking for an experienced
**Vessel Performance Analyst**
to join a team specializing in vessel performance monitoring, maritime data analytics, fuel efficiency, and fleet optimization. The ideal candidate should have 2–5 years of relevant experience in vessel performance or maritime analytics, with a degree in Naval Architecture, Ocean Engineering, or a related field. The candidate must possess strong knowledge of hydrodynamics, vessel performance modelling, Python programming, and data analytics. This is an excellent opportunity to improve fleet efficiency and support data-driven technical and operational decisions.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Build, calibrate, and maintain vessel speed-power and fuel-consumption models.
* Analyse vessel performance, hull and propeller efficiency, speed loss, and fuel consumption.
* Develop baseline performance curves using weather and sea-state corrections.
* Monitor hull fouling, coating effectiveness, drydock performance, and hull-cleaning requirements.
* Validate vessel data from noon reports, sensors, weather sources, and voyage records.
* Develop data-validation rules, anomaly detection methods, and quality-control procedures.
* Investigate data discrepancies and coordinate with vessel crews, Operations, and IT teams.
* Develop Python applications and dashboards for vessel performance, fuel efficiency, and emissions monitoring.
* Provide actionable insights to Performance, Chartering, Operations, and senior management.
* Support voyage optimisation and the integration of vessel-performance monitoring platforms.

**Key Requirements**

* 2–5 years of experience in vessel performance, ship-performance monitoring, or maritime analytics.
* Degree in Naval Architecture, Ocean Engineering, or a related field with strong hydrodynamics knowledge.
* Hands-on experience with Python programming, data analysis, and dashboard development.
* Strong understanding of vessel hydrodynamics, propulsion systems, and speed-power modelling.
* Experience in fuel-consumption analysis, hull and propeller performance monitoring, and weather corrections.
* Knowledge of maritime data validation, anomaly detection, and performance reporting.
* Understanding of hull-coating economics, hull grooming, drydock planning, and hull-cleaning decisions.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to work across technical and operational teams.

title: Store Ingestion Specialist
description:
Believe is a global artist development company. We empower local artists, labels and publishers to grow their audiences at each stage of their careers with expertise, respect, fairness and transparency.

Operating in 50+ countries, with more than 2,000 employees, Believe offers a full range of services including audience development, publishing, marketing and distribution, with a tailor-made approach to fit any artist, label or publisher.

Believe champions independence and innovation through a unique model that combines local expertise with a global tech platform, delivering exclusive solutions for artists to promote and monetize their music thanks to strategic partnerships with leading global digital service providers.

With a leading portfolio of brands that includes Nuclear Blast, naïve, TuneCore, Groove Attack, Sentric, AllPoints and Byond, Believe artists generated more than 800 billion streams worldwide in 2024 across all genres, and were recognized with more than 70 leading industry awards.

Learn more at www.believe.com

**Job Description**

As a Store Ingestion Specialist, you will play a key role in managing the ingestion, validation, reconciliation, and posting of financial and royalty data received from digital service providers (DSPs) and other delivery channels. You will be responsible for ensuring the accuracy and completeness of raw financial files, supporting timely royalty postings, resolving data discrepancies, and maintaining data integrity throughout the ingestion process.

You will work closely with Finance, Accounting, BI, Tech/Data teams, DSPs, and other internal and external stakeholders in an international environment to ensure accurate and timely processing of financial and royalty data.

You will be reporting to the Head of Customer Finance and Legal Operations based in Mumbai and will work closely with the broader Revenue Invoicing, Ingestion and Customer Finance teams in an international environment.

Key Responsibilities:

* Receive and process raw financial and royalty files from various DSPs and delivery channels through email, SFTP/FTP, and backend portals, across formats including Excel, PDF, and TXT.
* Review incoming raw files for completeness and accuracy, identifying incorrect templates, missing information, data inconsistencies, and discrepancies between summary and detailed data.
* Maintain accurate records of raw files by ensuring files are stored in designated S3 buckets in accordance with internal processes.
* Manage the ingestion and posting of royalty and financial reports, including the upload of FX rate files and success files through FileZilla.
* Monitor ingestion processes and identify errors or issues, coordinating with relevant Tech, BI, Data, and Finance teams to ensure timely resolution.
* Review ingested reports for accuracy and perform reconciliation of financial data, including cross-checking AR invoices and payments.
* Export data to Retool and apply relevant foreign exchange rates as part of the ingestion and posting process.
* Perform appropriate validation and second-level reviews before obtaining Finance approvals and facilitating data posting.
* Manage regular SR/SIP report postings, ensuring postings are completed accurately and within defined timelines.
* Coordinate with DSPs to obtain corrected or updated raw files where required and follow up on data discrepancies until resolution.
* Work closely with Tech and Data teams during posting activities to monitor progress, troubleshoot issues, and ensure timely completion.
* Review postings against invoices and receipts created in Oracle and investigate discrepancies and variances.
* Perform detailed analysis of complex or exceptional cases and coordinate with relevant stakeholders to resolve differences.
* Communicate changes in split percentages or other relevant business inputs in advance to ensure appropriate accounting adjustments.
* Support monthly financial closing activities by ensuring ingestion, posting, reconciliation, and supporting financial data are complete and accurate.
* Prepare, maintain, and export relevant reports and documentation for financial reporting, audit, and record-keeping purposes.
* Collaborate with Finance, Accounting, BI, Tech/Data, and other internal stakeholders to resolve data, posting, reconciliation, and accounting-related queries.
* Identify recurring data and process issues and contribute to improvements in data quality, automation, and operational efficiency.
* Ensure adherence to internal controls, procedures, data management standards, and applicable financial policies throughout the ingestion and posting processes.
* Prioritize daily activities effectively and manage multiple ingestion, reconciliation, and posting activities within defined timelines.

We're seeking a hands-on GTM Engineer (B2B Saas) to build the automated systems that find, reach and convert pharmacovigilance buyers for Clinevo Technologies, from data and signals to AI-led outreach, routing and analytics.

You will partner with our sales, marketing, product and tech teams to design, build and run the workflows behind every stage of our funnel. You'll need to possess a strong drive, take ownership of your work, and have an insatiable desire to ship things and make them work.

This role requires a builder with hands-on experience in GTM automation, data enrichment and AI tools, adept at turning manual sales work into repeatable, measurable systems.

* **Data Foundation:**
  Build and maintain a living database of pharma, biotech, CRO, med-device and veterinary companies, with waterfall enrichment for verified contacts and PV-specific data.
* **ICP and Scoring:**
  Define ICP tiers from won and lost deals, and build account and lead scores that blend fit, intent and engagement.
* **Signal Detection:**

title: SAP Consultant
description:
**Hiring: SAP Data Migration Consultant – S/4HANA Finance & Alteryx**

**Industry:**
IT Services & Consulting

**Experience:**
5–8 Years

**Budget:**
Up to ₹25 LPA

**Work Mode:**
Hybrid

**Locations:**
Multiple locations across India

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**About the Role**

We are looking for an experienced
**SAP Data Migration Consultant specializing in SAP S/4HANA Finance and Alteryx**
to support end-to-end financial data migration initiatives for enterprise SAP transformation projects.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience in SAP data migration, financial data profiling and cleansing, source-to-target mapping, transformation, SAP S/4HANA migration tools, and financial reconciliation. Strong expertise in Alteryx Designer is essential for building scalable, reusable workflows that ensure data accuracy, completeness, consistency, and auditability throughout the migration lifecycle.

The successful candidate will work closely with SAP Finance functional consultants, business stakeholders, data owners, technical teams, and project management teams to plan and execute migration activities from initial assessment through mock migrations, cutover, reconciliation, and post-migration validation.

**Key Responsibilities :**

**1. SAP S/4HANA Finance Data Migration**

* Lead and execute end-to-end data migration activities for SAP S/4HANA Finance implementations and transformation projects.
* Define migration scope, data objects, migration strategy, timelines, dependencies, and execution plans.
* Coordinate data extraction, profiling, cleansing, transformation, validation, loading, and reconciliation activities.
* Participate in migration workshops with Finance, SAP functional, business, and technical teams.
* Execute mock migration cycles, identify defects, resolve data issues, and support cutover and go-live activities.
* Ensure migrated financial data meets business requirements, data quality standards, and audit expectations.

**2. Finance Data Objects and Mapping**

* Perform source-to-target field-level mapping for SAP S/4HANA Finance data objects.
* Work with financial master data and transactional data, including:
* General Ledger (GL) and Chart of Accounts (CoA)
* Profit Centers and Cost Centers
* Business Partners (BP) and Customer/Vendor Integration (CVI)
* Accounts Receivable (AR) and Accounts Payable (AP)
* Fixed Assets and Asset Accounting
* Tax-related master data
* Bank master data and related financial information
* Analyze source-system structures, target-system requirements, mapping rules, transformation logic, and dependencies.
* Collaborate with SAP Finance functional teams to resolve mapping gaps, data inconsistencies, and business-rule exceptions.
* Understand relevant SAP data structures and tables, including ACDOCA, BKPF, BSEG, SKA1, SKB1, LFA1, LFB1, KNA1, and ANLA.

**3. Alteryx Data Profiling, Cleansing and Transformation**

* Develop, maintain, and optimize Alteryx Designer workflows for large-scale data migration activities.
* Perform data profiling, parsing, cleansing, standardization, validation, deduplication, fuzzy matching, joins, pivots, and transformation.
* Build reusable and parameterized workflows, macros, and mapping tables to support repeatable migration cycles.
* Implement data quality rules, exception handling, reference-data management, and validation checks.
* Identify missing values, duplicate records, inconsistent formats, invalid master data, and other migration risks.
* Optimize workflow performance and implement appropriate logging, traceability, and data lineage practices.
* Collaborate with business and technical stakeholders to improve data quality before loading data into SAP S/4HANA.

**4. SAP Migration Cockpit and Data Loading**

* Execute data loads using SAP S/4HANA Migration Cockpit, including staging-table or direct-transfer approaches where applicable.
* Understand migration object templates, source structures, mapping requirements, dependencies, and load sequencing.
* Prepare and validate migration files or staging data before loading.
* Monitor migration execution, analyze error logs, troubleshoot failed records, and coordinate defect resolution.
* Reprocess corrected records and validate successful loading into the target SAP environment.
* Support mock loads, dress rehearsals, production cutover, and post-go-live data validation.
* Work with SAP functional and technical teams to resolve loading errors and migration object issues.

**5. Financial Reconciliation and Data Validation**

* Perform pre-migration and post-migration reconciliation to confirm the accuracy and completeness of migrated financial data.
* Reconcile trial balances, General Ledger balances, Accounts Receivable, Accounts Payable, fixed assets, and bank-related data.
* Validate record counts, financial balances, debit/credit totals, opening balances, and key control totals.
* Investigate reconciliation differences and coordinate corrective actions with Finance and SAP teams.
* Prepare reconciliation reports, migration sign-off documentation, issue logs, and audit-ready evidence.
* Ensure migration results meet agreed acceptance criteria and financial control requirements.

**6. Migration Planning, Cutover and Stakeholder Coordination**

* Develop migration plans, mock-cycle schedules, cutover checklists, issue trackers, and reconciliation templates.
* Coordinate migration dependencies across Finance, SAP functional, technical, data, and business teams.
* Track migration progress, data quality metrics, defects, risks, and outstanding dependencies.
* Support go/no-go assessments, cutover rehearsals, production migration, and stabilization activities.
* Maintain clear documentation of mapping rules, transformation logic, data quality findings, load results, and reconciliation outcomes.
* Communicate migration status, risks, and remediation plans to project stakeholders.

**Required Technical Skills :**

**SAP S/4HANA Finance**

* Hands-on experience in SAP data migration, preferably for SAP S/4HANA Finance.
* Strong understanding of Finance master data and transactional data migration.
* Knowledge of GL, CoA, Profit Centers, Cost Centers, Business Partners/CVI, AR/AP, Asset Accounting, Tax, and Bank Master data.
* Familiarity with SAP tables such as ACDOCA, BKPF/BSEG, SKA1/SKB1, LFA1/LFB1, KNA1, and ANLA.
* Practical experience with SAP S/4HANA Migration Cockpit, migration objects, load sequencing, error resolution, and reconciliation.

**Alteryx Designer**

* Strong hands-on proficiency in Alteryx Designer for data preparation and migration.
* Experience building reusable workflows and macros.
* Proficiency in data profiling, cleansing, joins, parsing, deduplication, fuzzy matching, regular expressions, and pivoting.
* Understanding of data quality rules, mapping tables, reference data, logging, lineage, and workflow optimization.

**Data and Reconciliation**

* Strong SQL skills for data extraction, validation, and analysis.
* Advanced Excel skills for mapping, reconciliation, data validation, and reporting.
* Ability to investigate data discrepancies, resolve migration defects, and maintain accurate documentation.

**Experience and Qualifications :**

* 5–8 years of relevant SAP data migration experience.
* Experience delivering 1–2 full-cycle SAP S/4HANA Finance migration projects.
* Demonstrated hands-on experience in migration planning, data mapping, transformation, loading, reconciliation, and cutover.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.

**Good to Have :**

* Experience with SAP BODS, SAP MDG, or SAP CPI.
* Exposure to Alteryx Server and enterprise workflow management.
* Basic knowledge of SAP Ariba supplier and purchase-order data.
* Experience with SAP ECC-to-S/4HANA migration or multi-system consolidation.
* Familiarity with data governance, financial controls, and audit documentation.

**Work Locations:**

Hybrid opportunities are available across the following Indian locations, subject to project requirements and team allocation:

Interested?

If interested, please apply through the job posting below or email your resume to hr@stafingo.com for immediate consideration.

We look forward to connecting with experienced SAP Data Migration professionals who can deliver reliable, accurate, and audit-ready S/4HANA Finance migration outcomes.

title: Manager, Media Strategy & Marketing Analytics
description:
**The opportunity**
Join our India theatrical marketing team in a role that sits at the intersection of media strategy, audience intelligence, creator marketing and commercial performance. You will shape how films reach audiences across India, translating data and cultural insight into integrated campaigns that build awareness, spark conversation and support box-office outcomes throughout the release lifecycle.
  
  
Based in our Mumbai office, this is a hands-on strategic role for a curious, commercially minded candidate who can connect the big picture with the detail: identifying the right audiences, building the channel mix, negotiating value, challenging partners and using live performance signals to sharpen investment decisions.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Own end-to-end media strategy and planning for theatrical releases across digital, television, out-of-home, print, radio, cinema and emerging platforms.
* Translate audience data, market potential, campaign objectives and cultural insight into clear investment choices, channel roles and measurable outcomes.
* Lead digital and performance marketing across platforms such as YouTube, Meta, Google, connected TV/OTT and programmatic media, continually optimising against agreed KPIs.
* Develop creator and influencer strategies that are relevant to each title, audience and market, with a focus on conversation, fandom and organic amplification as well as paid reach.
* Assess creators using audience fit, engagement quality, content performance, cultural relevance, brand suitability and return on investment, not follower count alone.
* Partner with media agencies, creators, platforms and media owners; negotiate commercial value, secure innovative opportunities and hold partners accountable for quality and outcomes.
* Build measurement frameworks and dashboards that connect reach, frequency, engagement, search, social signals, creator performance, ticketing trends and campaign efficiency.
* Use real-time signals to recommend changes in audience, channel, creative or spend across trailer launch, advance booking, opening weekend and sustained release periods.
* Establish benchmarks and post-campaign learning that improve planning, investment and performance from one title to the next.
* Collaborate closely with marketing, digital, publicity, creative, distribution and regional stakeholders to deliver joined-up release campaigns.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Typically 5-8 years of experience in media strategy, media planning, digital/performance marketing or marketing analytics, gained in entertainment, streaming, consumer technology, e-commerce, FMCG, telecoms, sports or another fast-moving consumer category.
* A bachelor's degree in marketing, business, media, commerce or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* Demonstrated experience developing integrated media plans and managing meaningful campaign budgets across digital and traditional channels.
* Strong analytical capability, including confidence with dashboards, campaign measurement, attribution concepts and turning data into clear recommendations.
* Working knowledge of India's media landscape, audience behaviours, regional and cultural nuance, and the creator ecosystem.
* Commercial judgement and proven negotiation skills with agencies, platforms, publishers, media owners or creators.
* A creator mindset: able to spot new audience, content and partnership opportunities, test ideas and learn quickly.
* Clear communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the confidence to challenge assumptions and influence decisions.
* Able to prioritise effectively and manage multiple campaigns and competing deadlines simultaneously.
* Comfort operating with pace, ownership and accountability in a deadline-driven release environment.
* Please note that this role is based in Mumbai, India. In order to enable us to meet statutory and regulatory obligations of the Indian immigration system you must have the appropriate immigration permission needed to work and reside in India for the duration of the employment.

**The profile that will thrive**
You are equally comfortable discussing audience strategy, reviewing a dashboard, negotiating with a partner and shaping a creator idea. You ask good questions, bring an informed point of view and use evidence rather than convention to make decisions. This is not a media or influencer coordination role. It is an opportunity to own the connection between audience insight, culture, creators, media investment and commercial outcomes.

title: EY - GDS Consulting - AI And DATA - Semantic BI - Senior
description:

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY-Consulting - Data and Analytics - Semantic BI Engineer – Senior**
EY's Consulting Services is a unique, industry-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional and technical capabilities and product knowledge. EY's financial services practice provides integrated Consulting services to financial institutions and other capital markets participants, including commercial banks, retail banks, investment banks, broker-dealers & asset management firms, and insurance firms from leading Fortune 500 Companies. Within EY's Consulting Practice, Data and Analytics team solves big, complex issues and capitalise on opportunities to deliver better working outcomes that help expand and safeguard the businesses, now and in the future. This way we help create a compelling business case for embedding the right analytical practice at the heart of client's decision-making.
  
  
**Role : Semantic BI Engineer**
**Experience Guide : 3-7 Years**
**Primary Skill Area :**
Semantic Analytics, Self-Service BI, Dashboards, AI-Enabled Insights & Decision Intelligence
  
  
**The opportunity**
Design, build and advise on enterprise BI and semantic analytics solutions that convert trusted data into actionable business insights. This role is not limited to dashboard development; the candidate must be able to assess business needs, propose the right dashboarding or self-service reporting tools, design semantic data layers, build high-quality dashboards, and enable next-generation AI-assisted analytics experiences. The role combines analytics engineering, semantic layer design, dashboard architecture, BI strategy, data storytelling, data modelling, AI enablement and strong business analysis capability.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* BI Strategy, Tool Evaluation & Solution Advisory
* Assess business reporting, analytics and self-service consumption needs across user personas, maturity levels, governance requirements and operating constraints.
* Evaluate and recommend the right BI, dashboarding and self-service reporting tools based on scalability, semantic layer fit, governance, cost, user adoption, integration capability and AI-readiness.
* Shape enterprise BI and analytics roadmaps across Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Tableau, ThoughtSpot, Qlik, Databricks AI/BI, Snowflake Cortex Analyst and other modern analytics platforms.
* Advise stakeholders on when to use operational reporting, executive dashboards, self-service analytics, semantic search, conversational BI, embedded analytics or AI-assisted insight discovery.
* Semantic Layer & Analytics Engineering
* Design semantic data layers that separate business logic from physical data structures and allow consistent consumption across dashboards, reporting tools, AI assistants and self-service analytics platforms.
* Define governed business metrics, KPIs, measures, dimensions, hierarchies, calculations, data definitions and reusable analytical entities.
* Develop analytics engineering assets using SQL, dbt-style transformation patterns, Fabric semantic models, Power BI datasets, lakehouse/warehouse tables and curated analytical data products.
* Align semantic models with business glossaries, metadata, lineage, data quality rules, access controls and enterprise governance standards.
* Dashboard Development, Architecture & Data Storytelling
* Design and develop high-quality dashboards, scorecards and analytical reports that support executive decisions, operational monitoring, root-cause analysis and business performance tracking.
* Apply dashboard design principles including KPI hierarchy, drill-through, guided navigation, narrative flow, visual consistency, usability, accessibility and performance optimisation.
* Build dashboards using tools such as Power BI, Fabric, Tableau, ThoughtSpot, Qlik, Databricks AI/BI, Snowflake Cortex Analyst or equivalent enterprise BI platforms.
* Move beyond visualisation by translating patterns, trends and exceptions into actionable business insights, recommendations and decision support.
* Data Modelling, Data Analysis & Insight Generation
* Apply strong data modelling skills including dimensional modelling, star schema design, semantic modelling, analytical data product modelling, metric modelling and data mart design.
* Perform deep data analysis using SQL, analytical thinking, data profiling, reconciliation, segmentation, trend analysis, variance analysis and root-cause investigation.
* Partner with business SMEs, data engineers, data architects and product owners to convert business questions into robust data models, analytical logic and reusable reporting assets.
* Ensure insights are grounded in trusted data, explainable logic, meaningful context and clear business interpretation.
* AI-Enabled Analytics & Next-Generation BI
* Understand where and how AI can improve analytics workflows, including natural language querying, automated insight generation, anomaly detection, narrative summaries, semantic search and guided analysis.
* Enable AI-assisted analytics using capabilities such as Fabric Copilot, Power BI Copilot, Databricks Genie, Databricks AI/BI, Snowflake Cortex Analyst, ThoughtSpot Spotter, Azure AI Foundry and Azure OpenAI where relevant.
* Design AI-ready semantic layers that provide business context, trusted metrics, governed definitions and explainability for conversational BI and agentic analytics use cases.
* Identify appropriate use cases for AI in BI while recognising where traditional dashboards, governed reports or human-led analysis remain more suitable.
* Governance, Adoption & Analytics Operating Model
* Define governance standards for dashboards, semantic models, KPIs, certified datasets, access controls, refresh schedules, lifecycle management and reporting asset ownership.
* Support integration with governance and catalogue platforms such as Microsoft Purview, Collibra, Unity Catalog, Snowflake Horizon, Immuta or equivalent enterprise tools.
* Create templates, design standards, dashboard review checklists, documentation patterns and adoption playbooks for consistent analytics delivery.
* Enable business users through self-service analytics training, guardrails, metric definitions and trusted data consumption practices.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* BI and dashboarding - Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Tableau, ThoughtSpot, Qlik, Databricks AI/BI, Snowflake Cortex Analyst, executive dashboards, self-service reporting, embedded analytics.
* Semantic and analytics engineering - Semantic layers, Fabric Semantic Models, Power BI datasets, metrics layer, governed KPIs, SQL, dbt-style modelling, analytical data products, business glossary alignment.
* Data modelling - Dimensional modelling, star schema design, snowflake schema design, semantic modelling, metric modelling, data mart design, canonical/domain model awareness, data dictionary creation.
* Data analysis and insight generation - Advanced SQL, data profiling, trend analysis, root-cause analysis, variance analysis, segmentation, data storytelling, business analysis, actionable insight generation.
* AI and next-generation analytics - Fabric Copilot, Power BI Copilot, Databricks Genie, Snowflake Cortex Analyst, ThoughtSpot Spotter, Azure OpenAI, conversational BI, semantic search, AI-assisted insights, agentic analytics.
* Governance and operations - Microsoft Purview, Collibra, Unity Catalog, Immuta, certified datasets, data lineage, access controls, dashboard governance, BI adoption, performance optimisation.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Relevant experience guide: 3-7 years
* 3+ years of experience in BI, analytics engineering, data analysis, semantic modelling, data modelling or analytics architecture.
* Strong hands-on experience developing dashboards and semantic models, with the ability to advise on the right BI/self-service analytics tools for business needs.
* Preferred certifications: Power BI Data Analyst, Microsoft Fabric Analytics Engineer, Tableau, Snowflake/Databricks analytics credentials, AI/GenAI foundations or cloud data certifications.

**Ideally, you'll also have**

* Architect by mindset, not only dashboard developer by nature; able to influence BI strategy and analytics consumption architecture.
* Excellent data analytics, stakeholder management, business consulting and data storytelling skills.
* Understands where AI should and should not be used in analytics workflows, and can guide business users towards trusted, governed and actionable insights.
* Comfortable operating across business, analytics, data engineering, semantic architecture, AI and enterprise governance teams.
* This role is not a traditional BI Developer. It is a Semantic BI Engineer and analytics architect who defines how trusted data is modelled, consumed and converted into actionable insight through governed dashboards, self-service analytics and AI-enabled decision intelligence.

**What We Look For**

* Architect by mindset, not only dashboard developer by nature; able to influence BI strategy and analytics consumption architecture.
* Excellent data analytics, stakeholder management, business consulting and data storytelling skills.
* Understands where AI should and should not be used in analytics workflows, and can guide business users towards trusted, governed and actionable insights.
* Comfortable operating across business, analytics, data engineering, semantic architecture, AI and enterprise governance teams.

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we're dedicated to helping our clients, from start-ups to Fortune 500 companies, and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasises high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:

title: Digital Insights Consultant
description:
**About i-Genie**

At i-Genie.ai, we believe the best insights don't just inform. They inspire.

We're an AI-powered consumer insights company. We help leading global brands and retailers, including Kenvue, Unilever and Coca-Cola, spot future trends and make better decisions, faster.

We do this by bringing together billions of data points from search, social media, reviews and market data. Clients get the answers through easy-to-use dashboards and Presto, our GenAI copilot, which spots trends, tracks brand health and benchmarks performance in real time.

**The role at a glance**

Role: Digital Insights Consultant (Social, Search & Reviews)

Location: Mumbai, hybrid

Type: Full-time

Experience: 5 to 6 years in social listening, search and reviews insights

Focus: Global FMCG client

Start: November 2026

**Why this role matters.**
Brands are drowning in digital signals but short on clear answers. You'll turn what people post, search for and write in reviews into insights that shape marketing, brand strategy, innovation and content.

You'll also help our client's teams get better at this themselves. You'll coach them on using social, search and reviews data well, so good insight becomes part of how they work every day.

**What you'll do**

**Find the story in the data**

* Dig into social listening, search and ratings & reviews data to answer real business questions
* Use tools like Trajaan, Google Keyword Planner, review analytics platforms and i-Genie's own platform
* Connect the dots across sources: what people say on social, what they search for, and what they praise or complain about in reviews

**Turn insight into action**

* Work on strategic briefs on innovation, content, trends and brand health
* Build clear, compelling narratives that help marketers decide what to do next
* Present findings to brand, marketing and insights teams in plain, confident language

**Build capability**

* Coach client teams on using social, search and reviews data well
* Share best practices and stronger ways of analyzing digital signals
* Help teams ask sharper questions and get more out of the tools they already have

**Shape what we build**

* Share what you learn from clients with i-Genie's product and data teams
* Help us improve our dashboards and Presto based on real client needs

**What you bring**

* 5 to 6 years of hands-on work turning social, search and reviews data into consumer insight
* Strong, practical experience with social listening tools; Trajaan experience is a must, and Meltwater or ConvoTrack is a big plus
* Confidence with search data (for example Google Keyword Planner or Google Trends) to size interest and spot rising demand
* Experience analysing ratings and reviews to find product strengths, pain points and unmet needs
* A track record of stitching data into stories that changed a marketing, brand or innovation decision
* Experience working with, or consulting for, marketing and brand teams
* Clear communication: you can explain complex data simply to senior stakeholders
* A natural coach who enjoys helping others get better

**The kind of person who thrives here**

* Curious about people, culture and what drives consumer behavior
* Proactive and can-do, with a habit of delivering results
* Comfortable switching between hands-on analysis and big-picture thinking
* Excited by AI and new ways of finding insight

**Nice to have**

* Experience in Beauty, Personal Care or Wellbeing categories
* Background in an insights agency, a social listening vendor or a client-side consumer insights team
* Comfort with dashboard tools such as Power BI
* Experience running training sessions or workshops

**Who you'll work with**

You will work closely with the client’s team and be integrated into their day-to-day operations. Although you will be embedded within the client’s organisation, you will remain an employee of i-Genie.ai and continue to be part of our wider team.

**Why you'll love working here**

* **Innovative work:**
  be part of a company changing how brands use AI for insights
* **Global exposure:**
  work with some of the world's best-known brands
* **Supportive culture:**
  we're a team that has your back
* **Room to grow:**
  ongoing learning and a clear path to bigger client roles
* **Flexible working:**
  hybrid set-up that fits how you work best

**How to apply**

Send your CV to people@i-Genie.ai and a short note on an insight you're proud of the data you used, the story you told, and what changed because of it.

Job Description:
  
  
**About The Role**
Russell Investments is seeking a highly analytical, technology-minded Portfolio Implementation Analyst to join our Mumbai-based team supporting the fast-growing Personalized Managed Accounts (PMA) business. This role sits within a global portfolio management team responsible for implementing systematic, tax-aware and personalized investment strategies across client accounts.
  
  
You will support daily portfolio implementation, optimization, trade preparation and data validation while helping improve the systems and processes that make the business scalable. The strongest candidates will be comfortable working across multiple systems, investigating issues, using data to form a view, and translating problems and enhancement ideas into clear recommendations for portfolio managers, business partners and developers.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

* Support daily portfolio implementation, including account optimization, trade creation and review, compliance checks, cash management, data validation and exception resolution.
* Analyze optimizer results and portfolio data to identify unusual outcomes, data-quality issues, system defects and opportunities to improve decision rules or workflows.
* Work across investment, trading, risk, data and operational systems; determine whether breaks originate from data, configuration, process or technology and drive issues toward resolution.
* Use SQL, Excel and other analytical tools to query, reconcile and validate data, support root-cause analysis, and reduce manual checks where practical.
* Identify and help implement automation opportunities that improve accuracy, control, speed and scalability, including thoughtful use of AI and emerging technologies.
* Translate business problems into clear requirements: articulate the issue, impact, evidence and recommended enhancement to peers, managers and developers; support testing and implementation.
* Coordinate with global portfolio management, trading, operations, research and technology teams on trades, cash activity, account events and implementation issues.
* Interpret and process security corporate actions and help resolve security master, pricing and other market-data exceptions across a large security universe.
* Document procedures, controls, recurring issues and findings; manage multiple priorities, execute directions accurately, and escalate material issues with concise analysis and recommended next steps.

What We’re Looking For
  
  

* 3-5 years of experience in investment management, portfolio operations, trading, investment technology, data analysis or a related field.
* Bachelor’s degree in finance, economics, mathematics, engineering, computer science or a related discipline. A master’s degree, CFA progress/designation or other relevant qualification is beneficial but not required.
* Strong understanding of capital markets, investment portfolios, asset classes and/or performance measurement, combined with rigorous analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Demonstrated comfort working with multiple systems and large data sets, including the ability to recognize when something does not look right, investigate why, and recommend a practical response.
* Working knowledge of SQL and strong Excel skills. Experience with Python, Power BI or other data/automation tools is a plus.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain a problem, its business impact and a recommended solution to both investment professionals and technology teams.
* Ability to work autonomously and collaboratively; a self-starter who takes ownership, asks questions early and is candid when a concept, process or requirement is unclear.
* Strong organization, attention to detail and time management, with the ability to execute instructions consistently and accurately in a fast-paced environment.
* Comfort making pragmatic decisions in ambiguous situations, documenting the rationale, and adjusting as new information becomes available.
* Curiosity, strong work ethic and a continuous-improvement mindset; willing to challenge the status quo constructively and look for better ways to work.

**Preferred Experience**

* Retail or institutional trading, portfolio management, portfolio implementation or portfolio optimization.
* Axioma Portfolio or another portfolio optimization/risk platform; Bloomberg or similar market-data tools.
* Security-level corporate actions, security master/reference data, pricing data and exception resolution across a broad security universe.
* System testing, requirements gathering, process design, workflow automation or partnership with software developers and technology teams.
* Using AI or emerging technologies to streamline analysis, documentation, controls or investment workflows.
* Tax-managed investing, direct indexing or separately managed accounts is helpful, but prior U.S. tax-management experience is not required.

How You’ll Work
  
  
This is a hands-on role in a rapidly growing business. You should be comfortable moving quickly, learning continuously and taking ownership from the outset. We value people who are direct, curious and dependable; who ask good questions rather than make silent assumptions; who can make a reasonable decision with incomplete information and explain their reasoning; and who actively look for opportunities to make the portfolio-management process more efficient, scalable and robust.
  
  
Why Join PMA?
  
  

* Join one of Russell Investments’ strategic growth businesses and help shape how a scaled, technology-enabled portfolio-management platform evolves.
* Gain exposure to global portfolio management, trading, optimization, risk, investment operations and technology while working with experienced investment professionals across regions.
* Build a career at the intersection of investing, data and technology, with meaningful opportunities to take ownership as the business and platform expand.
* Have visible impact: strong ideas, thoughtful analysis and effective automation can improve client outcomes and the way the team operates from day one.Portfolio Implementation Analyst

title: Engineer - AI (Mining Automation)
description:

WSP is seeking an Engineer AI (Mining Automation) to join the GCC Specialist Mining Services team, supporting the delivery of digital and automation solutions for global mining projects. Reporting to the Mining Automation Team Leader, the successful candidate will develop and implement AI-enabled workflows that improve the way mining, asset, operational, geotechnical, and technical information is processed, connected, analysed, and used for engineering decision-making.
  
  
The role combines mining-domain understanding with artificial intelligence, automation, data engineering, computer vision, knowledge extraction, and graph-based retrieval. The Engineer will collaborate with multidisciplinary teams across WSP to develop practical, scalable, traceable, and responsible solutions for mine planning, operations, tailings and water management, asset performance, risk management, and engineering delivery.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**AI and Mining Automation Development**

* Design, develop, and implement AI-enabled automation solutions for mining engineering and operational workflows.
* Work with mining specialists to identify high-value automation opportunities and convert technical requirements into practical digital solutions.
* Develop intelligent workflows that integrate geological, geotechnical, mine planning, operational, asset,

environmental, and risk information.
  
  

* Support the use of generative AI, machine learning, computer vision, and agent-based approaches to improve engineering productivity and decision support.
* Create reusable components and scalable solution patterns that can be applied across global mining projects.

**Data Extraction and Document Intelligence**

* Develop automated pipelines to extract information from mining reports, PDFs, scanned documents, drawings, tables, figures, inspection records, and monitoring outputs.
* Apply OCR, layout understanding, multimodal models, and LLM-based techniques to identify entities, attributes, relationships, measurements, risks, and supporting evidence.
* Implement validation, normalization, exception-handling, and quality-control logic to improve the accuracy and consistency of extracted information.
* Maintain traceability between extracted outputs and the relevant source documents, pages, figures, tables, or evidence.

**AI Models and Advanced Analytics**

* Develop, validate, and support deployment of machine learning solutions for predictive analytics, anomaly detection, classification, risk assessment, optimization, and asset insights.
* Apply data science and statistical methods to identify patterns, trends, and actionable insights from engineering and operational data.
* Evaluate model performance, limitations, and suitability for mining use cases, working with domain experts to confirm engineering relevance.
* Contribute to proof-of-concept development and the transition of successful prototypes into maintainable production solutions.

**Knowledge Management and Graph-Based Intelligence**

* Support the design of structured knowledge models that connect mining assets, technical information, operational data, risks, controls, and engineering evidence.
* Contribute to knowledge graph and semantic data solutions using RDF, OWL, SPARQL, or equivalent technologies where appropriate.
* Develop graph-native and hybrid retrieval workflows, including GraphRAG approaches that combine structured graph context with AI models.
* Enable natural-language access to connected mining knowledge for engineering assistants, analytics tools, and decision-support applications.
* Support provenance, versioning, evidence linking, and auditability of AI-generated or graph-derived outputs.

title: Associate, Credit Risk Manager, Risk Management Group
description:
**Job Purpose**
The Policy Manager for Prime Loan Against Property (PLAP) is responsible for designing, formulating, and lifecycle-managing the credit policies, risk acceptance criteria (RAC), and underwriting guidelines for secured asset portfolios (specifically Loan Against Property / PLAP) within Consumer Banking Group (CBG) Credit.
  
  
The role ensures that the portfolio growth aligns with the bank's approved Risk Appetite Framework while balancing aggressive business expansion goals with prudent credit risk controls, regulatory compliance (RBI guidelines), and fraud mitigation.
  
  
**Job Duties & Requirements**

* Policy Formulation and Framework Design
* Credit Policy Architecture: Own, review, and periodically update the credit policies, Product Programs (CPP), and underwriting guidelines for Prime Loan Against Property (PLAP) in coordination with business units and senior management.
* Risk Acceptance Criteria (RAC): Calibrate and refine RAC parameters (such as LTV caps, debt-to-income ratios, collateral eligibility, property valuation metrics, and negative area/pincode restrictions) based on macroeconomic trends, portfolio performance, and stress-testing results.
* Standardization: Ensure clear alignment of PLAP policies with overarching Group Core Credit Policies, Risk Appetite Statements (RAS), and local regulatory mandates (e.g., RBI Master Directions).
* Portfolio Monitoring, Analytics & Quality Assurance
* Portfolio Health Tracking: Continuously monitor portfolio metrics (delinquencies, early-stage flow rates, bounce rates, LTV migration, and Concentration Risk thresholds) to identify emerging credit risks or asset quality deterioration.
* Trigger Management: Implement and monitor Management Action Triggers (MAT) and portfolio caps for PLAP and broader secured lending portfolios.
* Audit & Compliance Support: Partner with Quality Assurance (QA) and Credit Fraud Risk Management (CFRM) teams to review control parameters, address policy/process vulnerabilities, and ensure audit readiness.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration & Product Expansion
* New Product Programs (NPP): Collaborate with Business, Product, and Technology & Operations (T&O) teams to evaluate and structure new product variants, digital/phygital journey integration (e.g., automated appraisal workflows, API-driven verification), and alternative scoring models.
* Process Alignment: Work closely with Credit Operations (CBO) and underwriting teams to ensure seamless policy translation into system rules (e.g., One Risk Workbench/ORWB, IBPM workflows) and operational execution manuals.
* Exception & Escalation Governance: Review and decide on complex policy exception frameworks, setting clear delegation of authority (DoA) matrices for credit managers.

**Required Experience**
Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, Statistics, or a related quantitative field.
  
  
Professional risk certifications (e.g., FRM, CFA) are an added advantage.
  
  
**Education / Preferred Qualifications**
Graduate / Post Graduate in relevant field.
  
  
****Core Competencies****
****Technical Competencies****
Deep Regulatory & Product Knowledge: Strong understanding of secured lending products, property valuation methodologies, legal title checks, CERSAI regulations, and RBI guidelines governing commercial and retail banks in India.
  
  
Data-Driven & Analytical: Strong command over portfolio analytics, credit risk modelling metrics (PD, LGD, EAD), and performance tracking dashboards.
  
  
Stakeholder Management: Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to influence senior business leaders, risk committees, and operational teams.
  
  
Governance Mindset: Demonstrated ability to balance business growth objectives with robust risk controls and rigorous compliance standards.
  
  
****Work Relationship****
8 years of overall banking experience, with at least 5–7 years specialized experience in Retail/Consumer Credit Risk, Credit Policy, or Portfolio Management—specifically focused on Secured Lending, Mortgages, or Loan Against Property (LAP)
  
  
****DBS India - Culture & Behaviors****

* Performance through Value Based Propositions
* Ensure customer focus by delighting customers & reduce complaints
* Build pride and passion to protect, maintain and enhance DBS’ image and reputation
* Enhance knowledge base, build skill sets & develop competencies
* Execute at speed while maintaining error free operations
* Maintain the highest standards of honesty and integrity
