title: Treasury Business Analyst
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

We are hiring a Business Analyst to translate Treasury's needs into well-defined, workflow-driven

systems. The Group runs a large investment book and a diversified borrowing programme, so Treasury depends on accurate deal capture, approvals, limits, cash and liquidity visibility, and reporting.

You will sit between the Treasury desk (front, mid and back office), Finance, Risk, Compliance and

Technology. Your job is to turn how Treasury actually works into clear requirements, automated

workflows and reliable data, and to see those changes through to go-live.

Role Expectations:

● Requirements and process analysis

○ Gather and document business requirements (BRD / FRD / user stories) for treasury

processes across investments, borrowings, liquidity, cash management and collateral.

○ Map current and target-state processes, spot manual hand-offs and control gaps, and

propose automation.

● Workflow design

○ Design end-to-end workflows for deal capture, multi-level approvals, limit checks,

confirmations, settlement and reconciliation, with clear roles, maker-checker controls

and audit trails.

○ Define business rules, SLAs, escalations and exception handling inside each workflow.

● Investment and borrowing operations

○ Support requirements for investment instruments (G-secs, T-bills, CPs, CDs, bonds,

mutual funds) and borrowing instruments (bank lines, NCDs, CPs, term loans), including

interest accruals, maturities, repayments and covenant tracking.

○ Work with Treasury on liquidity and cash-flow forecasting, exposure and

counterparty-limit views.

● Treasury product and platform

○ Build deep functional knowledge of the treasury product in use: the deal lifecycle

(capture, validation, approval, confirmation, settlement, accounting, maturity),

instrument and counterparty masters, limit and rate set-ups, and user roles.

○ Run fit-gap analysis between product capabilities and Treasury requirements, and agree

with Technology and the vendor what is configuration, customisation or a workaround.

○ Own the product backlog with Treasury: prioritise enhancements, review vendor release

notes, assess impact before upgrades and coordinate regression testing.

○ Document and maintain product configuration: product parameters, workflow rules,

templates, report formats and access matrices.

○ Specify product integrations with banks (payment files, statements), market data,

depositories and the general ledger.

○ Act as first-line functional expert for production issues: reproduce, find the root cause

and work with vendor support to resolve.

● Delivery and change management

○ Partner with Technology and vendors (including treasury product vendors) to translate

requirements into specifications, review designs and track delivery.

○ Plan and run UAT, write test cases, manage defects and sign-offs, and support go-live and

post-go-live stabilisation.

○ Prepare training material and user guides for Treasury and Finance teams.

● Reporting and data

○ Define MIS, dashboards and regulatory or management reports (liquidity, investment

portfolio, borrowing profile, interest cost, limit utilisation).

○ Ensure data integrity between the treasury system, general ledger, bank statements and

other source systems.

● Governance

○ Keep documentation, change logs and process controls audit-ready; support internal and

statutory audit queries.

Qualifications:

● 4–6 years of total experience, of which 2–3 years as a Business Analyst or functional consultant

on treasury, capital-markets, banking or NBFC systems.

● Hands-on experience with a treasury product or platform (implementation, configuration,

support or functional ownership), covering the deal lifecycle for investments and borrowings.

● Hands-on experience designing and documenting workflows (approval chains, rule-based

routing, maker-checker, exception handling) on that platform.

● Experience taking requirements through the full cycle: elicitation, specification, UAT and go-live.

● Working knowledge of treasury products and processes: money market and debt instruments,

borrowings, liquidity management and interest computation.

● Graduate in Commerce, Finance, Engineering or a related field; MBA (Finance), CA, CFA or FRM is

a plus but not mandatory.

Good to Have

● Working knowledge of Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials, especially General Ledger and Cash

Management, plus Payables and Receivables where treasury flows touch them

● Understanding of how the treasury product posts to Oracle Fusion: accounting entries, GL and

account mapping, period close and bank reconciliation.

● Ability to write functional specifications for file-based or API-based integrations between the

treasury product and Oracle Fusion, and to run UAT on the accounting flows.

● Comfortable working with Finance and the Oracle Fusion team to resolve posting and

reconciliation breaks.

Skills

1. Treasury Domain - Investments, borrowings, liquidity and cash-flow management, counterparty

and exposure limits, interest accruals, accounting touchpoints

2. Business Analysis - BRD / FRD / user stories, process mapping (BPMN or flowcharts), gap

analysis, traceability, UAT planning, change management

3. Workflow and Systems - Workflow engines, rule configuration, approval matrices, integrations

between treasury, Oracle Fusion / GL, banks and market data

title: People Consulting-Analytics-Senior-GIG
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Senior Consultant**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
A Full Stack Developer with .NET and React expertise specializes in building complete enterprise web applications using Microsoft's .NET ecosystem for the backend and React for the frontend. Also, you're expected to architect solutions, mentor junior developers, and own entire features from design through production.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Frontend Development: Building responsive, performant user interfaces with React, managing state, and implementing complex UI interactions
* Backend Development: Designing and implementing APIs using .NET (C# with ASP.NET Core or Framework), managing business logic, and ensuring system reliability
* Database Design: Creating efficient SQL Server schemas, optimizing queries, and ensuring data integrity
* System Architecture: Contributing to decisions about application structure, scalability, and integration patterns
* API Development: Building RESTful APIs endpoints with proper authentication, validation, and error handling
* Code Quality: Writing clean, maintainable code following SOLID principles and conducting code reviews
* Testing: Implementing unit tests, integration tests, and end-to-end tests across both layers
* Deployment & DevOps: Managing CI/CD pipelines, deploying to Azure or on-premises servers, and monitoring applications
* Problem-Solving: Debugging issues that span React frontend, .NET backend, and SQL Server database
* Collaboration: Working with designers, product managers, QA, and other developers
* Performance Optimization: Ensuring fast load times, efficient database queries, and optimized React rendering
* Documentation: Maintaining API documentation and architectural decision records

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Full-Stack Microsoft Expertise: You need strong knowledge across the entire Microsoft stack—React for frontend, .NET/C# for backend, and SQL Server for data. You should understand how these technologies integrate and optimize across all layers.
* Enterprise-Level Thinking: Enterprise applications require scalability, security, maintainability, and reliability. You should think about long-term implications of technical decisions, not just short-term solutions.
* Database Optimization: SQL Server expertise with understanding of query optimization, indexing strategies, and database design patterns that support high-performance applications.
* Communication: Explaining technical decisions about architecture, technology choices, and trade-offs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Problem-Solving Across Layers: Ability to diagnose whether a performance issue is in the React UI, .NET API, the database, or network layer—and fix it systematically.

**Ideally, you’ll also**

* 5+ Years in .NET and React Development should have spent substantial time building production applications with both technologies. This typically means multiple projects where you've seen different architectural patterns, scaling challenges, and business requirements.
* C# Expertise: Deep knowledge of C# including LINQ, async/await, delegates, events, generics, and modern language features (nullable types, records, tuples, etc)
* API Design: Building RESTful APIs following best practices, versioning strategies, and proper HTTP status codes
* Authentication & Authorization: Implementing authentication (JWT, OAuth, Windows Auth) and role-based access control
* React Proficiency: Modern component-based UI development with hooks, state management, and performance optimization. React is the standard for building dynamic user interfaces in this stack.
* .NET Mastery: Deep knowledge of C# and the .NET ecosystem, including async/await patterns, dependency injection, middleware, and entity framework. Understanding both .NET Framework and .NET Core is valuable.
* Database Optimization: SQL Server expertise with understanding of query optimization, indexing strategies, and database design patterns that support high-performance applications.
* Advanced React Knowledge: Deep proficiency with React hooks (useState, useContext, useReducer, custom hooks), functional components, and lifecycle methods
* JSX & Component Architecture: Building reusable, well-structured components with proper prop management and composition patterns
* State Management: Experience with major state management solutions
* CSS & Styling: Proficiency with CSS-in-JS solutions (styled-components, Emotion) or CSS modules, responsive design, and styling best practices
* Performance Optimization: Understanding React performance (memorization, lazy loading, code splitting, virtualization)
* Testing: Writing unit tests with Jest and React Testing Library, integration tests, and snapshot testing
* Debugging: Using React Developer Tools and browser Dev Tools effectively
* Version Control: Expert-level Git proficiency including branching strategies and workflows
* CI/CD Pipelines: Experience with Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or similar tools for automated testing and deployment
* Azure: Proficiency with Azure services commonly used with .NET.
* Monitoring & Logging: Setting up logging (Serilog, NLog), monitoring, and alerting
* Design Patterns: Understanding and implementing common patterns (Repository, Factory, Observer, Strategy, etc)
* SOLID Principles: Writing code that follows Single Responsibility, Open/Closed, Liskov Substitution, Interface Segregation, and Dependency Inversion principles
* Clean Architecture: Building applications with clear separation of concerns across layers

**What We Look For**
EY People Consulting is likely seeking someone who:
  
  

* Enterprise-Ready Developer: Someone who writes production-quality code that scales and is secure
* Full-Stack Independence: Can own features end-to-end without being blocked by frontend or backend specialists
* Modern Tech Stack Expertise: Deep knowledge of current best practices in both React and .NET ecosystems
* Technical Leadership: Can make architectural decisions, guide junior developers, and establish coding standards

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  

* Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
* Professional Development: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
* People and Culture: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
* Benefits: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
* How to Apply: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.

Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.

title: Advisory Coordinator - Sales Pipeline Data Analyst
description:
**Job Description**
EisnerAmper is seeking a Sales Pipeline Data Specialist to support data quality across the Advisory Services Group and Outsourced Services Group. Reporting into the Growth team, you will audit, clean, and maintain sales pipeline data: resolving duplicate records, enforcing stage and field standards, and closing out stale opportunities.
  
  
You will work closely with the Advisory Services and Outsourced Services growth teams, business development professionals, and practice leadership to ensure pipeline reporting, forecasting, and KPIs are built on reliable, trustworthy data.
  
  
**What it Means to Work for EisnerAmper:**

* You will get to be part of one of the largest and fastest growing accounting and advisory firms in the industry.
* You will have the flexibility to manage your days in support of our commitment to work/life balance.
* You will join a culture that has received multiple top “Places to Work” awards.

+ We believe that great work is accomplished when cultures, ideas and experiences come together to create new solutions.
+ We understand that embracing our differences is what unites us as a team and strengthens our foundation.
+ Showing up authentically is how we, both as professionals and a Firm, find inspiration to do our best work.
+ Numerous Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) to support our Diversity, Equity, & Inclusion (DE&I) efforts.

**Responsibilities:**

* Conduct ongoing audits of CRM and pipeline data to identify duplicate, stale, incomplete, inaccurate, or non-compliant records
* Perform daily, weekly, monthly, and quarterly pipeline hygiene activities to maintain data quality standards across NetSuite CRM and other approved CRM platforms
* Review opportunity records for completeness and accuracy, validating required fields, stage classifications, ownership assignments, close dates, service line coding, originator attribution, and other required data elements
* Correct data issues directly within CRM systems and follow up with opportunity leaders and/or other stakeholders to obtain missing or inaccurate information
* Monitor aging, stalled, dormant, duplicate, and misclassified opportunities and work with stakeholders to ensure timely updates and appropriate disposition
* Investigate and resolve data quality exceptions that cannot be addressed through automated tools, escalating issues when appropriate.
* Support the accuracy of pipeline reporting, forecasting, and analytics by maintaining clean and reliable CRM data
* Prepare and distribute pipeline hygiene reports, scorecards, exception lists, and data quality findings to Growth and practice leadership
* Support pipeline review meetings through data preparation, action-item tracking, and follow-up activities
* Maintain and update CRM data quality procedures, hygiene checklists, SOPs, field definitions, and related documentation
* Document recurring data issues and recommend updates to processes, procedures, or training materials that improve data quality and consistency
* Identify recurring data quality patterns and trends over time, and surface opportunities for process improvement or automation to Growth leadership
* Serve as a resource for CRM users by answering questions related to data entry requirements, pipeline standards, and opportunity management procedures
* Assist with the creation, maintenance, and modification of CRM reports, dashboards, and data quality monitoring tools
* Help promote consistent pipeline definitions, data standards, and CRM practices across NetSuite and other approved CRM platforms, including Salesforce, HubSpot, or future systems

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree of equivalent experience in business administration, sales operations, data management, or related field
* 2+ years of experience working with CRM systems, including data entry, cleanup, or quality assurance
* Exceptional attention to detail and demonstrated commitment to data accuracy. Ability to identify discrepancies, investigate root causes, and ensure information is maintained to the highest quality standards
* Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to apply practical business judgment when evaluating opportunity data, ownership, stage progression, attribution, and other pipeline-related scenarios
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to ask thoughtful questions, obtain missing information, follow up persistently, and communicate data quality concerns clearly and professionally
* Confidence and professionalism in holding stakeholders accountable to established CRM data standards and following through on corrective actions when needed.
* Ability to maintain a work schedule that includes at least 3-4 hours of regular overlap with U.S. business hours, with flexibility to participate in scheduled meetings across U.S. time zones as needed

**Desired Qualifications:**

* Experience with NetSuite CRM or comparable CRM platforms such as Salesforce, HubSpot, Microsoft Dynamics, or similar systems
* Strong Excel skills, including experience working with large datasets, filtering, sorting, lookup functions, and pivot tables
* Familiarity with sales pipeline concepts, including opportunity stages, forecasting, lead attribution, opportunity ownership, and sales reporting
* Experience identifying data quality issues and implementing corrective actions within CRM or operational systems
* Experience supporting a professional services, consulting, accounting, advisory, or business development organization
* Exposure to SQL/BI/reporting tools (PowerBI, Tableau), or data visualization is a plus, as the role may grow to include deeper pipeline analytics
* Experience using approved AI, automation, or data analysis tools to improve data quality, reporting, or operational workflows

**About EisnerAmper:**
EisnerAmper is one of the largest accounting, tax, and business advisory firms, with nearly 4500 employees and more than 450 partners across the world. We combine responsiveness with a long-range perspective; to help clients meet the pressing issues they face today and position them for success tomorrow.
  
  
Our clients are enterprises as diverse as sophisticated financial institutions and start-ups, global public firms, and middle-market companies, as well as high net worth individuals, family offices, not-for-profit organizations, and entrepreneurial ventures across a variety of industries. We are also engaged by the attorneys, financial professionals, bankers, and investors who serve these clients.
  
  
**About EisnerAmper India:**
EisnerAmper (India) Consultants Pvt. Ltd. (“EA India”) is a subsidiary of Eisner Advisory Group LLC (“EA Group”), which practices in an alternative practice structure with EisnerAmper LLP. EA India employees provide advisory services to clients of EA Group and audit services to clients of Eisner Amper LLP and comply with the professional standards applicable to each of EA India, EA Group and EisnerAmper LLP. EA India employees also provide operational services to EA Group and EisnerAmper LLP. The policies and procedures of EA India, including obligations of confidentiality and non-disclosure, apply to all services provided by EA India employees. All applicants are applying to positions for employment with EA India, and not EA Group or EisnerAmper LLP.
  
  
EA India opened its first office in Mumbai in 2007. Over the years, our India footprint has expanded to include offices in Bengaluru, Hyderabad and Ahmedabad. We are a culturally diverse pool of over 800 professionals supporting our global clientele from a range of startups to Fortune 500 entities.
  
  
Should you need any accommodations to complete this application please email: indiata@eisneramper.com

title: Analyst, Global Programs Support
description:
The Program Analyst is a full-time role combining rigorous impact metrics data validation and executive reporting with hands-on project management support. This role is the team's data custodian: every piece of data that flows into the master database is expected to be reviewed, challenged, and validated before it is accepted. Alongside this, the Analyst works closely with Contract Performance Managers (CPMs) on a daily basis, helping translate scattered project information into clean, approval-ready project deliverables, and acts as the team's tracker — keeping CPMs on schedule for milestones, payments, timely deliveries and approvals. The ideal candidate brings a strong audit background, an exacting eye for detail, and confident PowerBI, Excel, PowerPoint and MS Project (Gantt chart) skills.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Data Validation & Database Integrity**

* Act as the primary gatekeeper for all data entering the master databases — reviewing, cross-checking, and challenging inputs submitted by CPMs before acceptance. All data across CPMs’ working files and Program Support master databases need to be consistent and accurate.
* Apply a rigorous, audit-style validation process to impact metrics evidence, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and alignment with reporting standards and evidencing frameworks.
* Maintain high Excel hygiene across all working files — clean formulas and data input, version control, and structured, auditable workbooks including standardising SharePoint folders.
* Flag inconsistencies or gaps to CPMs or Program Leader, follow up to resolution, and maintain a clear log for internal tracking and validation
* Build and maintain Gantt charts in MS Project to track project timelines, dependencies, and milestones.
* Proactively prompt CPMs ahead of approaching deadlines, milestone payments, and approval document requirements, helping the team stay focused and on track for each project's next stage. Escalate risks to deadlines or deliverables in good time.
* Support proactive project oversight by maintaining real-time visibility of project risks and E2E issue indicators. Escalate issues requiring management attention to safeguard program performance and KPI delivery.
* Continuously enhance operational processes by identifying gaps in data entry and validation workflows and addressing them through automation and process improvements.

**2. Reporting, Dashboards & Executive Presentation**

* Independently gathers, synthesises, and verifies information from diverse sources to produce reliable content.
* Build, maintain, and refresh PowerBI dashboards to support internal and external reporting needs.
* Prepare and tightly edit PowerPoint materials for internal and external audiences, ensuring wording and formatting meet executive-level standards.
* Support both internal reporting (Project Steering Committees, Program calls) and external reporting (Governing Council and Leadership Board) with a consistent level of polish and rigor. All data provided at internal and external forums need to be consistent with PowerBI, accurate and current.
* Support and coordinate the India Program Advisory Group (PAG) meetings under the guidance of Program Strategy and Engagement Leader, ensuring PowerPoint materials and minutes are approved and circulated on time
* Support meeting governance through accurate and timely minute-taking, capturing key discussions, decisions, action items, and ownership to ensure accountability and effective follow-up.

**3. Project Management Support**

* Support CPMs with day-to-day project management activities, acting as an extra pair of hands across the project lifecycle, and ensure CPMs adhere to project deadlines and comply to the E2E process during pipeline development or project execution.
* Support CPMs in drafting project deliverables (e.g. change requests, executive summary, closure reports etc.) by consolidating scattered or incomplete information into clean, submission-ready drafts.
* Liaise with CPMs to clarify missing information and ensure deliverables are internally consistent and fulfils the E2E process criteria before they are routed for approval.
* Review invoices and deliverables and promptly submit disbursement requests; troubleshoot any challenges related to Microsoft Business Central (BC).
* Maintain regular engagement with CPM’s and Program Workstream Leaders to share relevant updates and ensure alignment on information that could affect project execution and program objectives.
* Support pipeline development, project execution documentation and other ad-hoc project administration as needed. This includes documentation and collection of information to expedite the E2E process, and working closely with the Funding Recipient to obtain information or follow up on outstanding matters.
* Support internal and external audit processes of the projects and programs, through collection and consolidation of relevant information and documents, and providing data analysis and justification as needed.
* Participate in site visits and support related preparation work as needed.
* Support any other responsibility as relevant to the job description, emerging from time to time.

**Qualifications and Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in a related field
* 3+ years of relevant work experience.
* Prior experience in an audit, assurance, or controls-focused role strongly preferred — comfortable challenging data and evidence rather than taking it at face value.
* Advanced Excel skills with excellent file hygiene and a strong data-oriented mindset.
* Working experience with PowerBI (dashboard building and maintenance) required.
* Strong PowerPoint skills — able to produce tight, polished, executive-ready slides.
* Experience with MS Project or equivalent Gantt-chart tools.
* Prior exposure to project coordination or project management support is highly valued.
* Excellent attention to detail, follow-through, and stakeholder communication skills.

Generate and optimize short- to medium-term schedules across multi-channel environments (voice, chat, email, back-office). Match shift placement perfectly against arrival patterns provided by the forecasting team to minimize overstaffing and understaffing. Coordinate the strategic placement of non-productive activities, including team meetings, training sessions, 1-on-1s, and coaching blocks, to protect operational SLAs. Administer shift-bid processes, internal transfers, holiday scheduling, and time-off allocation frameworks fairly and transparently.
* Shrinkage Management & Labor Compliance: Track, analyze, and manage shrinkage inputs (planned and unplanned absences, breaks, lunches) within the scheduling software. Ensure strict compliance with local labor laws, union regulations, overtime caps, and corporate HR scheduling policies across all regions. Deliver data-driven recommendations on optimal time-off windows and required overtime (OT) triggers to cushion operational risks.
* Workforce Automation: Assist the Workforce Planning Manager in the deployment of advanced workforce management tools and technologies, including AI and machine learning, to enhance forecasting practices. Own the configuration, performance, and maintenance of the forecasting engine within enterprise WFM platforms (e.g., NICE, Verint, Genesys, Assembled).
* People Strategy Alignment: Build workforce management practices that support the people agenda and the overall employee value proposition. Lead the development of the "Next Generation" workforce development practices in line with the change experience dynamics and employee expectations.
* Big Data: Utilize data analytics to drive continuous improvement in workforce planning, scheduling, and performance management. Translate dense data visualizations and mathematical models into clear, actionable, executive-level insights for senior leaders. Implement data automation pipelines utilizing SQL, Python, or advanced business intelligence (BI) tools to streamline data aggregation and reporting.
* Collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams, including IT, HR, and Customer Service, to ensure seamless integration of workforce management practices. Collaborate closely with Experience Orchestration Center (EOC) Real-Time teams to ensure baseline assumptions are successfully converted into efficient weekly rosters.
* Innovation: Stay abreast of industry trends and best practices in workforce management and automation, and implement innovative solutions to enhance operational efficiencies.
* Performance Management: Develop and implement performance metrics and KPIs to monitor and improve workforce productivity and service quality.

title: Sr Analyst, Financial Planning & Analysis
description:

PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.
  
  
We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.
  
  
We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.
  
  
Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.
  
  
**Job Summary:**

title: Associate, Workflow Modelling and Orchestration - Parametric
description:
**About Morgan Stanley**
Morgan Stanley is a leading global financial services firm providing a wide range of investment banking, securities, wealth management and investment management services. With offices in more than 41 countries, the Firm's employees serve clients worldwide including corporations, governments, institutions and individuals. For further information about Morgan Stanley, please visit www.morganstanley.com.
  
  
**About Parametric**
Parametric is part of Morgan Stanley Investment Management, the asset management division of Morgan Stanley. We partner with advisors, institutions, and consultants to build portfolios focused on what is important to them and their clients. A leader in custom solutions for more than 30 years, we help investors access efficient market exposures, solve implementation challenges, and design multi-asset portfolios that respond to their evolving needs. We also offer systematic alpha and alternative strategies to complement clients' core holdings.
  
  
This role is part of Parametric's hybrid working model, which includes working in the office 3 days a week and choosing to work remotely or in the office the remaining days of the week.
  
  
**About The Team**
The Automation, Reinvention and Collaboration (ARC) team is part of Parametric Operations. The Workflow Modelling and Orchestration team designs, builds, tests, and delivers enterprise operational workflows through Workflow Center, Parametric's Camunda-based workflow platform.
  
  
**About The Role**
Parametric is seeking an Associate to join the Workflow Modelling and Orchestration team to support the design, build, testing, and delivery of enterprise operational workflows through Workflow Center, Parametric's Camunda-based workflow platform.
  
  
The role is a hands-on workflow practitioner who translates complex operational processes into clear requirements and executable workflows. Working with Operations, Product, Technology, Risk and platform teams, the role supports the full workflow lifecycle from discovery and BPMN/DMN modelling through testing, deployment readiness and production support. The role requires practical process analysis, attention to controls and exceptions, and a willingness to develop deeper Camunda expertise.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities**

* ­Discover and define workflows: Lead or support discovery sessions; document business objectives, triggers, actors, systems, data, controls, handoffs, SLAs, decisions and exception scenarios; translate incomplete processes into structured, testable requirements.
* ­ Model executable processes: Design end-to-end BPMN 2.0 workflows and DMN decision logic, including user and service tasks, events, gateways, subprocesses, approvals, escalations, retries, rework and manual-intervention paths.
* ­Configure Workflow Center solutions: Configure models, forms, variables, business rules, task assignments and approved platform components; partner with engineers to define service interactions, APIs, data mappings and integration dependencies.
* ­Support end-to-end delivery: Contribute from intake and design through functional testing, UAT, deployment readiness, hypercare and production analysis; prepare test scenarios, investigate defects and maintain delivery and operating documentation.
* ­Embed controls and operational resilience: Model maker-checker controls, evidence requirements, rejection and resubmission, attestations, auditability and exception handling; escalate unclear requirements, conflicting rules and unresolved risks.
* ­Collaborate and communicate: Facilitate workshops and model walkthroughs; explain workflow behaviour in business language; provide concise updates on progress, decisions, dependencies, risks and defects.
* ­ Apply standards and promote reuse: Follow BPMN, DMN, documentation, testing, naming and review standards; use and improve reusable patterns, templates, checklists and playbooks.

**Job Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems or related area of study.
* 4+ years of professional experience in workflow modelling, business process management, process automation, business analysis, operations transformation or a related discipline.
* Hands-on experience creating executable BPMN 2.0 models, with a sound understanding of events, tasks, gateways, subprocesses, messages, timers, boundary events and exception paths.
* Ability to gather requirements and translate complex or incomplete operational processes into structured models, decision logic and clear documentation.
* Understanding operational controls, approvals, handoffs, task assignment, SLAs, auditability and exception management.
* Experience preparing test scenarios, documenting defects and supporting functional testing or UAT.
* Strong analytical, written and verbal communication skills; ability to manage assigned work, raise risks early and collaborate with business and technical stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Hands-on experience with Camunda 8, Camunda Modeler or another executable workflow platform, including BPMN, DMN, forms, variables or connectors.
* Familiarity with FEEL, REST APIs, JSON, events, messaging, SQL or enterprise-system integrations.
* Experience with Jira and Confluence and with reviewing workflow instances, variables, incidents, logs or execution paths.
* Financial-services or other regulated-industry experience; exposure to onboarding, oversight, reconciliation, approvals, investment operations or exception management.
* BPMN, Camunda, business analysis or process-management training or certification

Parametric believes each member of our organization makes a significant contribution to our success. That contribution should not be limited by the assigned responsibilities. Therefore, this job description is designed to outline primary duties and qualifications. It is our expectation that every member of our team will offer his/her/their services wherever and whenever necessary to ensure the success of our business.
  
  
**What You Can Expect From Morgan Stanley**
At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients – helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that’s differentiated – and we’ve done that for 90 years. Our values - putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back - aren’t just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80,000 employees in 1,200 offices across 42 countries. At Morgan Stanley, you’ll find an opportunity to work alongside the best and the brightest, in an environment where you are supported and empowered. Our teams are relentless collaborators and creative thinkers, fueled by their diverse backgrounds and experiences. We are proud to support our employees and their families at every point along their work-life journey, offering some of the most attractive and comprehensive employee benefits and perks in the industry. There’s also ample opportunity to move about the business for those who show passion and grit in their work.
  
  
To learn more about our offices across the globe, please copy and paste https://www.morganstanley.com/about-us/global-offices into your browser.
  
  
Morgan Stanley is an equal opportunity employer committed to building and maintaining a workforce that is diverse in experience and background. Our recruiting efforts reflect our strong commitment to a culture of inclusion, where individuals are hired, developed, and advanced based on their skills and talents.
  
  
Our workforce reflects a broad cross-section of the global communities in which we operate, bringing a variety of backgrounds, talents, perspectives, and experiences.
  
  
For more information, please visit: https://www.morganstanley.com/people-opportunities/eeo.

title: Senior Associate
description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they are doing!

*We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.*

Job Description

**Job Profile: Investor Relations Associate / Senior Associate**

Location: Mumbai, India

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an Investor Relations Associate / Senior Associate to support the Investor Relations function at Fractal.

The role will involve investor and analyst-facing coordination, meeting scheduling and logistics, maintaining detailed records of external interactions, supporting valuation and peer benchmarking analysis, and assisting with quarterly earnings and other IR processes.

The ideal candidate should have prior experience in Investor Relations, equity research, capital markets, corporate finance, consulting, or listed-company stakeholder management. The candidate should be organized, detail-oriented, financially literate, and comfortable working with senior internal and external stakeholders. The ability to use AI tools for research, summarization, content preparation, workflow management, and productivity improvement will be an added advantage.

**Key Responsibilities**

**External-Facing Activities**

* ***Investor, Analyst and Market Participant Engagement:***
  Support investor and analyst-facing activities, including meetings, calls, conferences, roadshows, and earnings-related interactions; act as a coordination point for investors, analysts, brokers, conference organizers, and other market participants.
* ***Investor Queries:***
  Handle inbound investor and analyst queries and coordinate internally for timely and appropriate responses.
* ***Investor Feedback:***
  Capture key questions, concerns, feedback, discussion themes, and follow-up items from investor and analyst interactions.
* ***Relationship Tracking:***
  Maintain structured records of investor meetings, analyst interactions, conference participation, action items, and pending responses.

**Internal-Facing Activities**

* ***Management Briefing:***
  Support preparation of management briefing notes ahead of investor and analyst meetings.
* ***Investor Sentiment Updates:***
  Prepare periodic summaries of investor sentiment, analyst feedback, recurring market questions, and key discussion themes for senior management.
* ***Cross-Functional Coordination:***
  Coordinate with finance, legal, secretarial, corporate communications, business, and leadership teams for information required by the IR function.
* ***Quarterly Earnings Support:***
  Support quarterly earnings processes, including timelines, content collation, version control, approval workflows, earnings presentations, Q&A documents, and post-results summaries.
* ***IR Materials:***
  Assist in preparing investor presentations, earnings materials, corporate fact sheets, FAQs, analyst call notes, and other IR communication materials.

**Research, Valuation and Market Intelligence**

* ***Valuation Analysis:***
  Support regular valuation analysis, including peer comparison, trading multiples, historical valuation trends, market benchmarking, and valuation gaps versus peers.
* ***Market and Consensus Tracking:***
  Track company and peer valuation metrics, analyst estimates, consensus expectations, target prices, rating changes, share price performance, and sector valuation trends.
* ***Market Intelligence:***
  Monitor analyst reports, investor commentary, peer updates, sector news, regulatory developments, capital market activity, shareholding patterns, and institutional ownership.
* ***Peer Benchmarking:***
  Prepare competitor benchmarking across financial performance, growth metrics, margins, business mix, AI positioning, and valuation.

**Administration, Process and Documentation**

* ***Scheduling and Logistics:***
  Manage calendars, meeting schedules, invites, meeting links, participant lists, briefing materials, travel coordination, and post-meeting follow-ups.
* ***Interaction Documentation:***
  Maintain detailed notes of all investor, analyst, and market participant interactions, including key questions, feedback, concerns, follow-up items, and management responses.
* ***Trackers and Databases:***
  Maintain structured trackers / CRM for investor contacts, analyst coverage, meetings, conferences, action items, and pending responses.
* ***Process Management:***
  Support IR workflows, timelines, documentation, approvals, record-keeping, and periodic reporting.
* ***Confidentiality and Compliance:***
  Ensure confidentiality and sound judgment while handling company-sensitive, unpublished, or price-sensitive information.

**AI and Productivity Enablement**

* ***AI Tools:***
  Use AI tools to improve efficiency in research, meeting summaries, report preparation, content drafting, market tracking, and workflow automation.
* ***Automation:***
  Identify opportunities to automate repetitive IR tasks such as meeting trackers, follow-up reminders, valuation dashboards, contact databases, and periodic reports.
* ***Responsible AI Usage:***
  Use AI responsibly while maintaining strict confidentiality of unpublished, price-sensitive, and company-sensitive information.

**Desired Candidate Profile**

**Experience**

* 3–5 years of relevant experience preferred.
* Prior Investor Relations experience is preferred.
* Candidates from equity research, investment banking, corporate finance, corporate communications, financial PR, consulting, strategy, or listed-company finance teams may also be considered.
* Experience interacting with investors, analysts, brokers, or capital market stakeholders will be an advantage.

**Skills and Competencies**

* Good understanding of investor relations, capital markets, listed-company communication, financial statements, business metrics, and valuation multiples.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to support valuation analysis, peer benchmarking, and market intelligence.
* Excellent organizational, scheduling, coordination, documentation, and follow-up skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to interact professionally with investors, analysts, brokers, senior management, and cross-functional teams.
* High attention to detail, confidentiality, judgment, and professionalism.
* Ability to manage multiple workstreams, especially during quarterly results cycles.

**Technical Skills**

* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Outlook.
* Ability to build and maintain trackers, dashboards, valuation templates, and investor databases.
* Familiarity with market data platforms, investor databases, CRM tools, or financial databases would be an advantage.
* Ability to use AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Gemini, Perplexity, or similar platforms for productivity, research, and summarization.
* Basic knowledge of automation, dashboards, workflow tools, or data visualization would be useful.

**Educational Qualification**

* Bachelor’s degree in Commerce, Economics, Finance, Business, Management, Engineering, or a related field.
* MBA, CFA, CA, or relevant capital markets / finance certification would be an advantage but is not mandatory.

**Ideal Candidate**

The ideal candidate has worked in or around Investor Relations and is comfortable with investor and analyst-facing coordination. They should be proactive, organized, financially literate, detail-oriented, and able to manage schedules, logistics, meeting preparation, interaction notes, valuation analysis, market tracking, and follow-ups with accuracy and professionalism.

title: Lead Data Analyst
description:
Jump Trading Group is committed to world class research. We empower exceptional talents in Mathematics, Physics, and Computer Science to seek scientific boundaries, push through them, and apply cutting edge research to global financial markets. Our culture is unique. Constant innovation requires fearlessness, creativity, intellectual honesty, and a relentless competitive streak. We believe in winning together and unlocking unique individual talent by incenting collaboration and mutual respect. At Jump, research outcomes drive more than superior risk adjusted returns. We design, develop, and deploy technologies that change our world, fund start-ups across industries, and partner with leading global research organizations and universities to solve problems.
  
  
Our Data team is responsible for building a world class Data Platform with a centralized source of vendor and proprietary research data. We operate in a very dynamic environment utilizing a sophisticated and diverse technology stack. The team interfaces with all aspects of the firm, from Trading, Research, and Technology to Risk, Middle Office and Accounting – providing individuals within the group a full 360-degree view of Jump. Our Proprietary Data team collects and builds research-ready datasets, financial and non-financial, from primary sources, vendors, and public data; cleans, tags, and organizes them with consistent identifiers, taxonomies, and metadata; sources data not available from vendors and evaluates its quality and provenance. It performs deep data analysis, identifies and corrects data quality issues, and surfaces the conventions behind the datasets we use. The team provides human-in-the-loop review for automated and AI-driven pipelines; and partners with engineers to turn manual workflows into repeatable, automated processes.
  
  
This is a senior, hands-on leadership role, working closely with researchers, traders, and engineers across the firm. The role offers the individual the opportunity to develop both business and technical expertise, while significantly contributing to our whole platform.
  
  
What You’ll Do:
  
  

* The ideal candidate will be able to dig into the details of the data and work with end-users to understand their needs and deliver results. We are looking for individuals who are instinctively curious self-starters, demonstrating the ability to independently drive tasks and projects to completion in a team environment. Curiosity, focus, attention to detail, and a genuine enjoyment of learning are essential to this role.
* As Lead Data Analyst, you will lead that team day to day. You will:
* Coordinate the team’s work: translate requests from researchers, traders, and engineers into well-defined projects, set priorities across competing demands, and drive them to completion.
* Own quality: set the standards for how data is collected, tagged, documented, and validated, and review the team’s output before it reaches the researchers and traders who depend on it.
* Guide individual analysts: assign work suited to each analyst’s strengths and development, give regular and specific feedback, and coach them on data research techniques and the effective use of modern AI tools.
* Stay hands-on: take on the most ambiguous and highest-stakes data problems yourself, and model the curiosity and rigor expected of the team.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for the team: understand the business needs, communicate findings and status clearly and concisely, and manage expectations.
* Partner with data engineers to decide which manual workflows to automate and ensure automated and AI-driven pipelines keep appropriate human-in-the-loop review.
* Other duties as assigned or needed.

Skills You'll Need:
  
  

* 7+ years of hands-on experience working with data in the financial industry, at a trading firm, hedge fund, bank, or a vendor serving those institutions.
* 3+ years of experience leading complex projects and other analysts.
* Direct experience collecting, tagging, and cleaning data; experience on a trading firm’s alternative or proprietary data team, or at a vendor selling to such teams, strongly preferred.
* Familiarity and breadth with alternative data, fundamental data, market data, and reference data.
* Expertise in at least one asset class, such as equities, options, futures, ETFs, or FX, including its data and market conventions.
* Strong proficiency in Python, SQL, and Excel for data analysis and manipulation.
* Experience using modern AI tools, such as LLMs, agents, and coding assistants, to accelerate data collection, cleaning, tagging, and research.
* Exceptional attention to detail, with a focused and methodical approach to work.
* Deep curiosity about data and the markets and businesses behind it; enjoys learning and picks up new domains and tools quickly.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to communicate concisely to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Reliable and predictable availability.

title: Senior Analyst - Supply Chain Advanced Analytics
description:
**Company Overview**
We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.
  
  
**Overview**
In this role, the Senior Analyst key responsibilities involve leveraging data science to solve supply chain challenges. This includes data analysis, model development (descriptive, diagnostic, predictive, prescriptive), and scenario planning. Focus to improve modelling efficiency through automation and mentor junior analysts. Finally, independently manage moderately complex projects to deliver timely and impactful solutions. This role requires you to operate in 1.30 pm to 10.30 pm shift.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**

* Translate supply chain business objectives into analytical scope, assess data feasibility, and define success criteria.
* Cleanse and explore data to identify trends and root causes, then develop statistical, optimization, or machine learning models.
* Conduct scenario planning and sensitivity analysis while independently managing moderately complex analytical projects to deliver impactful solutions.
* Improve modelling efficiency through automation, eliminate redundant workflows, and mentor analysts by validating analytical deliverables.

**Domain Expertise**

* Plan: Supply and production planning; capacity, demand, and inventory planning; make-versus-buy decisions; service-level optimization and cost trade-offs.
* Source: Procurement process optimization; cost-saving and efficiency opportunities; financial, geopolitical, and environmental, social, and governance risk assessment; supplier sustainability and carbon-footprint tracking.
* Manufacturing and Engineering (MaKE): Manufacturing performance improvement and waste reduction; failure-mode analysis; anomaly detection; predictive maintenance; root-cause analysis; predictive and prescriptive downtime reduction.
* Network: Network design and distribution; facility location; greenfield and brownfield analysis; transportation and logistics planning; route optimization; cross-docking; push, pull, and postponement replenishment strategies.
* End-to-End & Operating Unit: Understanding of the Plan, Make, Source, and Deliver pillars; ability to connect cross-functional priorities; holistic solution mindset; awareness of key supply chain metrics, including service, cost of goods sold, and waste.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree from accredited university (Full Time) in Business Analytics, engineering, statistics or a related quantitative field.
* Experience: 3+ years of related experience in Supply chain analytics
* Technical Skills: Any optimization tool like Supply Chain Guru/Optilogic/Any logic (Nice to have)
* Python, Dash or similar visualization tools, SQL, and cloud platforms such as BigQuery
* Knowledge of statistical modeling, optimization, machine learning
* Proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint, leveraging advanced functions for data analysis, visualization, and effective business storytelling

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Post graduation in Industrial Engineering, statistics or Supply Chain operations
* Professional Certifications for supply chain and Data science

**ELIGIBILITY**
Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

* Independently lead discovery and requirement workshops with business stakeholders, subject matter experts, product owners, developers, architects, data teams, and quality assurance teams.
* Understand business problems, objectives, processes, data needs, and user outcomes; translate them into well-structured functional and non-functional requirements.
* Create and maintain business requirement documents, functional specifications, process flows, data flows, user stories, use cases, acceptance criteria, decision logs, and requirements traceability.
* Break down complex requirements into clear, prioritized, sprint-ready user stories that are understandable to both business and technical teams.
* Perform impact, dependency, feasibility, gap, and data analysis for new capabilities, enhancements, defects, and change requests.
* Lead requirement walkthroughs and clarify functional questions throughout design, development, testing, and implementation.
* Use SQL and other analysis techniques, where required, to validate data, investigate issues, support requirements, and confirm expected outcomes.
* Own functional quality for assigned initiatives, ensuring that delivered solutions remain aligned to approved business needs and acceptance criteria.
* Plan and support system testing, business validation, and user acceptance testing, including test scenarios, test data, defect triage, evidence, sign-off, and deployment of readiness.
* Maintain solution documentation and support-controlled transition into production, user communication, training, change management, and post-release validation.

Key Responsibilities - Scrum & Agile Delivery
  
  

* Partner with the Product Owner and delivery team to maintain a healthy, prioritized, and sufficiently refined product backlog.
* Facilitate or support Scrum events as needed, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
* Prepare stories for refinement by confirming business value, scope, dependencies, assumptions, acceptance criteria, and readiness before commitment.
* Help the team establish a realistic sprint goal and maintain shared understanding of committed outcomes.
* Track story progress, decisions, blockers, dependencies, risks, and actions; proactively coordinate resolution and escalate matters that may affect delivery.
* Protect requirement clarity during the sprint by managing questions and controlled changes without introducing avoidable disruption or scope ambiguity.
* Coordinate business participation in sprint reviews and demonstrations, capture feedback, and convert agreed feedback into prioritized backlog items.
* Use delivery measures and team feedback to identify opportunities to improve requirement quality, flow, predictability, and ways of working.
* Promote Scrum principles of transparency, inspection, adaptation, accountability, and continuous improvement while remaining practical and outcome focused.
* Where a dedicated Scrum Master is not assigned, provide day-to-day Scrum coordination for the project while continuing to own BSA responsibilities. This role supports team effectiveness and does not replace people management responsibilities.

Independent Project Ownership
  
  

* Take end-to-end functional ownership of small to medium initiatives, or a clearly defined workstream within a larger programme, with limited supervision.
* Build and maintain a delivery view covering scope, milestones, backlog readiness, dependencies, risks, decisions, testing, stakeholder actions, and implementation readiness.
* Coordinate across globally distributed and matrixed teams, ensuring that the right stakeholders are engaged at the right stage.
* Identify ambiguity early, present options and recommendations, drive timely decisions, and document agreed outcomes.
* Balance business value, user needs, data availability, technical feasibility, quality, and delivery timelines when recommending an approach.
* Provide concise, fact-based status updates to project leadership and stakeholders, including progress, risks, decisions required, and proposed next steps.
* Contribute reusable templates, standards, frameworks, and lessons learned to strengthen Business Analysis and Agile delivery practices.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 8+ years of experience in business analysis, systems analysis, technology implementation, or a closely related role.
* Demonstrated experience independently managing requirements and functional delivery across the full lifecycle, from discovery through production implementation.
* Strong hands-on experience with Agile and Scrum delivery, including backlog refinement, user story development, acceptance criteria, sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives, and impediment or dependency tracking.
* Experience working directly with business stakeholders, product owners, developers, architects, data teams, and quality assurance teams in a cross-functional environment.
* Experience creating functional documentation, process and data flows, requirements traceability, test scenarios, and user acceptance testing plans.
* Working knowledge of data concepts, system integrations, relational data structures, and data validation; practical SQL capability is strongly preferred.
* Experience with common work management and documentation tools such as Azure DevOps or Jira and Confluence or equivalent platforms.
* Experience working with globally distributed teams and managing multiple priorities in a complex, matrixed environment.

Core Skills & Behaviors
  
  

* Strong analytical thinking, structured problem solving, attention to detail, and ability to connect business requirements with system behavior.
* Ability to simplify complex concepts, ask effective questions, challenge constructively, and communicate recommendations clearly.
* Confident workshop facilitation, stakeholder management, negotiation, presentation, and written communication skills.
* Strong ownership mindset with the ability to work independently, organize work, follow through on commitments, and maintain momentum across teams.
* Ability to manage changing priorities calmly, make progress despite ambiguity, and escalate with context and options rather than only highlighting problems.
* Collaborative and service-oriented approach, with a focus on business value, delivery quality, shared accountability, and positive stakeholder outcomes.

**Preferred**

* Professional Scrum Master, Certified ScrumMaster, Professional Scrum Product Owner, PMI-PBA, IIBA-CBAP/CCBA, or comparable certification.
* Experience with enterprise platforms, data management, master data management, integrations, reporting, or business intelligence solutions.

title: Associate - Risk Controls - Market Risk
description:
**Position Overview**

Associate – Risk and Controls within the Market Operations department (Product Control/COCE). The role is part of the Risk Control group within the V&RC organization, focusing on monitoring end-of-day and intraday risk limits, ensuring compliance with trader mandates, and managing the escalation and reporting of breaches.

**Job Responsibilities**

* **Risk Control Framework:**
  Contribute to the execution, analysis, and coordination of End-of-day and Intraday Risk Limits and Trader Mandates.
* **Breach Management:**
  Investigate, understand, and promptly escalate daily limit and mandate breaches in accordance with global policy; document all findings in daily, weekly, and monthly summary reports and dashboards.
* **Stakeholder Interaction:**
  Collaborate with Traders, Front Office management, Risk, Operations, and IT to understand risk computation methodologies and resolve discrepancies between Front Office and Risk systems.
* **Mandate Management:**
  Understand mandate characteristics across asset classes, investigate policy breaches, and coordinate global updates to mandate systems or reconciliation logic.
* **Regulatory Compliance:**
  Implement new controls and processes arising from regulatory changes (e.g., Volcker, French Banking Law).
* **Permanent Control:**
  Contribute to the broader Permanent Control framework and ensure control exhaustiveness and thorough documentation of changes.

**Required Education, Skills and Experience (must have)**

* **Education:**
  Bachelor or Master Degree in Economics, Mathematics, or Finance.
* **Experience:**
  2+ years of relevant financial industry experience.
* **Technical Skills:**
  Strong IT skills including intermediate to advanced Excel, VBA, and PowerPoint.
* **Communication:**
  Fluency in English (both oral and written) with the ability to communicate effectively to diverse audiences (Senior management, Trading, IT, Audit, etc.).
* **Core Competencies:**
  Strong control-oriented mindset, high attention to detail, and the ability to thrive under tight deadlines and pressure.

**Preferred Education, Skills and Experience (nice to have)**

* **Domain Knowledge:**
  Prior experience in Risk, P&L, Product Control, or Audit; practical understanding of option theory and ability to explain pricing parameters (particularly Equity Options).
* **Product Knowledge:**
  Working knowledge across a wide range of asset classes, with a preference for Equities.
* **Mathematical Proficiency:**
  Technically strong in financial mathematics complemented by market practice knowledge.
* **Soft Skills:**
  Project coordination skills and a results/solutions-driven mindset capable of building consensus.

title: Supply Chain Executive
description:
**Company: Eume Lifestyle Pvt. Ltd.**

**Department:**
Supply Chain & Operations

**Location:**
Andheri, Mumbai

**Experience:**
2–5 years preferred

**Key requirement:**
Advanced, end-to-end Unicommerce (Uniware) expertise

**About the Role**

We are looking for a highly skilled supply chain professional (with preferred Unicommerce/Uniware expertise) who can take end-to-end ownership of our Unicommerce operations, identify process gaps, resolve complex system and operational issues, and implement robust, scalable processes.

This is not just a system-operating role. We need a problem solver and process owner who can investigate root causes, explore system capabilities, implement effective solutions, and establish preventive controls to avoid recurring problems.

**1. End-to-End Unicommerce Management**

·      Manage and optimise all Unicommerce modules and workflows.

·      Handle purchase order (PO) creation, goods receipt notes (GRN), inwarding, stock transfers, and inventory adjustments.

·      Manage product listing, cataloguing, SKU creation, SKU mapping, and channel integrations.

·      Oversee sales order creation, order processing, fulfilment, returns, and inventory reconciliation.

·      Ensure seamless data flow between Unicommerce, warehouses, marketplaces, Shopify, and integrated systems.

**2. Problem Solving & Process Improvement**

·      Deep-dive into operational and system issues to identify root causes.

·      Explore existing Unicommerce features, configurations, and alternative workflows to resolve challenges.

·      Develop permanent solutions rather than temporary fixes.

·      Establish SOPs, preventive controls, and automated checks to minimise recurring errors.

·      Identify opportunities for automation, process simplification, and operational efficiency.

·      Coordinate with Unicommerce support and internal teams for technical issue resolution.

**3. Inventory Management & Demand Planning**

·      Ensure accurate inventory mapping across SKUs, warehouses, and sales channels.

·      Monitor stock discrepancies, inventory movements, and reconciliation.

·      Support inventory planning, demand forecasting, and stock availability analysis using Unicommerce data.

·      Develop reporting for stock ageing, inventory accuracy, stockouts, and inventory health.

**4. Data Analysis & Cost Optimisation**

·      Extract, analyse, and interpret operational data from Unicommerce.

·      Analyse inventory, order processing, fulfilment, and supply chain costs.

·      Build dashboards and MIS reports to monitor key operational KPIs.

·      Identify inefficiencies, data inconsistencies, and cost-saving opportunities.

·      Translate data insights into actionable process improvements.

**5. System Integration & Process Governance**

·      Manage marketplace, website, warehouse, and logistics integrations within Unicommerce.

·      Troubleshoot order sync failures, inventory mismatches, SKU mapping issues, and integration errors.

·      Conduct regular process audits and ensure adherence to SOPs.

·      Train internal teams on Unicommerce workflows and best practices.

·      Drive continuous improvement in system utilisation and operational accuracy.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

·      Mandatory: Excellent hands-on, end-to-end knowledge of Unicommerce (Uniware).

·      Strong expertise in PO, GRN, cataloguing, channel integration, order management, inventory management, and reporting.

·      Experience troubleshooting complex Unicommerce issues independently.

·      Strong analytical, root-cause analysis, and problem-solving skills.

·      Advanced Excel / Google Sheets skills for data and cost analysis.

·      Good understanding of e-commerce, D2C, marketplaces, warehouse operations, and supply chain processes.

·      Ability to develop SOPs, implement process controls, and improve operational efficiency.

·      Strong coordination and communication skills.

**What Success Looks Like**

·      High inventory and order data accuracy across channels.

·      Faster resolution of Unicommerce issues with minimal recurrence.

·      Standardised, documented, and scalable supply chain processes.

·      Reduced manual intervention, operational errors, and system inefficiencies.

·      Improved visibility into inventory, demand, fulfilment, and costs.

·      Maximum utilisation of Unicommerce capabilities to support business growth.

title: Business Administration (MBA) - AI Content Specialist
description:
**About The Role**
What if your MBA — your hard-won expertise in finance, strategy, and operations — could directly shape how AI advises the next generation of business leaders and executives?
  
  
We're looking for MBA-qualified professionals to challenge, evaluate, and improve advanced AI models on the toughest questions in business. You'll stress-test AI reasoning across corporate finance, market strategy, supply chain, and organizational behavior — and build the gold-standard solutions that make these models smarter, sharper, and genuinely useful at the executive level.
  
  
This is a fully remote, flexible contract role. No AI background needed — just deep business expertise and a rigorous analytical mind.
  
  

* Organization: Alignerr
* Type: Hourly Contract
* Location: Remote
* Commitment: 10–40 hours/week

**What You'll Do**

* Design Complex Business Challenges — Craft advanced case studies and quantitative problems spanning DCF valuation, market entry strategy, operations bottlenecks, cap table modeling, and more
* Author Gold-Standard Solutions — Write rigorous, step-by-step responses — complete with financial statements, strategic frameworks (4Ps, 5Cs, Porter's Five Forces), and executive-level rationales — that serve as training benchmarks for AI models
* Audit AI Business Reasoning — Evaluate AI-generated business plans, financial forecasts, and case analyses for logical consistency, mathematical accuracy, and adherence to professional standards
* Refine and Correct AI Thinking — Identify flawed reasoning such as sunk cost errors, miscalculated WACC, or failure to account for macroeconomic variables, and provide structured, actionable feedback

**Who You Are**

* Holder of a Master of Business Administration (MBA) from an accredited institution
* Strong foundational knowledge across at least two core business disciplines: Finance, Marketing, Operations, or Strategic Management
* Skilled at synthesizing complex data into clear, executive-style recommendations
* Exceptionally detail-oriented — you catch formula errors, logical inconsistencies, and weak arguments others miss
* Comfortable working independently and asynchronously on your own schedule
* No prior AI or tech experience required

**Nice to Have**

* Prior experience in management consulting, investment banking, or corporate strategy
* Background in data annotation, quality assurance, or evaluation systems
* Proficiency in data-driven decision tools such as Excel financial modeling, Tableau, or SQL
* Experience writing case studies, executive reports, or business school curriculum

**Why Join Us**

* Work directly with industry-leading AI research labs on cutting-edge projects
* Fully remote and flexible — work when and where it suits you
* Freelance autonomy with meaningful, intellectually stimulating work
* Apply your MBA expertise to a field that is actively reshaping the global business landscape
* Potential for ongoing work and contract extension as new projects launch

Your insights will influence decisions for some of today’s leading global companies.

**Job Description**

* Managing clients and their respective projects custom research team in matters of market research based on experience in the T&D/ Media industry
* Reporting to a project lead, you will be responsible for the successful execution of customized quantitative studies, including project costing, questionnaire design, project management and execution, analysis and report writing.

**Project Management**

* Coordinating project task activities between your project team and internal support/operations team(s)

* Designing questionnaires/focus group screeners/interview guides to meet the specific or unique client objectives
* Synthesis and communication of both primary and secondary research findings into actionable insights according to the client’s objectives
* Full reporting and analysis (via PowerPoint): Interpreting and analysing multivariate data, drawing insightful conclusions and providing recommendations, where applicable

**Additional Information**

**About NIQ**

NIQ is the world’s leading consumer intelligence company, delivering the most complete understanding of consumer buying behavior and revealing new pathways to growth.
