title: Climate Nature & Social Risk Integration Analyst - Mumbai
description:
**Job Description**
**Job Description**
JP Morgan Chase (JPMC) is committed to understanding how climate change may drive or influence the risks we identify and manage. This includes evaluating how our business and the activities of our clients and customers could be impacted through transition and/or physical risks driven by climate change. The Firm's dedicated Climate, Nature and Social (CN&S) Risk team, which is led by our Firmwide Risk Executive for Climate Risk, is responsible for establishing the firmwide framework and strategy for climate risk management, developing and advancing climate risk policy and standards, and building our approach to climate risk data. The CN&S Risk team collaborates with stakeholders across the Firm to integrate climate considerations into line-of-business risk management frameworks.
  
  
As an Analyst in the CN&S Risk team, you will support the integration of climate, nature, and social risk considerations into the Firm's risk management frameworks, with a focus on research, insight synthesis, and regulatory change delivery across stakeholders.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a self-starter with impeccable attention to detail, capable of articulating their thoughts clearly both verbally and in written communications. This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to a rapidly evolving field within the financial services industry, with high focus and visibility within J.P. Morgan.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Monitor emerging CN&S regulatory developments and trends; assess implications for the Bank's regional franchise and translate them into clear compliance requirements and implementation plans.
* Coordinate cross-functional delivery of regulatory change, including socializing updates, supporting impact assessments, tracking actions/milestones, and ensuring alignment with Firmwide framework.
* Support integration of CN&S considerations into risk management frameworks (policies, processes, controls, metrics, and reporting) in partnership with Risk, Compliance, Legal, Finance, and the business.
* Develop high-quality presentations, briefs, and working materials for stakeholders and senior forums; communicate technical and quantitative content clearly and succinctly.
* Support enhancement of CN&S risk analytics by identifying emerging regulatory themes that may translate into supervisory expectations, enabling proactive impact assessment, and readiness across lines of business.

**Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**

* Master's degree in economics, Finance, Environmental Science, or related field.
* Strong ability to synthesize technical information into clear, accurate takeaways for senior audiences.
* Understanding of financial institutions and climate-related financial risk concepts.
* Strong ownership, critical thinking, and attention to detail; able to deliver to tight timelines.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills; experience building presentations and concise briefs.

**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities And Skills**

* 1–2 years of experience in financial services, risk, compliance, or regulatory change.
* Exposure to climate risk, sustainability, or regulatory implementation/change management.
* Experience using LLM/AI tools to improve research, summarization, and analysis (subject to Bank-approved tooling and controls).

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. title: Senior Wholesale Credit Risk Researcher, SVP (Hybrid)
description:
Citi is seeking a Senior Wholesale Credit Risk Researcher to lead high-impact credit risk analysis and research across the wholesale banking portfolio, informing decisions that directly influence how the firm identifies, measures, and manages credit exposure. This is a senior individual contributor role where your research shapes risk frameworks, informs senior leadership, and contributes to the governance structures that underpin Citi's wholesale lending activities. If you bring deep expertise in wholesale credit risk and a track record of translating complex analysis into clear, actionable insight, this role offers the scope and visibility to make a genuine difference.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Conduct in-depth credit risk research across the wholesale banking portfolio, producing assessments that enable senior leadership to make well-informed risk decisions.
* Develop and enhance risk measurement methodologies to ensure Citi's approach to wholesale credit risk remains rigorous, current, and aligned with evolving market conditions.
* Analyze credit portfolios to identify emerging risk concentrations, trends, and vulnerabilities, translating findings into clear recommendations for risk mitigation.
* Monitor credit risk trends across wholesale counterparties and sectors, ensuring the firm maintains an accurate and up-to-date view of its credit exposures.
* Produce high-quality risk assessment reports and research outputs that communicate complex findings in a clear, structured format for senior stakeholders.
* Engage directly with senior business and risk leaders to present research conclusions, discuss implications, and inform strategic risk decisions.
* Contribute to the development and ongoing refinement of credit risk governance frameworks, ensuring research outputs are embedded into risk oversight processes.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

* Deep expertise in wholesale credit risk research, analysis, or a closely related discipline gained within a financial services environment.
* Demonstrated ability to develop and enhance credit risk measurement methodologies, with a solid grounding in quantitative and qualitative analytical techniques.
* Strong analytical capability, with the ability to interpret complex credit data, identify material risk themes, and draw well-reasoned conclusions.
* Clear and confident communicator, able to present nuanced credit risk findings in writing and in person to senior and executive-level audiences.
* Familiarity with wholesale credit risk governance frameworks and the regulatory environment governing credit risk management in banking.
* Ability to manage multiple research workstreams simultaneously, delivering high-quality outputs within defined timelines without compromising rigour

**What We Offer**
At Citi, senior researchers in wholesale credit risk work at the heart of one of the world's most significant financial institutions, with direct access to complex, high-stakes subject matter and the leadership teams who act on it. This is an environment that rewards analytical rigour, rewards ownership, and offers genuine scope to shape how credit risk is understood and managed at scale.
  
  

* A hybrid working model with 3 days in the office and 2 days working remotely, providing structure alongside meaningful flexibility.
* Direct exposure to senior risk and business leadership, with your research informing decisions at the highest levels of the firm.
* The opportunity to influence credit risk governance frameworks that have real consequences for Citi's wholesale portfolio and strategic direction.
* Access to Citi's global network of risk professionals, supporting ongoing learning and long-term career development in wholesale credit.
* A performance-driven environment that recognizes intellectual contribution, accountability, and delivery of high-quality analytical work.
* Comprehensive wellbeing support and a genuine commitment to work-life balance at all levels of the organization.

Join Citi as a Senior Wholesale Credit Risk Researcher and apply your expertise where it matters most — shaping the credit risk intelligence that guides one of the world's leading financial institutions.

* Define, document, prioritize, and test data and functional requirements for the Trade Surveillance platform, balancing exchange needs, technical feasibility, and business value across the full product lifecycle.
* Partner with cross-jurisdictional Surveillance teams across Europe and the US, working closely with Commercial and System Engineering teams on project planning, requirements gathering and tracking, remove delivery impediments, and ensure work aligns with product design principles
* Engage directly with Risk, Compliance, and Audit teams to validate and review requirements, ensure clarity, and drive alignment on enhancements and issue resolution.

title: Risk Analytics - Audit Analytics - Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Senior – Audit Analytics**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
As a Senior – Audit Analytics, you will support the delivery of data analytics solutions across Internal Audit, risk and controls engagements. You will work with large and complex enterprise datasets to develop, validate and visualize analytics that help identify risk indicators, control exceptions and process improvement opportunities.
  
  
The role requires strong hands-on analytical capabilities and the ability to translate audit and business requirements into scalable analytical solutions using technologies such as SQL, Python, Power BI, ETL tools and modern data platforms including Databricks and Snowflake. You will also have opportunities to contribute to technology-enabled Internal Audit transformation, including automation, Continuous Controls Monitoring (CCM), and AI/GenAI-enabled analytics.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Perform data extraction, transformation, profiling and analysis using SQL, Python and ETL tools/techniques.
* Develop and execute audit analytics, exception testing and risk-based analytical procedures across enterprise processes.
* Build interactive dashboards and reporting solutions using Power BI to communicate analytical findings, exceptions and risk insights.
* Work with large and complex datasets across modern data platforms such as Databricks and/or Snowflake.
* Perform data quality checks, reconciliations and validation to ensure the completeness and accuracy of analytical outputs.
* Translate audit, risk and business requirements into analytical logic, data requirements and test scenarios.
* Collaborate with Internal Audit, business, technology and data teams to understand processes, identify relevant data sources and deliver analytics.
* Document data logic, transformation steps, assumptions and analytical procedures to support repeatability and auditability.
* Support technology-enabled Internal Audit transformation initiatives, including analytics, automation and Continuous Controls Monitoring.
* Identify opportunities to leverage AI/GenAI and Large Language Models (LLMs) within analytics, audit and risk management use cases.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Strong hands-on experience with SQL, including complex queries, joins, aggregations, data profiling and analytical logic.
* Strong hands-on experience with Python for data analysis, transformation, statistical modelling, automation and development of scalable analytical solutions.
* Strong understanding of ETL concepts, data transformation and working with data from multiple source systems.
* Hands-on experience developing dashboards and analytical reporting solutions using Power BI.
* Experience working with data warehousing and modern data platforms such as Databricks and/or Snowflake.
* Strong data analysis, reconciliation and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work effectively with large and complex datasets.
* Ability to understand business, audit and risk requirements and translate them into structured analytical tests and actionable outputs.
* Strong communication and documentation skills, with the ability to explain analytical approaches and findings to business and audit stakeholders.
* Exposure to AI/GenAI solutions and Large Language Models (LLMs) and their application across analytics, audit and risk management.
* Ability to work collaboratively across multidisciplinary teams and manage assigned analytical deliverables.
* Understand common business and technology processes such as Procure-to-Pay (P2P/PTP), Order-to-Cash (O2C/OTC), Travel & Expense (T&E), ITGC and SOX controls.
* Have an understanding of risks, controls, KRIs and exception-based audit testing.
* Have exposure to enterprise systems and datasets such as SAP, Oracle, Workday, expense platforms, GRC tools or other ERP environments.
* Have experience or exposure to Internal Audit transformation initiatives involving analytics, automation or technology-enabled auditing.
* We are looking for a hands-on analytics professional who combines strong technical capabilities with an understanding of risk, controls and Internal Audit. You should be comfortable working with complex enterprise datasets, developing analytical solutions independently and translating technical findings into meaningful risk and business insights.
* You should bring a problem-solving mindset, strong attention to data quality and the ability to collaborate effectively with audit, business, data and technology stakeholders.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  
**Our Commitment:**
As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development:**
From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture:**
In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits:**
Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How to Apply**
: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
  
  
Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Right Shore, Revenue Planning Analyst
description:
**Right Shore Revenue Planning Analyst**
Full Time | Hybrid
  
  
Location: Airoli, Navi Mumbai, India | Pune, Maharashtra, India
  
  
Team: Right Shore Sales Operations
  
  
Reports to: Right Shore Sales Operations Team Leader
  
  
Dotted line to: Manager, Revenue Planning Programs & Strategy
  
  
**Our Company**
At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
As Right Shore Revenue Planning Analyst, you are the dedicated data owner for Teradata’s revenue planning process. You sit within the Right Shore Sales Operations team and work day to day with the Manager, Revenue Planning Programs & Strategy to run the data engine behind the annual planning cycle and the year-round change process that keeps the plan accurate.
  
  
This is a data management and processing role. You build and manage the planning templates, consolidate and reconcile submissions from across the business units, keep account and assignment data clean, and take real ownership of the final business build files that hand off into Salesforce, downstream tools and IT processes. You are the last set of eyes before planning data leaves the process — accuracy is the job.
  
  
The planning calendar moves, priorities shift, and questions arrive without warning. This role suits someone who adapts quickly, can go deep into the detail of the planning process when something does not reconcile, and takes personal pride in a clean file.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the final business build files: Assemble, validate and own the definitive build files for territory, account assignment, headcount and quota that feed Salesforce, downstream tools and IT processes. Run the pre-handoff checks, resolve exceptions, and sign off on what goes out.
* Build and manage planning templates: Develop, version, distribute and support the planning templates used by business unit teams; track submissions, chase gaps, and consolidate returns into a single reconciled dataset.
* Maintain account data quality: Keep account data accurate and audit-ready — account hierarchy, duplicate records, ARR category changes, ownership and assignment accuracy — through scheduled audits, exception reports and remediation.
* Process territory and assignment changes: Process and validate territory, account and people assignments in Salesforce, including Enterprise Territory Management and hierarchy changes, ensuring every change is traceable and correctly reflected.
* Support the annual revenue planning cycle: Work to the calendar and cadence set by the Manager, Revenue Planning Programs & Strategy — preparing datasets, running the consolidation, and turning around iterations at pace during planning crunch.
* Maintain headcount, coverage and quota datasets: Keep the planning datasets current and reconciled across planning, Salesforce and Finance views, and maintain the change history behind them.
* Process in-year change requests: Handle mid-year changes to territories, account assignments and quotas — validating the request, applying the change, and keeping the audit trail intact.
* Produce planning status and exception reporting: Deliver recurring completeness, status and data-quality reporting so the Manager and business unit teams always know where the cycle stands and what needs attention.
* Go deep when required: Trace a number back to source, unpick a discrepancy across systems, or rebuild a broken file under time pressure — and explain clearly what went wrong and what you changed.
* Document the work: Maintain data definitions, file specifications, run instructions and change logs so the process is repeatable and does not depend on one person’s memory.

**Who You'll Work With**

* Manager, Revenue Planning Programs & Strategy — your day-to-day business partner and dotted-line manager
* Right Shore Sales Operations Team Leader — your direct manager
* UNIT Sales Operations Managers (SOMs) and business unit teams
* Revenue Operations, IT and Salesforce delivery teams
* FP&A and People/HR planning partners

**Minimum Requirements**

* 3–5 years of experience in sales operations, revenue operations, sales planning, or a data management role supporting a sales organization.
* Advanced Excel is essential — complex interconnected workbooks, pivot tables, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, nested formulas, template design, data consolidation and validation across large datasets.
* Proficiency in Salesforce. com, including territory and account hierarchy management, assignment processing, data quality management, and running and interrogating reports.
* Exceptional attention to detail, with the discipline to check your own work and the instinct to notice when a number looks wrong.
* Demonstrated ownership of a data deliverable end to end — not just producing it, but being accountable for its accuracy downstream.
* Ability to work to a fixed planning calendar and absorb shifting priorities without losing the thread.
* Clear written and verbal communication in English, with the confidence to flag a problem early and ask the question that unblocks the work.
* Comfort collaborating across time zones with US and EMEA stakeholders.
* Bachelor’s degree in business or a related field (finance, statistics, analytics, reporting).

**What You'll Bring**

* Ownership of the Build File: You treat the final build file as yours. You know what depends on it, you check it before anyone else has to, and you do not hand over work you are not confident in.
* Adaptability: Planning priorities change quickly. You re-sequence, absorb new requirements, and keep moving without needing the plan re-explained.
* Depth on Demand: You can drop into the mechanics of the planning process when something does not reconcile, and follow the data until you find the cause.
* Data Quality Instinct: A low tolerance for dirty data, and the habits — reconciliation, validation, exception reporting — that keep it clean rather than fixing it after the fact.
* Process Discipline: You follow the standard, document what you do, and leave the process better than you found it.
* Practical AI fluency: Comfort using a leading AI assistant (Claude preferred; ChatGPT or Gemini also relevant) to speed up data preparation, reconciliation, documentation and repetitive processing work — with the judgement to verify the output.
* Power BI experience or certification would be an added advantage.
* Familiarity with sales planning or incentive compensation platforms (Anaplan, Lative, Xactly, Varicent or equivalent) would be an added advantage.

**Why We Think You’ll Love Teradata**
We prioritize a people-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. We are an anti-racist company because our dedication to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion is more than a statement. It is a deep commitment to doing the work to foster an equitable environment that celebrates people for all of who they are.
  
  
Teradata invites all identities and backgrounds in the workplace. We work with deliberation and intent to ensure we are cultivating collaboration and inclusivity across our global organization. ​ We are proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, color, ancestry, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related conditions), national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, gender identity or expression, military and veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

title: Quantitative Researcher(unpaid)
description:
**Role:**
Quantitative Researcher (Contract)

**Company:**
Meridian Capital

**Location:**
100% Remote (India)

**Format:**
3-Month Live Project

**About Meridian Capital**

Meridian Capital is a proprietary algorithmic trading firm actively operating in the Indian stock market. We execute our strategies through a fully automated, end-to-end systematic trading platform designed to identify and exploit market inefficiencies with zero manual intervention required for trade execution.

**The Role & Challenge**

We are seeking a sharp, highly analytical, and results-driven Quantitative Researcher for a specialized 3-month contract. Your primary objective will be to audit, stress-test, and extensively optimize the mathematical and logical foundation of our current trading algorithm to maximize our market edge.

This engagement is strictly performance-oriented and structured around two core phases:

* **Phase 1 (The 2-Week Sprint):**
  Within the first 14 days of engagement, evaluate our existing quantitative logic and deliver at least one profitable, mathematically robust model that we can immediately deploy into live trading environments.
* **Phase 2 (Ongoing Optimization):**
  For the remainder of the 3-month contract, shift focus toward developing advanced quantitative metrics, refining statistical models, and continuously optimizing the system for peak performance and risk mitigation.

**Target Performance Metrics**

Optimization efforts must be engineered to achieve or exceed the following benchmarks:

* **Sharpe Ratio:**
  > 1.5
* **Sortino Ratio:**
  > 1.8
* **Win Rate:**
  45% or greater
* **Monthly Return:**
  Minimum 5% consistent growth

**Compensation & Profit Sharing**

This role is highly leveraged toward performance, rewarding the specific alpha you generate directly.

* **Fixed Stipend:**
  ₹5,000 per month (paid upon initial verification of a profitable, working algorithm).
* **Performance Share (30%):**
  You will receive 30% of all trading profits generated by the firm. This profit share activates the moment your quantitative logic is deployed in our live algorithm and remains in effect for the entire duration of your engagement with Meridian Capital.

**Must-Have Qualifications**

* Strong academic foundation in Mathematics, Statistics, Quantitative Finance, Computer Science, or a heavily quantitative engineering discipline.
* Proven, hands-on experience in statistical modeling, backtesting frameworks, and algorithmic trading logic.
* Deep, intuitive understanding of risk-adjusted return metrics (e.g., Sharpe, Sortino, Calmar, Maximum Drawdown).
* Ability to rapidly prototype, stress-test, and deploy mathematical logic tailored for financial markets under tight deadlines.
* Strong working knowledge of Indian stock market dynamics, market micro-structure, and historical market data handling.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Proficiency in Python, R, or C++ for extensive quantitative analysis and data manipulation.
* Prior experience building, auditing, or optimizing end-to-end systematic trading strategies from scratch.
* A pragmatic, objective mindset that prioritizes live-market applicability and robust execution over theoretical perfection.

title: Quantitative Risk Manager
description:
IMC is looking for a Quantitative Risk Manager to join our growing Risk team in Mumbai. You will identify and assess risks across our trading activities, design appropriate controls, and build the metrics and tools we use to monitor market and operational risk
  
  
**Your Core Responsibilities**

* Monitor and measure the market risk exposure of our trading activities, partnering closely with trading desks to recommend strategy adjustments and risk mitigation ahead of adverse events
* Build independent backtesting models to challenge trading strategies, evaluating performance with risk-adjusted metrics such as Sharpe, Sortino and Calmar ratios
* Track market developments and the macro calendar, and run stress tests and scenario analyses to assess potential impacts on the trading book
* Utilize Python-based tools and libraries for stress testing, and scenario analysis as well as generally designing and contributing to local risk management tooling
* Work with global risk, trading, software development and data engineering teams to design and deploy risk controls within IMC’s proprietary global risk management and trading systems
* Drive the operational incident management process with key stakeholders to structurally improve infrastructure, processes and governance
* Ensure adherence to regulatory requirements and internal risk policies
* Train and support traders on risk tools, methodologies and best practices

**Your Skills And Experience**

* 3+ years of relevant experience in capital markets, e.g. at a trading firm, bank or asset manager
* Bachelor's or master's degree in a quantitative field, with strong academic performance
* FRM/ CFA/ CQF preferred but not required
* Proficiency in Python, with demonstrated experience in data analysis, scripting, and dashboard or tool development
* Strong understanding of options theory, including Greeks, volatility, and pricing dynamics
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence to challenge traders constructively
* A proactive problem-solver who thrives in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment
* Experience analysing and managing risk across a portfolio of equities, futures, and options
* Familiarity with stress testing methodologies and risk management frameworks

**About Us**
*IMC is a research-driven trading firm where quantitative modeling, machine learning, and engineering shape how modern markets are traded. A stabilizing force in markets since 1989, we provide liquidity across trading venues, delivering the best outcome in value and risk management to investors. Using our own technology and capital, we build proprietary systems and algorithms that operate across global markets. Our researchers, traders, and engineers work as a collective, combining rapid experimentation, advanced infrastructure, and real-time feedback to turn insight into execution and execution into advantage.*

title: Valuation Governance, Associate, Tech & Ops
description:
**About This Role**
**Team Overview**
BlackRock Data Services (BDS) is entrusted with maintaining all data integral to the investment decision process, for BlackRock the Investment Manager and its BlackRock Solutions (BRS) business, in our proprietary Aladdin® end-to-end investment platform. BDS closely partners with teams, such as Portfolio Management, Global Capital Markets, Relationship Management, Portfolio Compliance, Risk Analytics, Regulatory Reporting, and others, to ensure their business data needs are met accurately, timely, and efficiently.
  
  
The BDS philosophy is anchored on BlackRock’s cornerstone principles: Innovation, Fiduciary focus, Passion for Performance, and the unified purpose of One BlackRock. Through that lens, we seek to build value for our clients by understanding their needs, the markets, and using technology to build best in class solutions. BDS has presence across 12 offices in 8 countries, servicing more than $17 trillion in AUM on Aladdin for BlackRock and BRS clients spanning 6 continents and all spectrums of the financial markets.
  
  
The Private Valuation Team within BDS supports the investment valuation function for private, illiquid investments acting as the interface between the investment professionals, external valuation providers, accounting outsource providers, auditors, and Global Fund Services. The team focuses on adding value by providing valuation oversight and coordination of valuations and supporting documentation.
  
  
**Role Responsibility**

* Prepare valuation documentation for private equity, private debt and other alternative investments.
* Support monthly and quarterly valuation cycles.
* Manage workflow of data to 3rd party valuation firms; working with investment teams to ensure all relevant information is incorporated into valuations.
* Provide high quality client service externally and internally. Address inquiries, perform controls, problem solve, and mitigate risks for clients and internal BlackRock partners.
* Initiate and help drive platform and process innovations to support fast-growing business needs, minimize risk, improve quality, and navigate the changing markets.
* Review and tie out of valuation templates received from third party service providers. Communicate any comments and coordinate sign off in coordination with Investment, Pricing and Fund Administration teams.
* Review legal documents to establish rights associated with new securities purchased.
* Prepare materials to be provided to the Valuation Committee and presenting findings to Pricing Committees and other management as necessary.
* Liaison with independent auditors and valuation firms. Provide support for valuations and answer questions as necessary in a controlled and efficient manner.
* Perform a review of fair value reporting provided by underlying managers and Co-Investment sponsors.
* Operate as part of a global team.

**Experience**

* Bachelor's degree is required, with preference to Accounting or Finance.
* 5-10 years meaningful experience, private investment valuation experience preferred.
* Solid understanding of ASC 820 and IFRS 13, familiarity with PWERM, OPM, and Current Value valuation techniques
* Ability to work with and manage financial data and build summarized reports.
* Experience building, testing and implementing valuation models.
* Natural standout colleague able to work in an innovative, ambitious, and fast paced environment while maintaining attention to detail.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills combined with agile critical thinking and a problem-solving attitude.
* Ability to quickly learn the intricacies of complex financial instruments.
* Working knowledge of Bloomberg, Reuters, Interactive Data and MS Office Suite as well as SQL, Unix commands, PERL, etc. is an advantage.

**Our Benefits**
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
  
  
**Our hybrid work model**
BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
  
  
**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided
**guidance**
on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
  
  
**About BlackRock**
At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
  
  
This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
  
  
To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.
  
  
BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

title: Associate Analyst, Analytics & Metrics
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Associate Analyst, Analytics & Metrics
  
  
**Overview**
We are seeking a Data Analyst to transform complex payments, transaction, customer, and operational data into accurate reporting and actionable business insights. The role combines hands-on data management, data quality, SQL and Python analysis, dashboard development, reporting automation, and stakeholder collaboration. The successful candidate will work with business and technology teams to improve performance, identify trends and growth opportunities, and support reliable, data-driven decisions.
  
  
Role
  
  
Data Preparation, Quality and Governance
  
  

* Extract, compile, cleanse, validate, standardize, and organize large datasets from multiple internal and external sources using SQL, Python, Excel, and approved data platforms.
* Review data for completeness, accuracy, consistency, duplication, and compatibility; investigate discrepancies and correct issues where possible or escalate them through defined channels.
* Research and obtain missing information required to complete datasets, records, or supporting documentation.
* Apply defined data extraction, labelling, categorization, mapping, reconciliation, and quality-control procedures.
* Perform internal quality reviews and maintain clear evidence of checks, corrections, assumptions, and data lineage.
* Handle sensitive and confidential information with professional maturity and comply with applicable data privacy, security, governance, and retention requirements.

Analysis and Business Insights
  
  

* Analyze payments and transaction data to identify trends, anomalies, customer behavior, operational performance, and potential growth or efficiency opportunities.

Use descriptive statistics, trend analysis, segmentation, model testing, and root-cause analysis
  
  

* Translate business requirements into structured analytical approaches, datasets, metrics, and reporting solutions.
* Interpret findings with the end user in mind and provide clear, practical recommendations supported by data.
* Collaborate with business, operations, product, risk, and technology stakeholders to clarify requirements and validate analytical outputs.

SQL, Python, Databricks and Automation
  
  

* Write and optimize SQL queries using joins, common table expressions, subqueries, aggregations, and window functions for extraction, validation, reconciliation, and analysis.
* Use Python, particularly pandas and NumPy, to manipulate data, perform quality checks, conduct analysis, and build reusable processing scripts.
* Work with Databricks notebooks and Spark or PySpark for data preparation and distributed processing, with guidance for more complex engineering activities.
* Automate recurring reports, validation routines, and data preparation processes to reduce manual effort and improve consistency.
* Support basic machine-learning activities such as feature preparation, model testing, performance evaluation, classification, clustering, or predictive analysis under established frameworks.
* Document code, logic, dependencies, business rules, and operating procedures so solutions can be reviewed, maintained, and reused.

Reporting and Visualization
  
  

* Build, maintain, and enhance dashboards in Power BI, Tableau, or similar tools to track business metrics, KPIs, trends, and exceptions.
* Prepare accurate recurring and ad-hoc reports, presentations, and analytical summaries for technical and non-technical audiences.
* Validate dashboard calculations and reporting outputs against source systems before release.
* Store completed work in designated repositories, maintain appropriate versions, and perform backup activities as instructed.
* Present findings, limitations, and recommendations clearly to stakeholders and respond to follow-up questions with supporting evidence.

Delivery and Collaboration
  
  

* Manage multiple assignments or projects simultaneously while meeting agreed quality, productivity, and turnaround expectations.
* Work effectively in a fast-paced environment, prioritize competing requests, and communicate risks or delays early.
* Partner with cross-functional and global teams, participate in reviews, and contribute to process and reporting improvements.
* Operate independently on defined tasks while seeking appropriate guidance for complex, ambiguous, or high-risk issues.
* Demonstrate professionalism, accountability, punctuality, attention to detail, and a goal-oriented approach.

**All About You**
Required Qualifications and Experience
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Commerce, or a related discipline.

3-4 years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, data management, reporting, or a related technical role.
  
  

* Proven experience working with large datasets, performing data validation, resolving quality issues, and delivering accurate analytical outputs.
* Strong SQL skills, including joins, aggregations, common table expressions, window functions, and complex queries.
* Proficiency in Python for data manipulation and analysis, particularly pandas and NumPy.
* Good to have knowledge on Power BI, Tableau, or a comparable data-visualization platform.
* Good Microsoft Excel skills, including formulas, pivot tables, lookups, data analysis, and preferably Power Query.
* Working knowledge of statistics, trend analysis, model testing, and analytical problem-solving.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including report writing, presentations, and stakeholder discussions.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage priorities and deliver work accurately within deadlines.
* Experience with web-based applications, internet research, Microsoft Office, and common data-management tools.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in payments, banking, fintech, financial services, or another transaction-intensive environment.
* Familiarity with payment and transaction metrics, customer segmentation, fraud or anomaly analytics, and operational performance reporting.
* Exposure to Databricks, Spark, PySpark, cloud data platforms, Delta tables, or distributed data-processing concepts.
* Exposure to machine-learning modelling, including data preparation, feature engineering, model evaluation, and interpretation of results.
* Experience with APIs, Git or version control, reporting automation, A/B testing, or predictive analytics.
* Relevant certifications in analytics, business intelligence, cloud platforms, Python, SQL, or Databricks are advantageous.
* Flexibility to support India night shifts, a 24x7 operating model, or alignment with the US holiday calendar where required by the team.

Success in This Role
  
  

* Deliver accurate, complete, and timely analyses, reports, and datasets with clear quality checks.
* Create dashboards and visualizations that are easy to understand, relevant to end users, and aligned with agreed business metrics.
* Reduce manual reporting and data-preparation effort through practical, maintainable automation.
* Identify meaningful trends, discrepancies, risks, and opportunities and convert them into actionable recommendations.
* Build stakeholder confidence through reliable delivery, transparent communication, sound documentation, and responsible handling of data.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

description:

**Role Description**

* Loans / lending commitments are often a key component of the relationships held by Deutsche Bank with its corporate and financial institutional clients. Relationship loans are typically issued to support the generation of franchise revenues booked by the product lines across the Corporate Bank and Investment Bank divisions.
* Strategic Corporate Lending (“SCL”) provides governance around the investment of loan capital into these client relationships and risk manages the approved final hold positions down to pre-defined thresholds set by Credit Risk Management. SCL owns the loan risk that it is hedging within its predominantly senior, unsecured asset class Institutional and Corporate Credit portfolio.
* SCL hedges the final hold positions down to the pre-defined thresholds using single name CDS and the issuance of CLOs referencing the underlying loan risk. SCL Client Analytics team plays a key role in supporting the loan execution team by preparing Capital Allocation Forum (CAF) memos, which facilitate lending decision-making by SCL regional heads. A day in the life…

title: Demand Planner
description:
**Job Description**
**Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International?**
**Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It Possible**
**Key Responsibilities**
**How you will contribute**

* Lead the monthly demand planning cycle for the Chocolates category, generating a robust, data‑driven forecast across SKUs, channels, customers, and regions.
* Use advanced statistical models and analytical tools to build, maintain, and continuously improve short‑, medium‑, and long‑term forecasts.
* Own and drive improvements in forecast quality (accuracy, bias, fidelity, forecast value add), directly impacting service level, working capital, ageing, and cost‑to‑serve.
* Lead the demand stream of the S&OP/IBP process, running structured demand reviews and ensuring a single, aligned consensus forecast with Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Supply.
* Translate commercial drivers (baseline, promotions, activations, NPD, price changes, distribution expansion, mix changes) into clear demand signals and scenarios.
* Partner closely with Revenue Growth Management, Category, and Sales teams to understand elasticity, ATL/BTL plans, seasonality, and demand‑shaping actions and reflect these in the demand plan.
* Monitor and report key KPIs such as forecast accuracy and bias, case fill rate, OTIF, inventory turns, ageing, and write‑offs; conduct root‑cause analysis and lead corrective action plans.
* Manage and continuously improve S&OE/ITP processes to connect weekly execution with the medium‑term demand plan, proactively addressing risks and opportunities.
* Champion the deployment and enhancement of advanced planning systems (e.g., o9, SAP IBP, APO, Anaplan), including adoption of AI/ML‑based forecasting where relevant.
* Lead or support core implementation projects for demand planning / IBP solutions, working with IT and global/regional teams.
* Build forecasting and demand planning capability across the broader team through coaching, best‑practice sharing, and process standardization.
* Provide clear, insight‑driven narratives to senior leadership on demand risks, opportunities, and scenario impacts on service, revenue, and working capital.
* Ensure differentiated planning approaches for emerging channels such as Q‑Commerce, E‑commerce, and Omni‑channel retail, reflecting their unique demand patterns and volatility.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

* 8–10 years of hard‑core Demand Planning / IBP / S&OP experience in FMCG food categories, with a demonstrable track record of impact on service, inventory, and cost.
* Advanced understanding of demand (baseline, elasticity, ATL/BTL, seasonality, demand shaping) and strong business acumen to make sense of RTM, RGM, distribution, offtakes, and trade pipelines.
* Experience handling all categories or a major flagship category of roughly $ 1.5 bn revenue and a minimum of 500 SKUs.
* Background in leading MNC organizations; a mix of MBB consulting plus industry experience is preferable.
* Proven o9 implementation experience – core design, configuration, testing, and deployment for demand planning / IBP. Solid foundation in AI/ML and statistical forecasting models, with the ability to select and apply the right model by segment and horizon.
* Clear, practical understanding of forecast quality metrics (accuracy, bias, fidelity, FVA) and their impact on service levels, working capital, and cost.
* Solid understanding and hands‑on experience of the 5‑step Oliver Wight IBP process, including running mature IBP/S&OP cycles.
* Hands‑on expertise in running S&OE / ITP processes that connect operational execution with the tactical demand plan.
* Seasoned professional with superior communication skills, capable of leading and steering consensus meetings with Commercial, Finance, and Supply Chain stakeholders.
* Exposure to and understanding of demand dynamics in upcoming channels such as Q‑Commerce, E‑commerce, and Omni‑channel, and how these influence planning strategies.

**Qualifications & Skills**

* Postgraduate degree in Supply Chain Management, Operations, Engineering, Statistics, or Business Management.
* Strong command of advanced planning tools (o9, SAP IBP, APO, Anaplan, or similar) and high proficiency in Excel and data analytics.
* Strong commercial orientation with the ability to link demand plans to P&L, pricing, trade investments, and portfolio decisions.
* High learning agility, problem‑solving orientation, and comfort working in a dynamic, fast‑paced FMCG environment.

title: Senior Associate, Corporate Treasury
description:
*Over the last 20 years, Ares’ success has been driven by our people and our culture. Today, our team is guided by our core values – Collaborative, Responsible, Entrepreneurial, Self-Aware, Trustworthy – and our purpose to be a catalyst for shared prosperity and a better future. Through our recruitment, career development and employee-focused programming, we are committed to fostering a welcoming and inclusive work environment where high-performance talent of diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives can build careers within this exciting and growing industry.*
**Job Description**
The Ares Corporate Treasury Department is responsible for capital planning, global cash and liquidity management, and foreign exchange risk mitigation across the organization’s multi-jurisdictional footprint. The department supports the business through several key functions spanning North America, EMEA, and Asia-Pacific, ensuring effective treasury operations across diverse regulatory, banking, and market environments, including:
  
  

* Balance Sheet Management: Developing strategies to leverage and monetize current and forecasted balance sheet assets across global entities and jurisdictions, while optimizing capital efficiency at both the corporate and regional levels.
* Capital Markets: Monitoring equity, debt, and loan capital markets to execute fundraising transactions that support anticipated capital requirements across multiple currencies and international markets.
* Liquidity and Cash Management: Forecasting and monitoring global cash needs, managing multi-currency liquidity structures, and facilitating cross-border transactions to support international entities and investment platforms.
* Foreign Exchange Risk Management: Identifying, evaluating, and executing derivative transactions to mitigate currency risks.

The Corporate Treasury Senior Associate will provide strategic support for the company’s global treasury team. This role is expected to participate in design, creation and maintenance of financial models and forecasts, the execution
  
  
of critical treasury activities and remain deeply involved in day-to-day cash, liquidity, and risk management across the organization. This role requires knowledge in treasury systems, experience operating in complex international environments, and a strategic mindset to drive global process standardization while accommodating regional requirements.
  
  
**Primary Functions And Essential Responsibilities**

* Perform cash management operations, including multi-currency cash pooling, intercompany funding structures, and short-term investment management across regions.
* Support treasury activities for fund groups, including Secondaries, Private Equity, and Co-investment.
* Support the management of credit facility activities, including forecasting facility requirements.
* Coordinate with regional finance teams across time zones to ensure optimal global cash positioning.
* Assist with the design, creation and implementation of liquidity and capital planning forecast models, including stress-testing functionalities.
* Collaborate with the Capital Solutions team to assess and monitor foreign exchange, interest rate, and counterparty risks.
* Drive initiatives for assessment and implementation of treasury workstations (e.g., Kyriba, FIS), including global system governance, regional workflow optimization, and integration with enterprise platforms.
* Drive enhancements and automation projects to improve visibility, efficiency, and accuracy in liquidity forecasting, cash management, payment processing, and reporting, including creation of PowerBi dashboards.
* Lead coordination for managing global cash positioning, banking relationships, and ensure compliance with internal controls and regulatory requirements.
* Participate to ensure compliance with internal controls, SOX requirements, and country-specific regulatory standards.
* Support global corporate treasury responsibilities, including rating agency relationships, financial commitments tracking, and other strategic transactions.
* Preparation, delivery, and presentation of global treasury reports to executive leadership.

**Qualifications**
**Education:**

* Bachelors Degree in Accounting, Economics or Finance

**Experience Required**

* 6+ years of experience in global Treasury or investment management.
* Demonstrated track record in hands-on forecasting, creation and maintenance of financial models.
* Comprehensive knowledge of treasury operations, including banking and cash management/forecasting in both U.S. and international contexts.
* Demonstrated experience partnering with business units to drive operational efficiency and collaborative outcomes
* Proficiency with treasury tools and banking portals, including familiarity with various payment methods and flows (local and cross-border wires, ACH).
* Strong technical acumen for solving complex problems using enterprise tools (report writers, SQL, Excel, Tableau/PowerBI, or Anaplan).
* Experience in business operations.
* Proven ability to lead process improvement and automation initiatives.
* Exceptional relationship management skills with banks and both internal and external stakeholders.

**General Requirements**

* Flexibility regarding role scope and willingness to take on new projects and acquire new skills.
* Outstanding written and verbal communication, presentation, documentation, and interpersonal skills; strong customer focus.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and competing demands; strong time management and prioritization skills.
* High degree of accuracy and attention to detail; confident decision-making abilities.
* Ability to extract and synthesize meaningful insights from extensive research and analysis, presenting findings in a clear and digestible format.
* Sound judgment in escalating issues versus resolving problems independently.
* Analytical mindset with a passion for process efficiency and innovation.
* Comfort with ambiguity and uncertainty in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
* Flexibility in working hours to coordinate with team members across various time zones.

**Reporting Relationships**
Principal, Treasury
  
  
*There is no set deadline to apply for this job opportunity. Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the search is no longer active.*

title: Deputy Manager - B&M (Category Management)
description:
The Deputy Manager – Buying & Merchandising (Category Management) will support the seasonal range planning, assortment building, category performance management and commercial execution for the Footwear category.
  
  
The role will be responsible for translating category and business requirements into effective assortments, tracking seasonal deliveries, monitoring sell-through and category performance, supporting End of Season Sale (EOSS) planning, and providing actionable insights at store, region, gender, style and size levels.
  
  
The position will work closely with Buying, Merchandising, Retail Operations, Marketing, Planning, Product Development and Store teams to ensure successful execution of the seasonal category strategy.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Season Range Planning & Assortment
* Support the development of seasonal range plans and assortment architecture for the Footwear category.
* Assist in building the right assortment based on category objectives, consumer preferences, store potential, historical performance and business requirements.
* Support assortment decisions across gender, category, style, size, price point and store grades.
* Participate in seasonal product conferences and contribute to product and assortment discussions.
* Identify assortment gaps and opportunities based on sales trends, market insights and category performance.
* Seasonal Product & Delivery Management
* Take ownership of tracking seasonal product deliveries for the respective category.
* Monitor delivery timelines against the agreed seasonal calendar and highlight potential delays or gaps.
* Coordinate with relevant internal stakeholders to ensure timely availability of products across channels and stores.
* Maintain and update seasonal product trackers and provide regular visibility on delivery status.
* Buying & Merchandise Planning
* Support the Buying Manager in developing seasonal buy plans aligned with category and business objectives.
* Prepare and maintain seasonal buy forms, catalogues and relevant merchandising documentation.
* Support merchandise planning to ensure the right product, quantity and assortment is available across stores and channels.
* Monitor inventory and sell-through trends and provide recommendations for corrective actions wherever required.
* Category Performance & Sell-Through Management
* Monitor and analyse category performance on a periodic basis across regions, stores and store grades.
* Conduct detailed analysis at category, gender, style and size levels to identify key performance drivers and gaps.
* Track sell-through and identify slow-moving, underperforming and high-performing products.
* Provide actionable recommendations to improve category productivity and inventory efficiency.
* Monitor performance against agreed GM% and category deliverables and highlight deviations.
* End of Season Sale (EOSS)
* Support the Buying Manager in EOSS planning and execution for the Footwear category.
* Analyze inventory ageing, sell-through and product performance to support markdown and liquidation decisions.
* Track EOSS performance and provide periodic updates on sales, inventory and sell-through.
* Support identification of products requiring specific interventions to optimize inventory liquidation.
* Marketing & Seasonal Initiatives
* Support the development and execution of the seasonal marketing calendar and key marketing initiatives.
* Coordinate with Marketing and relevant stakeholders to ensure category priorities are incorporated into seasonal campaigns.
* Support the creation of merchandise display plans for new-season products during the season.
* Ensure merchandising initiatives are aligned with product launches and category priorities.
* Product Knowledge & Store Training
* Conduct product training sessions for store teams to enhance product knowledge and selling effectiveness.
* Build awareness of key product features, technologies, benefits and selling propositions among store staff.
* Work with Retail Operations and store teams to ensure effective communication of seasonal product launches and priorities.
* Product Development & Channel Support
* Support new product development initiatives for key channels and business partners.
* Provide category and market inputs based on consumer trends, store-level performance and sales insights.
* Collaborate with relevant stakeholders to identify product opportunities and assortment requirements for specific channels/partners.
* Business Analytics & Insights
* Perform periodic, in-depth analysis of category performance across:

+ Region
+ Store and store grade
+ Category
+ Gender
+ Style
+ Size
+ Sell-through
+ Inventory/productivity

* Identify trends, opportunities and risks and translate data into actionable business recommendations.
* Prepare and present category performance reports and insights to relevant stakeholders.
* Support data-driven decision-making for range, assortment, replenishment and EOSS planning.

**Key Stakeholder Interfaces**
**The Role Will Work Closely With**

* Buying & Merchandising
* Retail Operations
* Planning & Allocation
* Marketing
* Product Development
* Finance
* Supply Chain
* Store Teams
* Key Channel / Business Partners

**Role Specifications**
**Qualification**

* Graduate from FDDI preferred.
* Additional qualification in Fashion, Retail, Merchandising, Business Management or a related discipline will be an advantage.

**Experience**

* Minimum 4 years of relevant experience in Buying & Merchandising / Category Management, preferably within the Footwear, Fashion, Sportswear or Lifestyle Retail industry.
* Experience in seasonal range planning, assortment building and category performance management will be preferred.

**Key Competencies**
**Functional Competencies**

* Season range planning and assortment building
* Category management
* Sell-through management
* Merchandise planning
* EOSS planning and execution
* Category and store-level performance analysis
* Style and size-level analysis
* Inventory and assortment productivity
* GM% management
* Product knowledge and merchandising
* Retail and consumer understanding

**Behavioral Competencies**

* Strong analytical and numerical ability
* Commercial acumen
* Attention to detail
* Problem-solving and decision-making skills
* Strong communication and stakeholder management
* Ability to work collaboratively across functions
* Ownership and accountability
* Ability to work in a fast-paced, target-driven retail environment
* Strong presentation and data interpretation skills

**Key Success Measures**
**Success In The Role Will Be Measured Through**

* Effectiveness of seasonal range and assortment planning
* Category sell-through and productivity
* Achievement of agreed GM% deliverables
* Timely tracking and availability of seasonal deliveries
* Effectiveness of EOSS planning and inventory liquidation
* Category performance across stores, regions, styles and sizes
* Quality of business insights and recommendations
* Effectiveness of product knowledge and store training initiatives
* Successful execution of seasonal and category priorities

**About Skechers**
Skechers, a global Fortune 500® company, develops and markets a diverse range of lifestyle and performance footwear, apparel, and accessories. Serving over 180 countries and territories, Skechers connects customers to products through department and specialty stores, e-commerce and digital stores, and through our more than 5,300 Skechers retail locations.

title: AI / ML Modelling Engineer
description:
**About Business Line/Function**
The AML IT function sits within the BNP Paribas Corporate & Institutional Banking (CIB) CEFS‑technology ecosystem and provides end‑to‑end technology platform that enables the bank’s anti‑money‑laundering (AML) program. Its core purpose is to translate regulatory and compliance requirements into robust, scalable, and secure IT solutions that detect, investigate, and report suspicious activity across the Group’s global operations.
  
  
The AML IT business line is the technology backbone that transforms raw transaction data into actionable AML intelligence, ensuring that BNP Paribas CIB meets its regulatory obligations while maintaining operational resilience and innovation.
  
  
**Position Purpose**
The role centers on creating next‑generation AML capabilities and will be instrumental in protecting the BNPP Group from fraud, money‑laundering, and other financial crimes by using advanced technologies and innovative solutions.
  
  
As an AI-ML Engineer, you will design, train and deploy machine learning models that detect money laundering and financial crime. This position is vital for shaping the core detection capability of the platform. This also involves execution of various AML initiatives, thereby strengthening the organization’s overall risk management.
  
  
While direct AML experience is not mandatory, a strong foundation in machine learning, sound engineering practices, and a willingness to learn the financial-crime domain are essential. Familiarity with regulated environments, model governance, or fraud and anomaly detection is an advantage, but we are primarily looking for engineers who can build robust, well-calibrated, production-grade models and reason carefully about their real-world impact. The role will operate within a globally distributed environment.
  
  
Direct Responsibilities
  
  

* Model Development & Evaluation – Design, train, and assess ML models (NNs, GNNs, gradient‑boosted ensembles, unsupervised anomaly detectors) for money‑laundering detection across transaction, client, and network levels.
* Feature Engineering Pipeline – Build and optimise Spark/Delta Lake pipelines, ensuring feature consistency between training and production.
* Lifecycle Management – Track experiments, version models, and run champion‑challenger workflows with MLflow.
* Low‑Latency Deployment – Deploy and maintain inference services (e.g., BentoML) on the on‑prem Kubernetes platform.
* Calibration & Scoring – Calibrate models and map scores to probabilities to deliver reliable, decision‑ready risk scores.
* Explainability & Governance – Provide model explainability for audits, document design/assumptions/validation, and guarantee full reproducibility and auditability for regulatory compliance.
* Cross‑Functional Collaboration – Partner with data engineers, graph/LLM specialists, and compliance analysts to translate detection requirements into production‑ready models.

**Technical & Behavioral Competencies**

* Python engineering & secure code – Expert in object‑oriented, modular, and reusable Python code; packaging, logging, metrics, and tracing (ELK, Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry); security primitives (OAuth2/JWT) and data‑privacy compliance (GDPR/CCPA).
* ML modeling & calibration – Hands‑on with PyTorch (custom architectures, focal loss, training loops, GPU optimization), XGBoost/LightGBM, scikit‑learn/Keras/TensorFlow; deep knowledge of model calibration (Platt scaling, score‑to‑probability, MC‑Dropout), evaluation (PR/AUC‑ROC, F‑beta, lift charts) and handling class imbalance along with the underlying statistical concepts (calibration theory, hypothesis testing).
* Large‑scale data processing – Proficient in Pandas, Dask, Polars (or equivalent) for transactional‑scale datasets; feature engineering, distributed pipelines, and performance‑aware data handling.
* MLOps & lifecycle management – MLflow (experiment tracking, model registry, stage promotion), BentoML (runners, adaptive batching, CPU/GPU pools), GitOps/Argo CD for A/B‑testing and champion‑challenger workflows; CI/CD pipelines with Git/Bitbucket.
* Python microservices & containerization – Designing and deploying APIs with FastAPI, Flask, or Django; async I/O, Celery task queues, Docker packaging, and Kubernetes orchestration for scalable inference services.
* Data storage & query optimization – Strong command of SQL (PostgreSQL, Oracle) and NoSQL/graph stores (Cassandra, MongoDB, Neo4j, JanusGraph); schema design, indexing, and performance tuning.
* Experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP; messaging/streaming (Kafka, RabbitMQ); cross‑team and multi‑geography collaboration, rapid technology adoption, mentorship, and end‑to‑end ownership of solutions.
* Strong collaboration and learning mindset, with the ability to work across teams and geographies, adapt to new technologies, mentor others, and take end-to-end ownership.

**Nice To Have Skills**

* Experience with W&B alongside MLflow.
* Evidently AI or similar drift/monitoring platforms
* DVC or LakeFS for dataset versioning
* TorchServe / Triton / KServe (alternative serving paths)
* Exposure to large scale data or streaming platforms such as Spark, Flink, or similar frameworks in high volume processing contexts.

**Education Level**
Bachelor Degree or equivalent
  
  
Experience Level
  
  
At least 7 years
  
  
**Job Title**
AIML\_Engineer
  
  
**Date**
18/05/2026

**About BNP Paribas India Solutions**
Established in 2005, BNP Paribas India Solutions is a wholly owned subsidiary of BNP Paribas SA, European Union’s leading bank with an international reach. With delivery centers located in Bengaluru, Chennai, and Mumbai, we are a 24x7 global delivery center. Driving innovation and growth, we are harnessing the potential of over 10000 employees, to provide support and develop best-in-class solutions.

BNP Paribas is the European Union’s leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking & Services for the Group’s commercial & personal banking and several specialized businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment & Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate & Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.
  
  
**Overview**
The purpose of the job is to support Demand planning function by providing Innovative solutions and help implementing it to optimize/Standardize processes which will bring improvement to overall forecasting approach resulting in better accuracy. Explore and take up opportunities which supports the demand planning efforts by creating and executing industry standard approaches. This role requires you to operate on the 1.30pm to 10.30pm shift.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**

* Basic understanding of new product launches, forecasting techniques, and statistical forecasting models, with the ability to fine-tune model parameters to align forecasts with business needs and market dynamics.
* Analyze forecasting outputs, interpret patterns and trends in complex datasets, and prepare insightful reports to support stakeholder decision-making. Evaluate and monitor key performance metrics, such as forecast accuracy and bias, and publish performance dashboards to keep stakeholders informed.
* Identify improvement opportunities through root cause analysis (RCA) to achieve business targets and enhance reliability, while managing data requirements for new product launch forecasting and prioritizing support requests based on business impact and resource constraints.
* Use tools (like GCP, Python Dash, Tableau, AFO etc.) to extract, transform and manage data from primary and secondary sources using SQL, Excel and Python.
* Collaborate with stakeholders and brand marketing teams to align demand forecasts with launch strategies and promotional plans, lead consensus meetings to incorporate cross-functional feedback, and standardize processes by training stakeholders on tools and methodologies to improve adoption and efficiency.
* Coordinate with technical /data science teams to identify process improvement opportunities, validate outputs, propose modification if required.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Education: Minimum of a bachelor’s degree in Operational research, statistics, supply chain and any other relevant field 3 years of related experience
* Experience: 2-3 years of experience in data analysis and high level of analytical skills,
* Technical Skills: Working knowledge of data visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, and Looker, along with forecasting techniques, including time-series models (Exponential Smoothing and ARIMA) and machine learning methods.
* Proficiency in statistical analysis and data handling using R, Python, Excel, and SQL to derive meaningful insights from datasets.
* Basic understanding of cloud platforms such as GCP, AWS, and Azure, as well as supply chain, CPG, and retail operations.
* Soft Skills: Demonstrates critical thinking, integrity, teamwork, demand management expertise, a systematic approach to problem-solving, the ability to influence without authority, and strong interpersonal skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master’s degree with a major in Operations or a related field.
* Minimum of 5 years of relevant professional experience.
* Professional certifications such as CSCMP or APICS are preferred.
* Proficiency in Excel, knowledge of ERP systems, and familiarity with functional planning tools such as SAP APO.

**ELIGIBILITY**
Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.
